Arcadiamon (Rookie).text: Soul Absorption: Disassembles and absorbs the opponent's data.

Arcadiamon (Rookie).name: Erase Sickle
Arcadiamon (Rookie).text: Erase Sickle: Erases the opponent's configuration data.

Arcadiamon (Ultimate).text: Converts foe into 0's and 1's which are then absorbed.

Arcadiamon (Ultimate).name: Freeze Tentacle
Arcadiamon (Ultimate).text: Freeze Tentacle: Freezes its opponents' data with its tentacle-shaped appendages, halting any biological activity.

Arcadiamon (Ultra).name: God Matrix
Arcadiamon (Ultra).text: God Matrix: An unblockable attack that instantly dismantles anything and everything into ones and zeroes with invisible waves.

Arcadiamon (Ultra).name: Dystopia Lances
Arcadiamon (Ultra).text: Dystopia Lances: Absorbs data from Digimon and attack energy with just a touch of its countless feelers.

Archelomon.name: Ocean Streamer
Archelomon.text: Ocean Streamer (Ocean Strom): Conjures up a ferocious storm by crying out to the clouds.

Archelomon.name: Fin Cutters
Archelomon.text: Fin Cutters (Fin Cutter): Attacks with his blade-like flippers.

Arcturusmon.name: Black Death
Arcturusmon.text: Black Death: Stabs the target with an arm drill and injects the corrosive GRB contagion.

Arcturusmon.name: Dark Confession
Arcturusmon.text: Dark Confession (Black Confession): Coats both of its drills with large amounts of GRB contagion, rapidly spins them to condense the secretions to inordinate concentrations, then launches it forth as a ranged attack.

Argomon (Champion).name: Entrap
Argomon (Champion).text: Entrap (Imprisonment): Restrains the enemy with the tentacles that extend from its mouth.

Argomon (Champion).name: Voltline
Argomon (Champion).text: Voltline (Bolt Line): Causes an electric shock to run through the enemy.

Argomon (In-Training).name: Acid Bubbles
Argomon (In-Training).text: Acid Bubbles: When an enemy draws near, it spits out its "Acid Bubbles" from its giant eye-like pattern.

Argomon (Mega).name: Distortion Line
Argomon (Mega).text: Distortion Line: Beams destructive enough to completely distort even dimensions, fired from the eyes on its limbs.

Argomon (Mega).name: Brute Force
Argomon (Mega).text: Brute Force: Mows down the enemy with its massive body. It is exceptionally destructive.

Argomon (Mega).name: Disaster
Argomon (Mega).text: Disaster: Countless beams fired from its mouth.

Argomon (Mega).name: Mystic Cannon
Argomon (Mega).text: Mystic Cannon ( Cannon): Blows up the enemy with powerful cursed volleys.

Argomon (Rookie).name: Brute Knuckles
Argomon (Rookie).text: Brute Knuckles (Brute Knuckle): Curls up the tentacles on its arms into balls and punches with them.

Argomon (Rookie).name: Imprisonment
Argomon (Rookie).text: Imprisonment: Restrains the enemy with its loose tentacles.

Argomon (Ultimate).name: Elimination Line
Argomon (Ultimate).text: Elimination Line: Fires an erasing beam from the eyes on its limbs

Argomon (Ultimate).name: Entrap
Argomon (Ultimate).text: Entrap (Imprisonment): Uses its tentacles to constrict the opponent's powers and completely restrict their movement.

Argomon (Ultimate).name: Worm Phase
Argomon (Ultimate).text: Worm Phase: Transforms into a parasite after taking control of a vast field.

Argomon (Ultimate).name: Hupunos Claw
Argomon (Ultimate).text: Hupunos Claw (Hypnos Claw): Slashes with its cursed tentacles.

Ariemon.name: Entangling Algae
Ariemon.text: Entangling Algae: Extends the ribbon wrapped around its shell staff to immobilize enemies.

Ariemon.name: Tidal Spear
Ariemon.text: Tidal Spear"}}: Imbues its staff with seawater and transforms it into a spear to impale its foes.

Ariemon.name: Cleansing Waters
Ariemon.text: Cleansing Waters"}}: Summons invigorating seawater to cleanse any wounds or illnesses.

ArkhaiAngemon.name: Saint Legion
ArkhaiAngemon.text: Saint Legion: Summons myriad familiars and controls them all at once.

ArkhaiAngemon.name: Heaven's Flame
ArkhaiAngemon.text: Heaven's Flame: Intensifies the fire in the Holy Rod and uses it to incinerate foes.

ArkhaiAngemon.name: Brave Aura
ArkhaiAngemon.text: Brave Aura: Envelops its allies in flames spewed from the Holy Rod to protect them from enemy attacks.

Armadillomon.name: Diamond Shell
Armadillomon.text: Diamond Shell (Rolling Stone): Curls up its body and rushes the opponent.

Armadillomon.name: Beat Blaster
Armadillomon.text: Beat Blaster (Scratch Beat): Strikes the opponent with the elongated claws on its forelegs.

Armadillomon.name: Beast Attack
Armadillomon.text: Beast Attack: Attacks with a swift blow of a powerful beast.

Armageddemon.name: Full Scale Attack
Armageddemon.text: Full Scale Attack (Black Rain): Fires energy shells from its back into the sky, which fall like rain as scattered beams.

Armageddemon.name: Destiny Destroyer
Armageddemon.text: Destiny Destroyer (Ultimate Flare): Emits a destructive energy wave from its gaping maw.

Armalizamon.name: Neutron Laser
Armalizamon.text: Neutron Laser: Fires charged neutrons from its mouth as a laser that can pierce through virtually anything, even Ultimate Digimon when at full output.

Armalizamon.name: Neutron Diffuser
Armalizamon.text: Neutron Diffuser: Fires scattered beams with decreased power.

Armalizamon.name: Neutron Blade
Armalizamon.text: Neutron Blade: Extends the scales on its arms to emit blade-shaped beams of charged neutrons that burns through enemies in close combat.

Armalizamon.name: Death Roll Press
Armalizamon.text: Death Roll Press: Curls up and rams into enemies with as much weight as it can stomach.

Armamon.name: Crystal
Armamon.text: Crystal: Showers the opponent in sharp crystals. In Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Blue and Red, the crystals also drain the opponent's energy to heal Armamon.

Armamon.name: Rainbow Hand
Armamon.text: Rainbow Hand: Fires a rainbow-colored aura from its right hand, rendering its opponents unconscious.

Armamon.name: Sword Masquerade
Armamon.text: Sword Masquerade: Performs a sword dance with its greatsword. In Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Blue and Red,  this can also confuse the opponent.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Sword of Meteor
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Sword of Meteor: Unleashes a powerful slicing attack with its six swords.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Infinity Sword Rain
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Infinity Sword Rain: Brings the swords floating around it crashing down over its opponent's head.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Hell & Thunder
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Hell & Thunder: Attacks with its sword of lightning and Barbamon-based sword of darkness.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Heaven & Break
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Heaven & Break: Attacks with its holy lance and the spikes on its grappling hand.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Ice & Fire
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Ice & Fire: Attacks with its swords of ice and fire.

Armamon Burst Mode.name: Data to Data
Armamon Burst Mode.text: Data to Data: Heals itself and increases its strength.

Armormon.name: Justice Strike
Armormon.text: Justice Strike (Justice Massacre): Strikes with the Gatling guns on both its arms and the machine guns on its stomach in the name of justice.

Armormon.name: Surprise Attack
Armormon.text: Surprise Attack: Disappears from sight and attacks from behind.

Arresterdramon.name: Mach Flicker
Arresterdramon.text: Mach Flicker: Unleashes high speed punches while bending both of its arms.

Arresterdramon.name: Flog Shot
Arresterdramon.text: Flog Shot: Brandishes its Tail Anchor to chop up the opponent.

Arresterdramon.name: Spin Caliper
Arresterdramon.text: Spin Caliper: Bisects the opponent with its super-sized Tail Anchor while performing a single revolution.

Arresterdramon.name: Spiral Shredder
Arresterdramon.text: Spiral Shredder: Rotates at high speed to cut the opponent to pieces.

Arresterdramon.name: Prism
Arresterdramon.text: Prism (Prism Gallet): Adds to "Spiral Shredder" by becoming countless revolutions of dragon-shaped lights to cleave the opponent apart.

Arresterdramon.name: Eraser Flog Shot
Arresterdramon.text: Eraser Flog Shot: Wields its eraser-equipped Tail Anchor to erase the opponent.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Blaze Spiker
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Blaze Spiker: Attacks with a blazing  that will completely break through any defense, no matter how sturdy, if it swings through with all its might.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Mach Flicker
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Mach Flicker: Unleashes high speed punches while bending both of its arms.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Flog Shot
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Flog Shot: Wields the Tail Anchor to chop up the opponent.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Spin Caliber
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Spin Caliber: Bisects the opponent with its super-sized Tail Anchor while performing a single revolution.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Spiral Shredder
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Spiral Shredder: Rotates at high speed to cut the opponent to pieces.

Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.name: Prism Garrett
Arresterdramon Superior Mode (Brave Snat.text: Prism Garrett (Prism Gallett): Adds to "Spiral Shredder" by becoming countless revolutions of dragon-shaped lights to cleave the opponent apart.

Arukenimon.name: Spider Thread
Arukenimon.text: Spider Thread: Chops up the opponent with razor-sharp wires.

Arukenimon.name: Predation Spider
Arukenimon.text: Predation Spider: Attacks the opponent with the countless carnivorous Dokugumon hidden in its abdomen.

Arukenimon.name: Acid Mist
Arukenimon.text: Acid Mist: Sprays green acid from its mouth.

Arukenimon.name: Spirit Needle
Arukenimon.text: Spirit Needle: Plucks strands of its human form's hair and uses them to convert Control Spires into artificial Digimon. Using more strands of hair will create stronger Digimon; one for a Champion, ten for an Ultimate, and one hundred for a Mega.

Aruraumon.name: Nemesis Ivy
Aruraumon.text: Nemesis Ivy: Twines the opponent in the claws extended from its hands, then disorients them.

Aruraumon.name: Gloomy Dust
Aruraumon.text: Gloomy Dust (Gloom Dust): Spreads a fog of poisonous dust.

Aruraumon.name: Hungry Hand
Aruraumon.text: Hungry Hand: Drains energy from its foe.

Aruraumon.name: Poison Ivy
Aruraumon.text: Poison Ivy: Entangles the opponent in ivy laced with a powerful toxin, completely paralyzing them.

Astamon.name: Fire
Astamon.text: Fire (Hellfire): Fires every last bullet from the Oro Salmón.

Astamon.name: Maverick
Astamon.text: Maverick: Attacks with a kick which unleashes all of its pent-up dark .

Asuramon.text: Fire Fist of : Unleashes a Punch Rush from its four arms which possesses the offensive power to completely annihilate the opponent itself. Naturally, when that is used while Asuramon has its face of wrath, it is its last and strongest technique.

Asuramon.name: Fire Fist of Shiva
Asuramon.text: Fire Fist of Shiva: Fires off the flames that were wrapped around the fists of its four arms.

Asuramon.name: Asura Bakunenken
Asuramon.text: Asura Bakunenken: Simultaneously fires off the flames that were wrapped around the fists of its four outstretched arms.

Atamadekachimon.name: Head Crush
Atamadekachimon.text: Head Crush: Swings its head down at the opponent from above with all its might.
Restrains the opponent's movements by raising its loud voice to maximum volume.

Atamadekachimon.name: Minideka Flame
Atamadekachimon.text: Minideka Flame: Cooperates with Minidekachimon and spews flaming breath from its mouth, but it is uncertain whether the flames will be small or large until it comes out.

AtlurBallistamon.name: Plasma Splitter
AtlurBallistamon.text: Plasma Splitter (Plasma Crack): Fires a stream or sphere of electricity from its main horn, with power rivaling that of "Heaven's Thunder".

AtlurBallistamon.name: Rocket Bunker
AtlurBallistamon.text: Rocket Bunker: Unleashes a punch with its extensible arm.

Aurumon.name: MN Clutch
Aurumon.text: MN Clutch (Midnight Clutch): Approaches the opponent from behind under the cover of darkness, then swoops down on them with its talons.

AvengeKidmon.name: Misery Bullet Rain
AvengeKidmon.text: Misery Bullet Rain: Hits the target with many energy shots from its fingers, causing it to hover in the air from the force, then fires live ammunition from its whole body and drives it into the opponent.

AvengeKidmon.name: Destruction Trigger
AvengeKidmon.text: Destruction Trigger: Stomps on the opponent, without balking at injuring itself, then fires an explosion-inducing bullet at point blank range from the gun muzzles on its legs.

Azhdarmon.name: Tomahawk Strike
Azhdarmon.text: Tomahawk Strike: Transfers the energy from a sudden descent into its blades to kill with a single blow.

Azhdarmon.name: Tri Carve Rain
Azhdarmon.text: Tri Carve Rain: Uses the three blades on its head and wings to slice opponents to pieces.

Azhdarmon.name: Trinity Lightning
Azhdarmon.text: Trinity Lightning: Fires a high voltage lightning attack from its blades.

Azulongmon.name: Sourai
Azulongmon.text: Sourai: Looses intense thunderbolts from the sky, with divine fury.

Azulongmon.name: Aurora Force
Azulongmon.text: Aurora Force: Curls its body into a circle, generating an intense burst of lightning.

Azulongmon.name: Lightning Whip
Azulongmon.text: Lightning Whip: Looses an intense thunderbolt.

Baalmon.name: Kamiuchi
Baalmon.text: Kamiuchi: Releases a mighty, lightning-fast smite from the Dǎshénbiān, which is especially effective against Holy-species Digimon.

Baalmon.name: Guiltish
Baalmon.text: Guiltish: Transforms its amulets into various things to attack, such as bullets.

Baalmon X.name: Kamiuchi
Baalmon X.text: Kamiuchi: Releases a mighty, lightning-fast smite from the Deus Fractus, which is especially effective against Holy-species Digimon.

Baalmon X.name: Guiltish
Baalmon X.text: Guiltish: Transforms its amulets into various things to attack, such as bullets.

Baalmon X.name: Tribunal Blast
Baalmon X.text: Tribunal Blast (Tūri Blast): Unleashes a shot from the shotgun on its right arm.

Baalmon X.name: Zai-Kamiuchi
Baalmon X.text: Zai-Kamiuchi: Its whip, Deus Fractus, merges with its left arm to strike any enemies attempting to flee.

Baalmon X.name: Absorption Mark
Baalmon X.text: Absorption Mark: Aims the Red Book of Appin at its enemy, causing its enemy to be absorbed into one of the book's pages.

Babamon.name: Empress Haze
Babamon.text: Empress Haze: Erases bad viruses with a single sweep of the magic broom in its right hand.

Babamon.name: Empress Haze
Babamon.text: Empress Haze: Fires a stream of flame from its mouth.-->

Baboongamon.name: Mount Rock
Baboongamon.text: Mount Rock: Hurls the rocks on its arms.

Baboongamon.name: Glide Rocks
Baboongamon.text: Glide Rocks: Strikes the enemy with its rock-covered tail at tremendous speed.

Babydmon.name: Hot Steam
Babydmon.text: Hot Steam (Hot Gas): Fires a blow of hot gas produced in its body. The gas is not just hot but also spicy.

Bacchusmon.name: Cook of the Abyss
Bacchusmon.text: Cook of the Abyss (Cook of the Hell): Wraps up the opponent in both of its hands, transforms their configuration data into drinking snacks, and then eats them.

Bacchusmon.name: Party of the Heavens
Bacchusmon.text: Party of the Heavens (Party of the Heaven): Refines  and mixes them with poisons that cause sleep or paralysis, then pours them on its target to incapacitate them.

Bacchusmon.name: Reversal of the Dead
Bacchusmon.text: Reversal of the Dead (Reverse of the Dead): When Bacchusmon has had too much to drink, the pattern on its body will turn pale, and it will the expel the data in its large stomach in a destructive beam of light. If the attack hits an opponent, Bacchusmon takes in the data to become more powerful, so facing off against large groups of enemies can make it unfathomably strong.

Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).name: Cook of the Abyss
Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).text: Cook of the Abyss (Cook of the Hell): Wraps up the opponent in both of its hands, transforms their configuration data into drinking snacks, and then eats them.

Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).name: Party of the Heavens
Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).text: Party of the Heavens (Party of the Heaven): Refines  and mixes them with poisons that cause sleep or paralysis, then pours them on its target to incapacitate them.

Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).name: Reversal of the Dead
Bacchusmon (Deisui Mode).text: Reversal of the Dead (Reverse of the Dead): When Bacchusmon has had too much to drink, the pattern on its body will turn pale, and it will the expel the data in its large stomach in a destructive beam of light. If the attack hits an opponent, Bacchusmon takes in the data to become more powerful, so facing off against large groups of enemies can make it unfathomably strong.

Bagramon.name: Astral Snatcher
Bagramon.text: Astral Snatcher: Uses its artificial right arm to rip the soul out of a living Digimon's body, then either sends the extracted soul to heaven or hell as it pleases, or places it in another Digimon's body.

Bagramon.name: Invisible Snake Eyes
Bagramon.text: Invisible Snake Eyes: Uses its ruby right eye to observe anywhere within the Digital World and instantly obtain any information it wants to know.

Bagramon.name: Savage Cyclone
Bagramon.text: Savage Cyclone: Generates a dimensional storm anywhere within the Digital World through which it stretches its right arm to attack the opponent.

Baihumon.name: Kongou
Baihumon.text: Kongou: Emits a wave from its mouth which converts the opponent completely into metal, making them unable to move while their body rusts, and unable to die until they have completely rusted away.

Bakemon.name: Dark Claw
Bakemon.text: Dark Claw (Hell's Hand): Pulls the captured enemy all the way to hell.

Bakemon.name: Evil Charm
Bakemon.text: Evil Charm (Death Charm): Casts a powerful death spell on the opponent which is said to bring annihilation within five turns unless they are the possessor of a tenacious spirit. This technique is not possessed by Bakemon of File Island.

Bakemon.name: Ghost Chop
Bakemon.text: Ghost Chop: Attacks using small chops.

Bakemon.name: Poison Breath
Bakemon.text: Poison Breath: Blows out poisonous smoke.

Bakemon.name: Touch of Evil
Bakemon.text: Touch of Evil (Death Claw): Slashes enemies with power of darkness.

Bakomon.name: Gum Roll
Bakomon.text: Gum Roll: Flings the packing tape it holds in its hand, encircling and wrapping the opponent to stop them in their tracks.

Bakomon.name: Transdelivery
Bakomon.text: Transdelivery: Packs the enemy into a cardboard box and hurls them away.

BalliBeastmon.name: Belly Balli Dance
BalliBeastmon.text: Belly Balli Dance: Entices foes with a sensual belly dance.

BalliBeastmon.name: Seismic Speaker
BalliBeastmon.text: Seismic Speaker (Cat Speaker): Emits a low tone from the speaker in its belly, shattering the opponent.

BalliBeastmon.name: Sonic Dancing
BalliBeastmon.text: Sonic Dancing: Belly-dances to reveal its speaker and emit a sonic wave.

BalliBeastmon.name: Ultimate Speaker
BalliBeastmon.text: Ultimate Speaker: Amplifies sound into a destructive sonic wave.

Ballistamon.name: Ram Slammer
Ballistamon.text: Ram Slammer (Horn Breaker): Heroically uses its horn to fling the opponent.

Ballistamon.name: Seismic Speaker
Ballistamon.text: Seismic Speaker (Heavy Speaker): Emits a low tone from the speaker in its belly, shattering the opponent. This technique conceals the power to smash rocks and shake mountains, and that power level rises when it gets hungry.

Ballistamon.name: Arm Bunker
Ballistamon.text: Arm Bunker: Charges energy into its arm.

Ballistamon.name: Doomsday Woofer
Ballistamon.text: Doomsday Woofer (Ultimate Speaker): Amplifies sound into a destructive sonic wave.

Ballistamon.name: Shocking Electricity
Ballistamon.text: Shocking Electricity--6.68--: Emits an electric charge from the speaker in his belly.-->

Ballistamon Mush Cottage.name: Mush Full Course
Ballistamon Mush Cottage.text: Mush Full Course: Cooks and serves a wide variety of mushroom-themed dishes.

Ballistamon Sextet Launcher.name: Sextet Storm
Ballistamon Sextet Launcher.text: Sextet Storm|Arashi no Rokujūsō}}: Unleashes its ordinance of six cannons.

Baluchimon.name: Psychic Chain
Baluchimon.text: Psychic Chain: Once it immediately discerns the hostility of an intruder, it constricts their body with psychokinetic chains and drives them away.

Baluchimon.name: Cloud Vision
Baluchimon.text: Cloud Vision: For those who get lost in the ruins unknowingly, it is said that it displays illusions with the clouds that it spews out and leads them out of the ruins while they are in a dream-like state.

BanchoGolemon.name: Heaven's Hammer
BanchoGolemon.text: Heaven's Hammer: Grips the enemy in its right hand and hammer-throws them into the distance.

BanchoGolemon.name: Raging Dust
BanchoGolemon.text: Raging Dust: Reflects the beam fired from the Kanshakudama in its abdomen off of falling stones, resulting in an attack with a large area of effect.

BanchoGolemon.name: World Claw Drill
BanchoGolemon.text: World Claw Drill: Impales the enemy with the gigantic excavator on its left hand, which is capable of pulverising even Chrome Digizoid alloy.

BanchoLeomon.name: Lion Slash
BanchoLeomon.text: Lion Slash: Unleashes an attack from the Otokodama.

BanchoLeomon.name: Flash Bancho Punch
BanchoLeomon.text: Flash Bancho Punch (Flash Bantyo Punch): Releases a fist packed with fighting spirit honed to its utmost limit.

BanchoLeomon.name: Chivalry
BanchoLeomon.text: Chivalry: Strikes the ground to create a shockwave attack.

BanchoLeomon.name: Burning Bantyo Punch
BanchoLeomon.text: Burning Bantyo Punch (Burn Bantyo Punch): A powerful punch with a burning soul.

BanchoLeomon Burst Mode.name: Burning Bancho Punch
BanchoLeomon Burst Mode.text: Burning Bancho Punch: Foils foes with its fiery fists.

BanchoLeomon Burst Mode.name: Lion Slash
BanchoLeomon Burst Mode.text: Lion Slash: Unleashes an attack from the Otokodama.

BanchoLillymon.text: Uses its yo-yos to tear the enemy to pieces as well as the space around them.

BanchoLillymon.name: Twin Petal
BanchoLillymon.text: Twin Petal: Unleashes instant kicks with its gorgeous feet.

BanchoLillymon.name: Nightmare Assemble
BanchoLillymon.text: Nightmare Assemble: Uses its yo-yos to pierce the enemy and absorb them.

BanchoStingmon.name: Bloody Finish
BanchoStingmon.text: Bloody Finish: Skewers enemies with the drills on both of its arms.

BanchoStingmon.name: Depth Charge Sky
BanchoStingmon.text: Depth Charge Sky: Releases Mine Bugs that self-destruct when they hit enemies.

BanchoStingmon.name: Redbutt
BanchoStingmon.text: Redbutt: Headbutts an enemy hard enough to shatter their face.

BaoHuckmon.name: Fif Cross
BaoHuckmon.text: Fif Cross: Slashes with its claws.

BaoHuckmon.name: Teen Blade
BaoHuckmon.text: Teen Blade: Rotates the blade on its tail about its axis and stabs with it.

BaoHuckmon.name: Blazing Flame
BaoHuckmon.text: Blazing Flame (Burn Flame): Blazing Flame is capable of using for counterattacking.

BaoHuckmon.name: Dragless Spiker
BaoHuckmon.text: Dragless Spiker (Dragrey Spiker): Bisects the enemy using the razor-sharp blades that protrude from its hind limbs.

Barbamon.name: Death Lure
Barbamon.text: Death Lure: Uses its demonic staff "Death Lure" to tempt Digimon into an inescapable living hell, converting them to wickedness.

Unleashes all of the Dark Area's evil energies at once as an extremely high-temperature explosion that burns up everything without a trace. Even MaloMyotismon's "Screaming Darkness" releases only a fraction of these energies.

Barbamon.name: Dark Inferno
Barbamon.text: Dark Inferno: Burns the enemy with a dark flame.

Barbamon.name: Greedy Wand
Barbamon.text: Greedy Wand: Attacks with its favorite wand.

Barbamon X.text: Unleashes all of the Dark Area's evil energies at once as an extremely high-temperature explosion that burns up everything without a trace. Even MaloMyotismon's "Screaming Darkness" releases only a fraction of these energies.

Barbamon X.name: Death Lure
Barbamon X.text: Death Lure: Uses its demonic staff "Death Lure" to tempt Digimon into an inescapable living hell, converting them to wickedness.

Barbamon X.name: Seventh Jewelrize
Barbamon X.text: Seventh Jewelrize: Transforms the enemy's Digicore that it scoops out using its left arm into a jewel with the Crown of Greed. Because the jewels shine more the stronger a Digimon is, it assesses whether they are worth fighting.

Baromon.name: Dancing Meteor
Baromon.text: Dancing Meteor (Meteor Dance): Manipulates the spirits of the cosmos, causing a group of meteorites to rain down on the enemy. The downside is that it takes time to synchronize with the spirits of the cosmos, but once invoked, it is said that 10 terabytes of data surrounding the target is annihilated.

Bastemon.name: Witch Warp
Bastemon.text: Witch Warp ('): Beguiles the opponent with the bewitching charms of its belly dance. In Digimon World 3, this attack causes Digimon to de-digivolve back into their Rookie stage.

Bastemon.name: Mind Fogger
Bastemon.text: Mind Fogger (Vampire Dance): Gets close to the opponent while dancing, then sucks out all the blood in their body, down to the last drop.

Bearcatmon.name: Penetrate Blow
Bearcatmon.text: Penetrate Blow: Utilizes the jet propulsion of its roller skates together with the full strength of its body to deliver a devastating knifehand strike that can pierce through the opponent's body with the power of its sharp bear claws.

Bearcatmon.name: Murderize Rush
Bearcatmon.text: Murderize Rush: Rains blows upon its opponent with hardened knuckles at such high speed that it is difficult to evade by sight alone.

Bearcatmon.name: Beardown Spinning Kick
Bearcatmon.text: Beardown Spinning Kick: Employs the jet propulsion of the roller skates to send itself high into the air, where it spins to gather momentum and then delivers a potent dropkick.

Bearmon.name: Bear Fist
Bearmon.text: Bear Fist|lit. "Bear-cub Punch"}}: Drives a  into the opponent's chest with all its strength.

Bearmon.name: Bear Roll
Bearmon.text: Bear Roll: Curls up its body and charges towards the enemy.

Bearmon.name: Beast Attack
Bearmon.text: Beast Attack: Attacks with a swift blow of a powerful beast.

BeelStarmon.name: Fly Bullet
BeelStarmon.text: Fly Bullet: Fires a "Fly Bullet" from the Rizoma de Loto that homes in on the enemy's vitals.

BeelStarmon.name: Double Claw
BeelStarmon.text: Double Claw: Stabs and tears through enemies with the knives stocked on the Rizoma de Loto.

BeelStarmon.name: Hurricane Screw Shot
BeelStarmon.text: Hurricane Screw Shot: Wildly fires the guns hidden in the heels of its boots with a keen .

BeelStarmon X.name: Fly Bullet
BeelStarmon X.text: Fly Bullet: Fires a "Fly Bullet" from the Rizoma de Loto that homes in on the enemy's vitals.

BeelStarmon X.name: Double Claw
BeelStarmon X.text: Double Claw: Stabs and tears through enemies with the knives stocked on the Rizoma de Loto.

BeelStarmon X.name: Hurricane Screw Shot

Brigadramon.name: Exa Destroyer

BryweLudramon.name: Guren Storm
BryweLudramon.text: Guren Storm: Unleashes a blaze from its flaming wings.

BryweLudramon.name: Blast Smash
BryweLudramon.text: Blast Smash: Detaches its wings, shrouding itself in a barrier of flame as it charges towards the enemy.

Bucchiemon.name: Heavy Beam
Bucchiemon.text: Heavy Beam (Heartner Beam): Releases a soft light that causes a loss of fighting spirit and soothes the hearts of its enemies.

Bucchiemon (Green).name: Heartner Beam
Bucchiemon (Green).text: Heartner Beam: Releases a soft light that causes a loss of fighting spirit and soothes the hearts of its enemies.

Budmon.name: Poisonous Thorns
Budmon.text: Poisonous Thorns: Attacks with thorns that are painful if touched. If it gets angry, it can also fire them off.

Budmon.name: Frothy Spit
Budmon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Bukamon.name: Bubbles
Bukamon.text: Bubbles: Fires pink bubbles from its mouth.

Bukamon.name: Froth Bubbles
Bukamon.text: Froth Bubbles: Spits froth that looks like bubbles.

Bukamon.name: Acid Bubbles
Bukamon.text: Acid Bubbles: Produces bubble-like objects from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Bulbmon.name: Mad Pump
Bulbmon.text: Mad Pump ('): Dispatches soldiers one after another from within. In Digimon World 3, it shoots water at the enemy from its arms.

Bulbmon.name: Octagon Attack
Bulbmon.text: Octagon Attack: Tackles the enemy with its very hard body.

Bulbmon.name: Barb Extreme
Bulbmon.text: Barb Extreme (Valve Extreme): Fires a powerful beam of condensed energy.

Bulbmon.name: Force Rain
Bulbmon.text: Force Rain: Fires a beam from a built-in cannon.

Bulkmon.name: Electrical Fist
Bulkmon.text: Electrical Fist: Sends the enemy flying with a blow from its electricity-laced fist.

Bulkmon.name: Thunder Dread
Bulkmon.text: Thunder Dread: Discharges the electrical energy stored in its horn.

Bulucomon.name: Baby Hail
Bulucomon.text: Baby Hail: Exhales chilled air from its mouth, shooting out countless shards of ice.

Bulucomon.name: Ice Smash
Bulucomon.text: Ice Smash (Ice Mash): Attacks continuously with its outer shell of ice.

Buraimon.name: Dual Swallow Reversal
Buraimon.text: Dual Swallow Reversal: Shreds foes using rapid slices unleashed with both its blades in the shape of a cross.

Buraimon.name: Secret Sword: Raptor Felling
Buraimon.text: Secret Sword: Raptor Felling: Performs a spinning counter slash that launches itself up to strike opponents in flight.

Burgermon.name: Delicious Patty
Burgermon.text: Delicious Patty: Places the opponent inside a large, delicious patty and kneads them.

Burgermon.name: Green Pickles
Burgermon.text: Green Pickles: Throws a pickle-shaped disk at the enemy like a frisbee.

Burgermon (Champion).name: Spicy Onion
Burgermon (Champion).text: Spicy Onion: Causes the enemy to lose their fighting spirit with onion slices full of pepper.

Burgermon (Champion).name: Delicious Patty
Burgermon (Champion).text: Delicious Patty: Placing the enemy in a huge patty.

BurningGreymon.name: Pyro Barrage
BurningGreymon.text: Pyro Barrage (Corona Blaster): Fires lasers that rival a solar heat ray from the Rudriya Darpaṇa.

BurningGreymon.name: Wildfire Tsunami
BurningGreymon.text: Wildfire Tsunami (Flame Storm): Sets its whole body aflame, then releases a high-temperature tornado by flapping the Fire Wings.

BurningGreymon.name: Fire Below
BurningGreymon.text: Fire Below: While airborne, fires the Rudriya Darpaṇa downwards at an angle.

BurningGreymon.name: Tail Whip
BurningGreymon.text: Tail Whip: Quickly flicks its tail at the enemy.

BurningGreymon.name: Burning Grey Basher
BurningGreymon.text: Burning Grey Basher (Inferno): Charges forward at high speed, covered in flames.

BurningGreymon.name: Wildfire Tsunami
BurningGreymon.text: Wildfire Tsunami (Inferno Wildfire): Unleashes a massive tornado of flame around itself.

Butenmon.name: Sunburst Dance
Butenmon.text: Sunburst Dance: Traces a circle with a high-speed swing of its great blade, slicing through foes along its arc.

Butenmon.name: Daybreak Flash
Butenmon.text: Daybreak Flash: Mows down enemies with a powerful strike charged with enough force to level a mountain, the sight of which is likened to that of a war god bringing dawn to the battlefield.

Butterflymon.name: Sweet Honey Straw
Butterflymon.text: Sweet Honey Straw: Sucks the energy from the enemy like a bee.

Butterflymon.name: Sweet Pheromone
Butterflymon.text: Sweet Pheromone: Confuses the enemy by using a special powder.

Butterflymon.name: Honey Wave
Butterflymon.text: Honey Wave: Emits a mysterious sound wave from its wings.

Butterflymon.name: Sweet Kick
Butterflymon.text: Sweet Kick: Attacks with a powerful flying kick.

Callismon.name: Deep Forest
Callismon.text: Deep Forest: Uses its razor-sharp claws to shred its enemy down to their very data. In Digimon Adventure V-Tamer 01, it rams its claws on the ground, causing a small earthquake.

Callismon.name: Rodeo Bullet
Callismon.text: Rodeo Bullet: Fires off a trio of follow-up shots from the barrel cannon equipped to its right arm.

Calmaramon.name: Titanic Tempest
Calmaramon.text: Titanic Tempest (Titanic Charge): Rotates like a drill and strikes her enemy after withdrawing into its body.

Calmaramon.name: Acid Ink
Calmaramon.text: Acid Ink (Nero Corso, ): Sprays black acid from its mouth.

Calumon.name: Shining Digivolution
Calumon.text: Shining Digivolution (Shining Evolution): Releases the light of Digivolution to allow Digimon to digivolve to the Mega level.

Calumon.name: Kurumon Prayer
Calumon.text: Kurumon Prayer: Restore status and raise all resistance with prayer.

Candlemon.name: Lava Loogie
Candlemon.text: Lava Loogie (Bonfire): Fires a small flame from its DigiCore fire energy that explode if hits.

Candlemon.name: Paralyzer
Candlemon.text: Paralyzer (Melt Wax): Fires multiple globs of hot wax to paralyze opponent.

Candlemon.name: Candle Ring
Candlemon.text: Candle Ring: Emits an incredible beam of light.

Candlemon.name: Tackle
Candlemon.text: Tackle (Tai Atari): Uses its body made of hot wax to tackle the enemy.

CannonBeemon.name: Nitro Stinger
CannonBeemon.text: Nitro Stinger: Fires a shot from its high-caliber laser cannon which can even shoot clean through strongly armored opponents.

CannonBeemon.name: Sky Rocket ∞
CannonBeemon.text: Sky Rocket ∞: Fires a simultaneous bombarding barrage from the container on top of it, and continues on like raging waves until its watch is ended.

Cannondramon.name: DynamoCannon
Cannondramon.text: DynamoCannon (Dyna Cannon): Fires its cannons while stationed at an area where enemy attacks cannot reach.

Cannondramon.name: Grenade Storm
Cannondramon.text: Grenade Storm: Random-fires grenades from the gun on its front.

Canoweissmon.name: Galiafisher
Canoweissmon.text: Galiafisher ( Fissure): Tears the enemy to pieces with its tough claws. It boasts the power to easily cut through Chrome Digizoid, if it has a low purity.

Canoweissmon.name: Dragonia
Canoweissmon.text: Dragonia: Closes its wings and charges like a bullet of light. Using its tough claws, Dragonia can even deal with long distances.

Canoweissmon.name: Meteorax
Canoweissmon.text: Meteorax (Meteor ): The radiance from its spread wings rains down as a meteor shower.

Canoweissmon.name: Gran Nova
Canoweissmon.text: Gran Nova: It gathers all the energy in its body and fires the brightest fireball from its mouth, enveloping the enemy in a scorching-hot star, even if they are a Mega.

CaptainHookmon.name: Rage Giga Anchor
CaptainHookmon.text: Rage Giga Anchor: Expresses its intimidating air to its opponents just by holding up the Rage Giga Anchor.

CaptainHookmon.name: Pirate's Punisher
CaptainHookmon.text: Pirate's Punisher: Attacks with violent fighting styles that make free use of the Pirate's Punisher's steady-attack and gunfire functions.

CaptainHookmon.name: Leg Revolver
CaptainHookmon.text: Leg Revolver: Attacks with the Leg Revolver, which is suited for surprise attacks, but takes it upon itself to fire off a warning first.

Cargodramon.name: Suppression Strike
Cargodramon.text: Suppression Strike: Fires the Gatling gun attached to the front of its fuselage. This is used as a ground control measure while troops are being deployed.

Cargodramon.name: Slaughter Blade
Cargodramon.text: Slaughter Blade: Cuts opponents to pieces using the propellers on its wings. This maneuver may damage its propellers, and is only allowed to be used in emergencies.

CatchMamemon.name: Magic Arm
CatchMamemon.text: Magic Arm: Catches Digimon that would harm Digi-Eggs and changes them into stuffed animals with some strange power.

CatchMamemon.name: Miracle Bomb
CatchMamemon.text: Miracle Bomb: Turns caught Digimon into bombs when its slots show three 7s. It attacks with said bomb, whose power depends on the strength of the captured Digimon.

Caturamon.name: Howl of Power
Caturamon.text: Howl of Power ('): Generates a massive earthquake accompanied by a shock wave by striking the ground with the Bǎo Chuí.

Caturamon.name: Howl of the Heavens
Caturamon.text: Howl of the Heavens: Releases a supersonic howl that can shatter barriers.

Cendrillmon.name: Strike
Cendrillmon.text: Strike: Wields its rock-solid glass slippers as weapons and skewers its targets.

Cendrillmon.name: Noble Family Arts
Cendrillmon.text: Noble Family Arts: Dispatches its Familiars aboard a bomb resembling a horse-drawn pumpkin carriage as part of a self-sacrificing attack.

Cendrillmon.name: Prism Date Break
Cendrillmon.text: Prism Date Break: Transforms a large glass clock into a launcher, with the large clock adorning it firing a devastating laser beam allowing Cendrillmon to eliminate all prince candidates in the vicinity.

Centarumon.name: Solar Ray
Centarumon.text: Solar Ray (Hunting Cannon): Uses the Hunting Cannon, which has become one with its right arm. It is near impossible to evade this attack. However, because this attack expends a large amount of energy, Centarumon avoids battle whenever possible.

Centarumon.name: Energy Ray
Centarumon.text: Energy Ray: Fires a solar ball of light.

Cerberusmon.name: Portals of Darkness
Cerberusmon.text: Portals of Darkness (Inferno Gate): Opens a "Hell Gate" engraved in the earth, then casts the opponent through it to the jet-black Dark Area.

Cerberusmon.name: Emerald Blaze
Cerberusmon.text: Emerald Blaze (Hellfire): Spews a red-hot jet of flames.

Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.name: Inferno Divide
Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.text: Inferno Divide: Blast foes with firebombs at point blank range while it holds them in place, which it does by biting them with the massive heads on the ends of its arms.

Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.name: Cerberus Erase
Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.text: Cerberus Erase: Cuts down enemies using a combination of dynamic movements and the claws on its feet.

Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.name: Fire
Cerberusmon Werewolf Mode.text: Fire (Hellfire): Unleashes a blast of scorching, hellish flames to reduce any foe to ashes. The destructive power of this attack is on a whole other level compared to that of the unmutated Cerberusmon.

Cerberusmon X.name: Fire
Cerberusmon X.text: Fire (Hell Fire): A red-hot jet of flames.

Cerberusmon X.name: Inferno Gate
Cerberusmon X.text: Inferno Gate: Opens a "Hell Gate" engraved in the earth, then casts the opponent through it to the jet-black Dark Area.

Ceresmon.name: Island Freefall
Ceresmon.text: Island Freefall: Slams its huge body against the opponent, inflicting damage from the intense shock wave and vibrations around the area where it falls.

Ceresmon.name: Burning Blood Shell
Ceresmon.text: Burning Blood Shell: Fires a magma bodily fluid from its mouth as an enormous flame shot.

Ceresmon.name: Fruit Flechette
Ceresmon.text: Fruit Flechette: Scatters the unripe fruit from the "Karpos Hulē" over a wide range, transforming its surroundings into a land of death with that poison upon impact.

Ceresmon.name: Famis
Ceresmon.text: Famis (Famēs, ): Uses a terrifying technique that couldn't be imagined from its gentle appearance to freely manipulate plants and absorb all of the opponent's energy.

Ceresmon Medium.text: ([https://www.theoi.com/Georgikos/SatyrosPhales.html Phales]): Attacks the enemy with vines, poisoning them and draining them of their health.

Ceresmon Medium.name: Famis
Ceresmon Medium.text: Famis: Attacks the enemy with vines, sometimes poisoning them.

Cernumon.name: Celtic Bind
Cernumon.text: Celtic Bind: Renders its opponent unable to act by emitting an extremely loud, high-pitched horn sound.

Cernumon.name: Scatter
Cernumon.text: Scatter :  Waves its tail and shakes up the leaves to slice and dice its foe.

Chamblemon.name: Sweet Spore
Chamblemon.text: Sweet Spore (Sweepore): Releases spores that stick to any threats that carelessly approach it. The spores sprout into mushrooms that absorb the foe's vitality. If one picks and eat the fungi, they will find it brimming with energy. Among them, the most delicious is said to be the data-type mushrooms.

Chamblemon.name: Chamble Bomb
Chamblemon.text: Chamble Bomb (Champion Bomb): Releases mushroom-shaped explosives of many different sizes at once. The resulting fumes and spores will transform an area into a bed of mushrooms.

Chamelemon.name: Tongue Lashing
Chamelemon.text: Tongue Lashing (Tongue Whip): Attacks with its tongue.

Chaos Lord.name: Chaos Cannon
Chaos Lord.text: Chaos Cannon: Fires several energy blasts from its back cannons.

Chaos Lord.name: Pulse Blast
Chaos Lord.text: Pulse Blast (Shaking Pulse): Dolphmon's technique in which it fires ultrasonic waves from its back cannons.

ChaosBlackWarGreymon.name: Giga Blaster
ChaosBlackWarGreymon.text: Giga Blaster (Giga Destroyer): Fires a fish-shaped missile from in between its hands.

ChaosBlackWarGreymon.name: Terra Force
ChaosBlackWarGreymon.text: Terra Force (Gaia Force): Gathers all of the energy within the atmosphere and concentrates it into one spot, then fires it as a super-dense, high-temperature fireball energy shot.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Demons Disaster
ChaosGallantmon.text: Demons Disaster (Demon's Disaster): Strikes with a powerful barrage of attacks from the Balmung.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Chaos Crusher
ChaosGallantmon.text: Chaos Crusher: ( Prison): Fires a dark wave from the Gorgon which corrodes everything.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Spiral Wailer
ChaosGallantmon.text: Spiral Wailer: Attacks with its lance Balmung as lightning spirals about the blade.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Gallant Charge
ChaosGallantmon.text: Gallant Charge (Duke Charge): Charges its enemy with its glowing Balmung.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Falling Lance
ChaosGallantmon.text: Falling Lance: Drops down from the sky, stabbing with Balmung.

ChaosGallantmon.name: Shield Attack
ChaosGallantmon.text: Shield Attack: (Shield Destructor) Charges up and blasts the enemy with energy from Gorgon.

ChaosGallantmon C.name: Dark Hazard
ChaosGallantmon C.text: Dark Hazard: Unleashes darkness upon three zones, inflicting Paralyze.

ChaosGallantmon C.name: Call Leo
ChaosGallantmon C.text: Call Leo: Summons a lion to cut two zones twice.

ChaosGallantmon C.name: Crazy Ice Blast
ChaosGallantmon C.text: Crazy Ice Blast: Attack enemies in five zones with lots of ice arrows.

ChaosGallantmon C.name: Chaos Slash
ChaosGallantmon C.text: Chaos Slash: Slash two zones with the power of chaos, inflicting Confusion.

ChaosGallantmon C.name: AT Change
ChaosGallantmon C.text: AT Change: Changes own strengths and weaknesses.

ChaosGrimmon.name: Chrono DSR
ChaosGrimmon.text: Chrono DSR (Chrono Destruction): Degrades and destroys any data in the Digital World.

ChaosGrimmon.name: Call Leyner
ChaosGrimmon.text: Call Leyner (Call Rainer): Summons a poisonous rain.

ChaosGrimmon.name: Multi Gatling
ChaosGrimmon.text: Multi Gatling: Fires a continuous spray of fiery bullets.

ChaosGrimmon.name: Call Machines
ChaosGrimmon.text: Call Machines: Summons clouds of nanomachines to attack enemies.

ChaosGrimmon.name: Chaos Slash
ChaosGrimmon.text: Chaos Slash: (xx00x), Selectable, Dark Elemental, Confusion

ChaosGrimmon.name: Multi Gatling
ChaosGrimmon.text: Multi Gatling: (xx0xx), Selectable, Fire Elemental, 4x Hits

ChaosMetalSeadramon.name: Energy Blast
ChaosMetalSeadramon.text: Energy Blast (Ultimate Stream): Unleashes a devastating energy beam from its nose-cannon.

ChaosMetalSeadramon.name: Brown Stinger
ChaosMetalSeadramon.text: Brown Stinger (Deadly Sting): Flymon's technique. Can poison the enemy.

ChaosPiedmon.name: Trump Sword
ChaosPiedmon.text: Trump Sword: Teleports its four swords, causing them to skewer the opponent in the following instant.

ChaosPiedmon.name: Trump Sword II
ChaosPiedmon.text: Trump Sword II: Unsheathes the swords on its back and throws them at the opponent.

ChaosPiedmon.name: Mask's Square
ChaosPiedmon.text: Mask's Square: Unsheathes a black ball of energy from its hand and shoots them at the opponent.

Chaosdramon.name: Hyper Attack
Chaosdramon.text: Hyper Attack(Hyper ∞ Cannon): Fires a superdreadnought-class energy wave from its two artillery cannons.

Chaosdramon.name: Destroyed Hook
Chaosdramon.text: Destroyed Hook (Destroyed Harken): Shoots an organic missile from its right hand, that injects a virus on the victim, making them melt.

Chaosdramon.name: Chaos Crusher
Chaosdramon.text: Chaos Crusher: Smashes enemies into pieces with its powerful nails.

Chaosdramon X.name: Hyper Infinity Cannon
Chaosdramon X.text: Hyper Infinity Cannon.: Superdreadnought-class energy wave fired from its two artillery cannons.

Chaosdramon X.name: Chaos Crusher
Chaosdramon X.text: Chaos Crusher: Smashes enemies into pieces with its powerful nails.

Chaosdramon X.name: Super Eradication Attack
Chaosdramon X.text: Super Eradication Attack (Super Genocide Attack): Seizes the enemy with the "Chaos Crusher" on its right arm, breaks open their armor, and launches organic missiles stored in a portion of that arm at their insides.

Chaosmon.name: Dragon Slash
Chaosmon.text: Dragon Slash.: Unleashes an invincible decisive stroke from the Ban-Tyo Blade.

Chaosmon.name: Dark Prominence
Chaosmon.text: Dark Prominence: Fires off its own digital cells from the Gigastick Cannon.

Chaosmon.name: End of Paradox
Chaosmon.text: End of Paradox: Uses both hands to emit a ball of light.

Chaosmon.name: Ban-Tyo Blade
Chaosmon.text: Ban-Tyo Blade: Attacks using the Ban-Tyo Blade.

Chaosmon Valdur Arm.name: Bantyo Blade
Chaosmon Valdur Arm.text: Bantyo Blade: Unleashes an invincible decisive stroke from the BAN-TYO Blade.

Chaosmon Valdur Arm.name: Aurora Blaster
Chaosmon Valdur Arm.text: Aurora Blaster: Fires a purifying shot of light from its Valdur Arm.

Chaperomon.name: For You
Chaperomon.text: For You: Turns a bottle of  into a  and hurls it.

Chaperomon.name: Crimson Ripper
Chaperomon.text: Crimson Ripper: Chaperomon dances wildly and slashes away with its handheld knives as well as the ones attached to its feet.

Chaperomon.name: Mercy Basket
Chaperomon.text: Mercy Basket: Unleashes Gatling guns from its basket and fires an extravagant volley.

Chapmon.name: Foam Shower
Chapmon.text: Foam Shower: Spits bubbles from its mouth to confuse the opponent, then flees.

Cherrymon.name: Cherry Blast
Cherrymon.text: Cherry Blast (Cherry Bomb): Tempts the opponent with the fragrant smell of the forbidden fruit which grows from the branches on its head, but certain death awaits if this fruit is eaten.

Cherrymon.name: Vine Attack
Cherrymon.text: Vine Attack: Uses the vines growing from its body to attack an opponent.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Lightning Spear
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Lightning Spear: Fires a spear of lightning.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Storm of Judgment
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Storm of Judgment (Heaven's Judgment): Summons a giant thundercloud that looses innumerable thunderbolts on the opponent.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Terminal Judgment
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Terminal Judgment (Final Judgment): An enhanced version of Storm of Judgment which increases the range and density of the thunderbolts.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Thousand Spears
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Thousand Spears (Thousand Spear): An enhanced version of Lightning Spear which fires multiple spears of lightning.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Lightning Blast
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Lightning Blast: An enhanced version of Lightning Spear which greatly enlarges the spear fired.

Cherubimon (Evil).name: Cherubi Finger
Cherubimon (Evil).text: Cherubi Finger: Flicks the enemy with its finger.

Cherubimon (Evil) X.name: Lightning Spear
Cherubimon (Evil) X.text: Lightning Spear: Fires a spear of lightning.

Cherubimon (Evil) X.name: Heaven's Judgment
Cherubimon (Evil) X.text: Heaven's Judgment: Summons a gigantic thundercloud, then looses innumerable thunderbolts on the opponent.

Cherubimon (Evil) X.name: Darkness Prison
Cherubimon (Evil) X.text: Darkness Prison: Expands its globe of darkness, eternally trapping the consciousness of anyone who comes into contact with it in darkness.

Cherubimon (Good).name: Lightning Spear
Cherubimon (Good).text: Lightning Spear: Fires a spear of lightning.

Cherubimon (Good).name: Heaven's Judgement
Cherubimon (Good).text: Heaven's Judgement (Heaven's Judgment): Summons a gigantic thundercloud that looses innumerable thunderbolts on the opponent.

Cherubimon (Good) X.name: Lightning Spear
Cherubimon (Good) X.text: Lightning Spear: Fires a spear of lightning.

Cherubimon (Good) X.name: Heaven's Judgment
Cherubimon (Good) X.text: Heaven's Judgment: Summons a gigantic thundercloud, then looses innumerable thunderbolts on the opponent.

Cherubimon (Good) X.name: Shocking Hug
Cherubimon (Good) X.text: Shocking Hug: Sends a shock to Evil Digimon that Cherubimon has given up on while hugging them. Their evil spirit is replaced by light and they revert back into a Digi-Egg from which they will emerge as a good Digimon.

Chibomon.name: Frothy Spit
Chibomon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acidic bubbles with nonexistent power to attack.

Chicchimon.name: Sonic Chirp
Chicchimon.text: Sonic Chirp: Unleashes an ultrasonic cry that can even knock out a Rookie Digimon at point-blank range, then makes a quick escape to safety while its aggressor is stunned.

Chicchimon.name: Frothy Spit
Chicchimon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Chikurimon.name: Final Chikurimon
Chikurimon.text: Final Chikurimon: Sacrifices itself just as the name suggests, exploding itself together with the opponent.

Chirinmon.name: Wind Cutter Sword
Chirinmon.text: Wind Cutter Sword: Abruptly swoops from the skies and runs through the opponent with the horn on its head.

Chirinmon.name: Knowledge of Swift
Chirinmon.text: Knowledge of Swift: Uses its fast movements to unleash clones and confound the opponent.

Chirinmon.name: Holy Wave
Chirinmon.text: Holy Wave: Flaps its wings to fire off its aura, which guides even its opponents on the path to holiness.

Chiropmon.name: Paralyze Echo
Chiropmon.text: Paralyze Echo: Uses the ultrasonic waves emitted from its mouth to paralyze foes.

Chiropmon.name: Analyze Echo
Chiropmon.text: Analyze Echo: Uses the ultrasonic waves emitted from its mouth to survey its surroundings via echolocation.

Chiropmon.name: Curious Eyes
Chiropmon.text: Curious Eyes: "Sees" beyond the visible spectrum of light into ultraviolet and infrared, allowing it to perceive information that is normally invisible.

Chiropmon.name: Condensed Echo
Chiropmon.text: Condensed Echo: Compresses ultrasonic waves to their limit before releasing them in an offensive attack.

Cho-Hakkaimon.name: Home Run Blast
Cho-Hakkaimon.text: Home Run Blast: Swings the Roketto Dīng​pá with its acceleration at full-throttle, blowing the opponent into the distance.

Cho-Hakkaimon.name: Strike, Strike, Strike, Mince
Cho-Hakkaimon.text: Strike, Strike, Strike, Mince: Showers the opponent in a high-speed barrage using the Roketto Dīng​pá, crushing them appallingly flat.

Cho-Hakkaimon.name: Pig Roast
Cho-Hakkaimon.text: Pig Roast: Embraces the opponent with its body, which has burst into flames from the fury of its hunger, roasting them well-done.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Finger Bomb
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Finger Bomb: Forcibly restores the past data of a foe that Chronomon points at, causing them to explode from the colossal amount of data swelling within their body.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Holy Flare
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Holy Flare: Attacks with a holy flame that burns up those who try to maliciously distort spacetime, erasing even the fact they once existed.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Chrono Devolution
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Chrono Devolution: Converts the chronological data of the Digital World into energy and unleashes it, causing those it strikes to age in the blink of an eye, their data reduced to mere debris. In Digimon Story: Time Stranger, it manipulates time to reduce opponents to their lowest level.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Corona
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Corona: Immolates all zones in fire.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Gusty Blade
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Gusty Blade (Wind Blade): Slices one zone with a wind blade.

Chronomon Destroy Mode.name: Vanishing Touch
Chronomon Destroy Mode.text: Vanishing Touch (Dark Vanish): Devastates three zones with dark energy.

Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).name: Confusion unto Despair
Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).text: Confusion unto Despair: Charges up a massive amount of energy between its hands and from its shoulder cannons, before firing dozens of highly devastating beams from across its entire body.

Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).name: Chrono Devolution
Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).text: Chrono Devolution: Forces enemy Digimon to de-digvolve to the Fresh Level.

Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).name: Rejection of All Order
Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).text: Rejection of All Order: Generates a barrier that greatly reduces all incoming damage.

Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).name: Mournful Torrent
Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).text: Mournful Torrent: Shoots water out of one of its shoulder mouths.

Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).name: Future Denied
Chronomon Destroy Mode (Robot).text: Future Denied: Roars, lowering the enemies Intelligence and Spirit. It also confuses them.

Chronomon Holy Mode.name: Holy Flare
Chronomon Holy Mode.text: Holy Flare: Attacks with a holy flame that burns up those who try to maliciously distort spacetime, erasing even the fact they once existed.

Chronomon Holy Mode.name: Crop
Chronomon Holy Mode.text: Crop: Attacks with a single impenetrable blow in which it wields its wings like blades and severs the opponent along with their spacetime.

Chrysalimon.name: Data Crusher
Chrysalimon.text: Data Crusher: Destroys the opponent's configuration data with the tentacles extending from its back.
