Devitamamon.text: Black Death Cloud: Destroys data with a gas of darkness.

DexDorugamon.name: Cannonball
DexDorugamon.text: Cannonball: Fires a large iron sphere from its mouth while charging.

DexDorugamon.name: Metal Cast
DexDorugamon.text: Metal Cast: Impales the opponent with its steel arms and rips out their DigiCore. In Digimon Masters it attacks with its sharp front claws and violently bites the enemy.

DexDorugoramon.name: Metal Impulse
DexDorugoramon.text: Metal Impulse: Destroys and blasts away everything of an enemy but its DigiCore.

DexDorugoramon.name: DORU-Din
DexDorugoramon.text: DORU-Din (DORU Din): Releases a destructive shock wave. The attack is identical to Dorugoramon's version of the attack but with one difference, DexDorugoramon's version is completely silent.

Dexmon.name: Process ""
Dexmon.text: Process "": The first of a set of perpetually repeating processes which disassemble and reassemble the DigiCores of its opponents.

Dexmon.name: Process ""
Dexmon.text: Process "": The last of a set of perpetually repeating processes which disassemble and reassemble the DigiCores of its opponents.

Diaboromon.name: Web Wrecker
Diaboromon.text: Web Wrecker (Catastrophe Cannon): Fires a powerful shot of destructive energy from its chest-cannon.

Diaboromon.name: Lost Paradise
Diaboromon.text: Lost Paradise (Paradise Lost): Uses all the power in its body to hit the enemy.

Diaboromon.name: Cable Crusher
Diaboromon.text: Cable Crusher: Stretches its arms and launches its huge clawed hands to slash or grab the enemy.

Diaboromon.name: Tentacle Bug
Diaboromon.text: Tentacle Bug: Stabs the enemy with its claw.

Diaboromon.name: Line Surge
Diaboromon.text: Line Surge: Spreads both of its arms outwards and spins in place.

Diaboromon X.name: Catastrophe Cannon
Diaboromon X.text: Catastrophe Cannon: Fires a powerful shot of destructive energy from its chest-cannon.

Diaboromon X.name: Spooky Zapper
Diaboromon X.text: Spooky Zapper: Rotates its body like a spinning top, and tears the enemy to pieces with its enormous claws and hidden arms.

Diaboromon X.name: Fatal Gaze
Diaboromon X.text: Fatal Gaze: Absorbs the data of enemies that gaze at the twelve eyes all over its body.

Diaboromon X.name: Rewind Abyss 13
Diaboromon X.text: Rewind Abyss 13: Rewind Abyss 13 is invoked when it opens its hidden thirteenth eye, and is the vilest, most wicked spell that causes Digimon to forcibly degenerate at the end of the countdown.

Dianamon.name: Crescent Harken
Dianamon.text: Crescent Harken (): Bewitches an illusion with the mysterious power of the moon, so that the opponent sees itself as its own enemy and immediately carves itself to pieces.

Dianamon.name: Arrow of
Dianamon.text: Arrow of : Pulls a faintly sparkling arrow of ice from the quill-like protuberances on its back, then fires it.
Lures the opponent into sleep with the lunar light emitted from the Goodnight Sisters.

Diarbbitmon.name: Advance
Diarbbitmon.text: Advance (Trusgain): Uses its superlative swordsmanship to cut its foes down.

Diarbbitmon.name: Twin Spear Pursuit
Diarbbitmon.text: Twin Spear Pursuit (Buidhedearg): Summons twin magical spears to pursue its foes.

Diarbbitmon.name: Buck Rush
Diarbbitmon.text: Buck Rush (Backstlash): Surrounds its enemy with afterimages that slice their target from all directions, leaving their enemy with no path of retreat.

Diatrymon.name: Mega Dash Impact
Diatrymon.text: Mega Dash Impact: Performs a tempestuous ramming attack.

Diatrymon.name: Destruction Roar
Diatrymon.text: Destruction Roar: Unleashes a gigantic roar which does extensive damage.

Diatrymon.name: Blast Shot
Diatrymon.text: Blast Shot: Sends ballistic waves and attacks.

Digitamamon.name: Hyper Flashing
Digitamamon.text: Hyper Flashing (Enigma): Attacks with mysterious power.

Digitamamon.name: Nightmare Syndrome
Digitamamon.text: Nightmare Syndrome: Sends out its true form as a black ghost.

Digitamamon.name: Double Nightmare Syndrome
Digitamamon.text: Double Nightmare Syndrome: Fires powerful nightmare energy alongside Tapirmon.

Digmon.name: Gold Rush
Digmon.text: Gold Rush: Fires its drills at the opponent.

Digmon.name: Rock Cracking
Digmon.text: Rock Cracking (Big Crack): Rams its drills in the ground and generates a fissure.

Dijiangmon.name: Wicked Spiral
Dijiangmon.text: Wicked Spiral: Uses its long tail to create a shockwave that sends its opponents flying.

Dijiangmon.name: Cursed Impact
Dijiangmon.text: Cursed Impact: Uses its extendable and retractable arms to throw the enemy down from the heavens.

Dijiangmon.name: Chaotic Void
Dijiangmon.text: Chaotic Void Pseudo-void"}}: Opens the zipper on its body and pulls its target inside, never to be seen again, to somewhere even it doesn't know.
Lowers the opponents Attack and Defense if it is healthy, or increases its own Attack and Defense if it is weakened.

Dimetromon.name: Luminous Heat
Dimetromon.text: Luminous Heat: Charge its dorsal fin with energy, then amplifies that energy and spits it out as a heat ray.

Dimetromon.name: Sailing Spin
Dimetromon.text: Sailing Spin: Utilizes its speed by springing into the air, spinning, and attacks foes with its energized fin. This move can tear clean through stone.

Dinobeemon.name: Hell Masquerade
Dinobeemon.text: Hell Masquerade: Performs the "Dance of Hell" in which its nimble movements leave behind afterimages while it chops up the opponent.

Dinohyumon.name: Lizard Dance
Dinohyumon.text: Lizard Dance: Slices into foes with the blades on its arms and Akinakes while seeming to dance.

Dinohyumon.name: Dino Slash
Dinohyumon.text: Dino Slash: Slashes with the power of a dragon.

Dinomon.name: Burning End
Dinomon.text: Burning End: Brings down its enemy to ash with its flame-laden claws.

Dinomon.name: Dino Breath
Dinomon.text: Dino Breath: Releases light from its body surface and dorsal fins, incinerating everything in waves of super-intense heat.

Dinorexmon.name: Splatter Hunting
Dinorexmon.text: Splatter Hunting: Seizes and kills the opponent with its talons.

Dinorexmon.name: Ogre Flame
Dinorexmon.text: Ogre Flame: Fires extremely high-temperature grenades from its mouth, which have a semi-fluid form similar to magma and burn down their surroundings even if they don't hit the opponent.

Dinotigermon.name: Ground Fang
Dinotigermon.text: Ground Fang: Pins down the enemy, then stabs and tears through them with its fangs.

Dinotigermon.name: Highland Fang
Dinotigermon.text: Highland Fang: Swings down its fangs from an elevation, instantly cutting them to pieces.

Divemon.name: Blade
Divemon.text: Blade: Slashes the enemy with the sharp fins all over its body.

Divemon.name: Ripple Edge
Divemon.text: Ripple Edge: Hurls pressurized water like a blade.

Divemon.name: Liquid Veil
Divemon.text: Liquid Veil: When Divemon is active on land it envelops itself in water armor which enhances its physical ability. As a result, even in places without water, it is able to exhibit the same strength as when it is underwater.

Divermon.name: Striking Fish
Divermon.text: Striking Fish (Strike Fishing): Stabs the enemy with the Trent.

Divermon.name: Abyss Dive
Divermon.text: Abyss Dive (Hell Dive): Jumps high into the sky to dive at an opponent.

Dobermon.name: Grau Lärm
Dobermon.text: Grau Lärm (): Seals the opponent's abilities with a howl.

Dobermon.name: Schwarz Strahl
Dobermon.text: Schwarz Strahl (): Pierces the opponent's body with a black beam and destroys its DigiCore.

Dobermon X.name: Grau Lärm
Dobermon X.text: Grau Lärm (): Seals the opponent's abilities with a howl.

Dobermon X.name: Schwarz Strahl
Dobermon X.text: Schwarz Strahl (): Pierces the opponent's body with a black beam and destroys its DigiCore.

Dodomon.name: Chīsana Tetsu Tsubu
Dodomon.text: Chīsana Tetsu Tsubu: Spits small iron beads from its mouth at an approaching opponent.

Doggymon.name: Howling
Doggymon.text: Howling: Lets out a great howl, inflicting damage to the opponent's sense of hearing and making them lose their fighting spirit.

Doggymon.name: Ultra Snap
Doggymon.text: Ultra Snap: Snaps at the opponent with its sharp fangs.

Doggymon.name: Mega Chomp
Doggymon.text: Mega Chomp: Bites the enemy with his sharp fangs.

Doggymon.name: Jesting Howl
Doggymon.text: Jesting Howl: Releases a sonic howl.

Doggymon.name: Quick Shot
Doggymon.text: Quick Shot: Throws red spherical bombs at his enemies.

Dokimon.name: Static Shock
Dokimon.text: Static Shock: When it is in danger, it threatens the enemy with static electricity emitted from the tip of its horn.

Dokugumon.name: Poison Cobweb
Dokugumon.text: Poison Cobweb (Stinger Poration): Fires a poisonous blast from its mouth.

Dokugumon.name: Poison Thread
Dokugumon.text: Poison Thread (Arachno ): Shoots a web from its spinnerets.

Dokugumon.name: Poison Sting
Dokugumon.text: Poison Sting: Attacks with a sharp poisonous needle.

Dokugumon.name: Spider Machine Gun
Dokugumon.text: Spider Machine Gun: Shoots  at the enemy.

Dokunemon.name: Electric Thread
Dokunemon.text: Electric Thread: Fires an electric thread from its mouth.

Dokunemon.name: Worm Venom
Dokunemon.text: Worm Venom: Jumps and scatters a  from its beak that paralyzes the enemy. In Digimon Digital Card Battle it stings the foe with its poisonous tail.

Dokunemon.name: Bug Shower
Dokunemon.text: Bug Shower (Insect Horde): Summons a swarm of digital bees to sting the foe.

Dokunemon.name: Capturing Net
Dokunemon.text: Capturing Net (Capture Net): Attacks by radiating light.

Dokunemon.name: Poison Ride
Dokunemon.text: Poison Ride: Charges and then stabs the enemy with the horn on its tail.

Dolphmon.name: Pulse Blast
Dolphmon.text: Pulse Blast (Shaking Pulse): Emits the ultrasonic waves from its mouth that it uses to communicate, just at maximum power.

Dolphmon.name: Water Wave
Dolphmon.text: Water Wave: Attacks with a big tsunami.

Dominimon.name: Final
Dominimon.text: Final : Pierces enemies with a blade of energy that manifests on its arm.

Dominimon.name: Zero Heavens
Dominimon.text: Zero Heavens: Fires superhot lasers in every direction from the shields on its shoulders.

Dominimon.name: Field
Dominimon.text: Field: Emanates a holy aura from its entire body, sacrificing some of its own lifeforce to grant power to nearby angelic Digimon.

DonShoutmon.name: Kankon Midare Daiko
DonShoutmon.text: Kankon Midare Daiko: Battles while spinning a tune with a unique rhythm.

DonShoutmon.name: Rowdy Drummer
DonShoutmon.text: Rowdy Drummer: Battles while spinning a tune with a unique rhythm.

Dondokomon.name: Dondoko March
Dondokomon.text: Dondoko March}}: Resounds a rhythm which raises the tension between friend and foe alike, and there isn't anything that will settle the commotion.

Dondokomon.name: Dondoko Rush
Dondokomon.text: Dondoko Rush: Randomly fires shock waves.

Dorbickmon.name: Dragon's Fury Blade
Dorbickmon.text: Dragon's Fury Blade (Tyrant ): Attacks with a flaming sword formed from the anger it works up in battle, whose power depends on the strength of its fury.

Dorbickmon.name: Burning the Dragon
Dorbickmon.text: Burning the Dragon: Stabs a  within the land, modifying the terrain and inflicting damage on groups of enemies.

Dorbickmon.name: Dragon Infernal Fire
Dorbickmon.text: Dragon Infernal Fire (Dragon Breath-tonic Fire): Exhales a burst of extremely high-temperature breath that instantly reduces anything it touches to ashes.

Dorbickmon Darkness Mode One.name: Dragon Infernal Fire
Dorbickmon Darkness Mode One.text: Dragon Infernal Fire (Dragon Breath-tonic Fire): Exhales a burst of extremely high-temperature breath that instantly reduces anything it touches to ashes.

Dorbickmon Darkness Mode Two.name: Dragon's Fury Blade
Dorbickmon Darkness Mode Two.text: Dragon's Fury Blade (Tyrant ): Attacks with a flaming sword formed from the anger it works up in battle, whose power depends on the strength of its fury.

Dorbickmon Darkness Mode Two.name: Dragon Infernal Fire
Dorbickmon Darkness Mode Two.text: Dragon Infernal Fire (Dragon Breath-tonic Fire): Exhales a burst of extremely high-temperature breath that instantly reduces anything it touches to ashes.

Dorimon.name: Metal Drop
Dorimon.text: Metal Drop: Spits an iron bead from mouth while charging at the opponent.

Dorimon.name: Frothy Spit
Dorimon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

DoruGreymon.name: Metal Meteor
DoruGreymon.text: Metal Meteor: Fires a supermassive iron sphere more than ten times its own size, crushing the opponent in one hit.

DoruGreymon.name: Bloody Tower
DoruGreymon.text: Bloody Tower: Skewers the opponent before flinging them up into the sky.

Dorugamon.name: Cannonball
Dorugamon.text: Cannonball: Fires a large iron sphere from its mouth while charging.

Dorugamon.name: Fighting Spirit
Dorugamon.text: Fighting Spirit (Power Metal): Stands still and accumulates power, then fires a large, more powerful iron sphere from its mouth.

Dorugoramon.name: Supreme Courage
Dorugoramon.text: Supreme Courage (Brave Metal): Puts its body and soul into a terrifying assault.

Dorugoramon.name: Doru Djinn
Dorugoramon.text: Doru Djinn (DORU Din): Releases a destructive shock wave.

Dorulumon.name: Drill Bit Blitz
Dorulumon.text: Drill Bit Blitz (Drill Buster): Rotates the drill on its head and then shoots it with unerring accuracy.

Dorulumon.name: Drill Tornado
Dorulumon.text: Drill Tornado (Dorulu Tornado): Enlarges the drill on its tail and then raises a tornado, threatening both ground-based and aerial opponents.

Dorulumon.name: Spiro-Drill
Dorulumon.text: Spiro-Drill (Drill Blader): Rides the drill on its tail and spins itself, striking the opponent with its body until it is pulverized.

Dorulumon.name: Claw Scratch
Dorulumon.text: Claw Scratch: Scratches the enemy with a forepaw.

Dorulumon.name: Jumping Claw Scratch
Dorulumon.text: Jumping Claw Scratch: Leaps at the enemy and slashes them with its forepaw.

Dorulumon.name: Charge
Dorulumon.text: Charge: Leaps at the enemy and knocks them upwards with its horn.

Dorulumon (Starmons).name: Drill Tornado
Dorulumon (Starmons).text: Drill Tornado: Spins its tail fast enough for limited flight capabilities.

Dorumon.name: Dash Metal
Dorumon.text: Dash Metal: Fires an iron sphere from its mouth while charging.

Dorumon.name: Metal Cannon
Dorumon.text: Metal Cannon: Stands still and accumulates power, then fires a more powerful iron sphere from its mouth.

Dorumon.name: Hyper Dash Metal
Dorumon.text: Hyper Dash Metal: A strong tackle with even higher speed.

Dorumon.name: Metal Shoot
Dorumon.text: Metal Shoot: Emits a small blast from the mouth.

Dorumon.name: Beast Attack
Dorumon.text: Beast Attack: Attacks with a swift blow of a powerful beast.

DotAgumon.name: Fire Ball
DotAgumon.text: Fire Ball: Sets off a blast with balls of fire.

DotFalcomon.name: Boom Bubble
DotFalcomon.text: Boom Bubble (Air Shot): Attacks by sending a small ball of air.

DotMirageGaogamon.name: Gale Claw
DotMirageGaogamon.text: Gale Claw: Slashes with quick claws.

DotShineGreymon.name: Glorious Burst
DotShineGreymon.text: Glorious Burst: Burns with fireballs released from its wings.

Doumon.name: Exorcism Scrolls
Doumon.text: Exorcism Scrolls: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

Doumon.name: Hidden Gate Divination
Doumon.text: Hidden Gate Divination|lit. "Demonic Gate, Hidden Jia"}}: Chants an incantation while painting a barrier in the form of the  character  in the air with its gigantic brush, confining the opponent in an eternal labyrinth from which it can never escape.

Dracmon.name: Eye of Nightmare
Dracmon.text: Eye of Nightmare: Casts a spell from the s on the palms of its hands which causes those who look into it to have their hearts completely dominated by Dracmon.

Dracmon.name: Undead Fang
Dracmon.text: Undead Fang: Attacks by biting with its fangs.

Dracmon.name: Demi Dart
Dracmon.text: Demi Dart (Pico Darts): Attacks with syringes of darkness.

Dracomon.name: Baby Breath
Dracomon.text: Baby Breath: Breathes out a high temperature sigh at the opponent.

Dracomon.name: Tail Smasher
Dracomon.text: Tail Smasher (Tail Smash): Spins its whole body to deliver a blow with its tail.

Dracomon.name: Great Strike
Dracomon.text: Great Strike: Makes the horns on its head glow intensely, then fires a beam shot from the back of its mouth.

Dracomon X.name: Baby Breath
Dracomon X.text: Baby Breath: Breathes out a high temperature sigh at the opponent.

Dracomon X.name: Tail Smash
Dracomon X.text: Tail Smash: Spins its whole body to deliver a blow with its tail.

Dracomon X.name: Great Strike
Dracomon X.text: Great Strike: Makes the horns on its head glow intensely, then fires a beam shot from the back of its mouth.

Dracomon X.name: Baby Blaze
Dracomon X.text: Baby Blaze: Attacks enemies over a vast range by letting the flames that it spews out from its mouth be carried by the wind.

Dracomon X.name: Smash Horn
Dracomon X.text: Smash Horn: Charges at the enemy with those ultra-high temperature horns. The power of its "Smash Horn" appears to greatly surpass that of the Rookie level.

Dragomon.name: Forbidden Trident
Dragomon.text: Forbidden Trident: Throws its trident with tremendous physical strength.

Dragomon.name: Thousand Whips
Dragomon.text: Thousand Whips (Thousand Whip): Unleashes numerous tentacles at an opponent.

Drimogemon.name: Drill Spin
Drimogemon.text: Drill Spin: Attacks the enemy with its gigantic drill.

Drimogemon.name: Bone Crusher
Drimogemon.text: Bone Crusher (Crusher Bone): Throws the bone it stole from Garurumon.

Dullahamon.name: Edge
Dullahamon.text: Edge: Swings its head like a flail to deliver a barrage of strikes.
Drags enemies into a floating coffin using a spectral hand, then desconstructs their physical data and assimilates them into the mass of spirits that enshrouds it.

Duramon.name: Blinded
Duramon.text: Blinded (Brinded): Fires a beam attack from its chest, which deals massive damage and carves a '20' mark into the enemy if it lands a direct hit.

Duramon.name: Glass Rush
Duramon.text: Glass Rush (Grass-Slash): Slices the enemy with the blades on both arms.

Durandamon.name: Zwei Glänze
Durandamon.text: Zwei Glänze () (Zwanglänze, ): Focuses its fighting spirit into the blades on both arms and slices the enemy with them.

Durandamon.name: Thron Messer
Durandamon.text: Thron Messer (): Spins its body to slice multiple enemies in one fell swoop.

Duskmon.name: Deadly Gaze
Duskmon.text: Deadly Gaze (Geist Abend, ): Emits shining energy from the eyes all over its body and the mouths on its arms, placing the opponent under hypnosis.

Duskmon.name: Lunar Plasma
Duskmon.text: Lunar Plasma (Eroberung, ): Slashes a full moon-like arc with the Blut Evolution, absorbing the opponent's power and making it its own.

Duskmon.name: Gedächtnisstörung
Duskmon.text: Gedächtnisstörung (): Shifts through the memories of its target.

Duskmon.name: Brute Strike
Duskmon.text: Brute Strike (Blut Strike, ): Charges its foe with the "Blut Evolution" swords.

Duskmon.name: Death Gaze
Duskmon.text: Death Gaze: Fires beams from all the eyes on its armor.

Duskmon.name: Ghost Move
Duskmon.text: Ghost Move: Teleports toward its foes.

Dynasmon.name: DNA Disintegrator
Dynasmon.text: DNA Disintegrator (Dragon's Roar): Fires energy shots from the palms of its hands, with all the attributes of the Ten Legendary Warriors. In Digimon Frontier, it can also charge energy in its palms and then physically strike a foe repeatedly.

Dynasmon.name: Breath of Wyvern
Dynasmon.text: Breath of Wyvern: Transforms its body's energy into an aura of a gigantic wyvern. In Digimon Frontier, it is so powerful that Dynasmon cannot fully control it.

Dynasmon.name: Dragon Collider
Dynasmon.text: Dragon Collider: The strongest technique from among the Royal Knights.

Dynasmon X.name: Wyvern's Breath
Dynasmon X.text: Wyvern's Breath (Breath of Wyvern): Transforms its body's energy into an aura of a gigantic wyvern.

Dynasmon X.name: Dragon's Gust
Dynasmon X.text: Dragon's Gust: Thrusts the gigantic horns on its head, soars, and then charges at the enemy with its body, leading it to being the most skilful among the Royal Knights in aerial combat.

Dynasmon X.name: Dragon's Roar
Dynasmon X.text: Dragon's Roar: Fires energy shots from the palms of its hands, with all the attributes of the Ten Legendary Warriors.

Eaglemon.name: Phoenix
Eaglemon.text: Phoenix: Performs a ramming attack with its  body.

Eaglemon.name: Mystic Break
Eaglemon.text: Mystic Break: Fires a white ray which reduces the opponent to ash.

Ebemon.name: Crusher Bone
Ebemon.text: Crusher Bone (Brain Rupture): Fires a cracking program into the opponent's brain with the gun it holds in its left hand, then absorbs all the data stored in their brain.

Ebemon.name: Neuro Destroyer
Ebemon.text: Neuro Destroyer (Planet Destroyer): Releases all of its accumulated power and fires off a shot from the gun in its right hand that is said to be able to instantly destroy a single planet.

Ebemon X.name: Brain Rupture
Ebemon X.text: Brain Rupture: Fires a cracking program into the opponent's brain with the gun it holds in its left hand, then absorbs all the data stored in their brain.

Ebemon X.name: Planet Destroyer
Ebemon X.text: Planet Destroyer: Releases all of its accumulated power and fires off a shot from the gun in its right hand that is said to be able to instantly destroy a single planet.

EbiBurgamon.name: Fresh Shrimp
EbiBurgamon.text: Fresh Shrimp: Produces a smell savory enough to stop the opponent in their tracks.

EbiBurgamon.name: Hot Cutlet
EbiBurgamon.text: Hot Cutlet: Produces a smell savory enough to stop the opponent in their tracks.

Ebidramon.name: Twin Scissors
Ebidramon.text: Twin Scissors (Twin Neptune): Swoops down on the opponent with its two pincers.

Ebidramon.name: Water Wave
Ebidramon.text: Water Wave: Attacks with a big tsunami.

Ebonwumon.name: Mugen
Ebonwumon.text: Mugen: Displays an illusion which generates a dark mist around the opponent, destroying their spirit.

Ekakimon.name: Colorful Change
Ekakimon.text: Colorful Change: Its attacks turn fire-elemental when red is used, water-elemental when blue is used, grass-elemental when green is used, and so on and so forth.

Ekakimon.name: Mini Mini Ekakimon
Ekakimon.text: Mini Mini Ekakimon: Draws tiny Ekakimon and causes them to materialize into Mini Mini Ekakimon, which it will order around like henchmen to fight the opponent.

Ekakimon.name: Ekakikaki
Ekakimon.text: Ekakikaki: Licks a drawing and brings it to life.

ElDradimon.name: Golden Road
ElDradimon.text: Golden Road: Charges the opponent with its large body and breaks through, even if it suffers an attack in the process.

ElDradimon.name: Meteor Earthquake
ElDradimon.text: Meteor Earthquake: Strikes with its gigantic foot, shaking the earth itself.

ElDradimon.name: Giant Nipper
ElDradimon.text: Giant Nipper: Bites through the opponent with the power of its mighty jaws.

Elecmon.name: Super Thunder Strike
Elecmon.text: Super Thunder Strike (Sparkling Thunder): Shoots electric bolts from its tails.

Elecmon.name: Nine Tails
Elecmon.text: Nine Tails: Smacks foe with its electrically-charged tails.

Elecmon.name: Lightning Knife
Elecmon.text: Lightning Knife (Thunder Knife): Stealthily releases three knives of electricity.

Elecmon (Violet).name: Jamming Thunder
Elecmon (Violet).text: Jamming Thunder: Shoots electric bolts from its tails.

Elecmon (Violet).name: Dark Tail
Elecmon (Violet).text: Dark Tail (Tail's Tusk): Smacks foe with its electrically-charged tails.

Elecmon (Violet).name: Assassin Bolt
Elecmon (Violet).text: Assassin Bolt (Assassin's Bolt): Stealthily releases three darts of electricity.

Elephantmon.name: Turbine Wave
Elephantmon.text: Turbine Wave (Nitro Turbine Wave): Vertically raises the turbines on both of its ears, spinning them at maximum output, and then generates a shock wave on the same level as a huge typhoon.

Elizamon.name: Frilled Cutter
Elizamon.text: Frilled Cutter: Rotates its collar at an intense speed to slice up the enemy.

Elizamon.name: Helicop-Tail
Elizamon.text: Helicop-Tail: Uses its spinning collar to glide at low altitudes, before harnessing its own momentum to attack foes with its tail.

EmperorGreymon.name: Dragonfire Crossbow
EmperorGreymon.text: Dragonfire Crossbow: Fires arrows from the Ryūgonken, whose flames are so intense that they become a white light.

EmperorGreymon.name: Pyro Dragons
EmperorGreymon.text: Pyro Dragons: Releases the eight dragon's veins dwelling within Gaia, then becomes the final dragon itself and pulverizes the opponent with the Ryūgonken.

EmperorGreymon.name: Rengokukenbu
EmperorGreymon.text: Rengokukenbu: Performs a dashing lunge with the Ryūgonken.

Enbarrmon.name: Dead Angle Horn
Enbarrmon.text: Dead Angle Horn (Disrange Horn): Charges out of the sky as if appearing from its foe's blind spot.

Enbarrmon.name: Vain Answer
Enbarrmon.text: Vain Answer: Counters its adversary's attacks with mighty blows from its hind legs.

Enmamon.text: Swings its ritual baton downward to conjure a giant fist of hellfire above its target, which it then brings crashing down on the target's head.

Entmon.name: Dryad Stinger
Entmon.text: Dryad Stinger: Skewers the enemy with its sharp stake-like tusk.

Entmon.name: Blasted Disaster
Entmon.text: Blasted Disaster: Spews a dark miasma which completely withers the opponent's body. The true form of the miasma is countless tiny insects that turn a Digimon's data into nourishment.

Eosmon (Champion).name: Mirror Guard
Eosmon (Champion).text: Mirror Guard: Spreads its transparent, panel-shaped wings to protect itself or the target.

Eosmon (Champion).name: Mirror Dust
Eosmon (Champion).text: Mirror Dust: Detaches its transparent, panel-shaped wings and sends them flying at the enemy.

Eosmon (Champion).name: Bolt Rip
Eosmon (Champion).text: Bolt Rip: Mixes its scales with electric shocks gathered in its palms and fires them at the enemy.

Eosmon (Mega).name: Aurora Stream
Eosmon (Mega).text: Aurora Stream: A beam fired from its chest.

Eosmon (Mega).name: Cutting Edge
Eosmon (Mega).text: Cutting Edge: Teleports and slashes the enemy.

Eosmon (Mega).name: Cruelty Rain
Eosmon (Mega).text: Cruelty Rain: Enlarges the panels protecting it, causing them to rain down over the enemy, crushing them.

Eosmon (Ultimate).name: Beat Press
Eosmon (Ultimate).text: Beat Press: Crushes the enemy with its gigantic hands.

Eosmon (Ultimate).name: Hexa-thunder
Eosmon (Ultimate).text: Hexa-thunder: Unleashes an electric attack from its antennae.

Eosmon (Ultimate).name: Cutting Edge
Eosmon (Ultimate).text: Cutting Edge: Throws panel-shaped energy in its hands to slash the enemy.

Erlangmon.text: Swings its sanjian-liangrendao around its own body to perform a circular slice that takes out surrounding enemies in one blow.
Summons Kotenken to chomp on an enemy's DigiCore.

Erlangmon Blast Mode.text: Surges concentrated energy out of its third eye to blast clean through foes.
Observes movements in an enemy's body and soul to deduce all manner of behavioral patterns and subsequently foresee all attacks.

Espimon.name: Bomb
Espimon.text: Bomb: Fires a self-propulsive automatically-detonating explosive that it can use as a decoy if the circumstances require it. In Digimon Dreamers, the explosive resembles Botamon. In the ' and Digimon Ghost Game, they resemble mice.

Espimon.name: Divanish
Espimon.text: Divanish: Presses the switch on its stomach to enable camouflage completely blending into its surroundings so it can avoid detection and do reconnaissance.

Etemon.name: Concert Crush
Etemon.text: Concert Crush (Love Serenade): Breaks the opponent's heart and makes their fighting spirit vanish.

Etemon.name: Dark Network
Etemon.text: Dark Network (Dark Spirits): Attacks with a dark sphere that consumes everything it touches.

Etemon.name: Monkey Kick
Etemon.text: Monkey Kick (Monkick): Attacks with a strong hard kick.

Etemon.name: Dark Musical
Etemon.text: Dark Musical: Sings a song that is totally off-key.

Etemon (Chaos).name: Dark Spirits
Etemon (Chaos).text: Dark Spirits: Throws a dark sphere at the opponent.

Etemon (Chaos).name: Dark Spirits Chaos
Etemon (Chaos).text: Dark Spirits Chaos: Throws a dark sphere at the opponent.

Evil Grademon.name: Cross Blade
Evil Grademon.text: Cross Blade: Cuts the opponent apart crosswise with the godly speed of its sword.

ExMaquinamon.text: Forcibly fuses disparate elements into one. This can be used for a wide range of techniques, such as impacting data streams from its left and right hands to trigger explosions, or forcibly fusing incompatible data with an enemy to trigger damage as that data is then rejected by the host.

ExTyrannomon.name: Pretty Attack
ExTyrannomon.text: Pretty Attack: Uses its cute plush body to fight.

ExTyrannomon.name: Black Matter
ExTyrannomon.text: Black Matter: The Digimon within ExTyrannomon unleashes an evil orb.

ExVeemon.name: Vee-Laser
ExVeemon.text: Vee-Laser (X-Laser): Emits an energy wave from the "X" pattern on its chest.

ExVeemon.name: Critical Crunch
ExVeemon.text: Critical Crunch (Strong Crunch): Attacks with a powerful biting technique.

ExVeemon.name: Hearty Shatter
ExVeemon.text: Hearty Shatter: Shoots a large fireball from its mouth.

ExVeemon.name: Combination
ExVeemon.text: Combination: A combination attack consisting of a punch, two kicks, and an elbow drop.

ExVeemon.name: Spinning Lariat
ExVeemon.text: Spinning Lariat: Spins around, hitting the enemy with both arms.

Examon.name: 's Gate
Examon.text: 's Gate: Pierces its foes with Ambrose, blasting all of the lance's special bullets into them to destroy them from the inside.

Examon.name: 's Glory
Examon.text: 's Glory: Shoots up into the  and unleashes a powerful laser beam from Ambrose.

Examon.name: Dragonic Impact
Examon.text: Dragonic Impact: Plunges down from the exosphere to slam into foes while its body is still hot from friction generated by its reentry into the atmosphere. It is accompanied by a shockwave, so it can sometimes wipe out huge numbers of foes across a wide area.

Examon.name: Ambrose Strike
Examon.text: Ambrose Strike: Impales the enemy with its tail and flings them before charging and stabbing them with Ambrose.

Examon.name: Caledfwlch Dive
Examon.text: Caledfwlch Dive: Dives into the enemy.

Examon X.name: 's Gate
Examon X.text: 's Gate: Stabs the opponent with the Ambrose (Ambrosius) and explodes all of its special shells, annihilating them from within.

Examon X.name: 's Glory
Examon X.text: 's Glory: Rockets up to the  and conducts a high-powered laser firing.

Examon X.name: Dragonic Impact
Examon X.text: Dragonic Impact: Dives from the exosphere and performs a ramming attack shrouded in heat from friction with the atmosphere, mopping up swaths of enemies with the accompanying shock wave.

Examon X.name: Thunder Sword Bureiragaha
Examon X.text: Thunder Sword Bureiragaha: Twelve Thunder Sword Bureiragaha appear from the lightning that falls from its Dragonic Plasma which it fires at the enemy.

Examon X.name: Pendragon Sparkle
Examon X.text: Pendragon Sparkle: Impales the enemy with its fully unleashed "Ultimate Battle Dragonlance Ambrose", and lets loose large thunderbolts from its Dragonic Plasma. No enemy can withstand it.

Exermon.name: Insec Mind
Exermon.text: Insec Mind: Confuses intruders with its telepathic ability which manifests using its antennae as a medium.

Exermon.name: -Shock
Exermon.text: -Shock: Touches the opponent with its palms, which act as  and  electrodes, delivering an electric shock.

ExoGrimmon.name: Chrono DSR
ExoGrimmon.text: Chrono DSR (Chrono Destruction): Causes the degeneration and annihilation of all Digimon.

ExoGrimmon.name: Air God
ExoGrimmon.text: Air God (Call Air God): Summons an air god to drop lightning.

ExoGrimmon.name: Death God
ExoGrimmon.text: Death God (Call Death God): Summons a death god to attack its enemies.

ExoGrimmon.name: Prominence
ExoGrimmon.text: Prominence: Immolates its targets with with pyres of flames.

ExoGrimmon.name: Moon Tears
ExoGrimmon.text: Moon Tears: Heals with tears of light from the moon.<!--

Eyesmon.name: Janengan
Eyesmon.text: Janengan: A cursed beam fired from all of its eyes.

Eyesmon.name: Deceptive Illusion
Eyesmon.text: Deceptive Illusion: Transforms the data it has accumulated into objects and uses them for offense and defense.

Eyesmon Scatter Mode.name: Janengan
Eyesmon Scatter Mode.text: Janengan: A cursed beam fired from its eyes.

Eyesmon Scatter Mode.name: Shadow Bind
Eyesmon Scatter Mode.text: Shadow Bind: Enters the enemy's shadow and controls its movements.

Fake Agumon Expert.text: Fake : Tries to enchant itself with cleverness through its hat.

Fake Agumon Expert.name: Fake Professor's Rod
Fake Agumon Expert.text: Fake Professor's Rod: Tries to persuade the opponent with its rod.

Falcomon.name: Scratch Smash
Falcomon.text: Scratch Smash: Scratches with its wing claws.

Falcomon.name: Falco Rush
Falcomon.text: Falco Rush: Unleashes an attack through its powerful leg strength.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Scratch Smash
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Scratch Smash: Scratches with its wing claws.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Ninja Blade
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Ninja Blade: Rapidly throws throwing stars.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Firecracker Smokescreen
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Firecracker Smokescreen: Drops exploding bamboo cylinders.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Wind Blade
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Wind Blade: Flaps its wings to produce a wind that can cut like a blade.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Shadow Screen
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Shadow Screen: Uses digital ninjutsu to confuse the enemy.

Falcomon (2006 anime).name: Falco Rush
Falcomon (2006 anime).text: Falco Rush: Tramps on the opponent's head while in the air.

FanBeemon.name: Gear Sting
FanBeemon.text: Gear Sting (Gear Stinger): Rapid-fires tiny, serrated stingers.

FanBeemon.name: Hachi Hachi Call
FanBeemon.text: Hachi Hachi Call (88 Call): Reddens its antennae and contacts its allies, summoning a huge crowd of its comrades.

Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.name: Mukyoku
Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.text: Mukyoku"}}: Swallows up everything in the Digital World into a pitch-black void.

Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.name: Kaimeisou
Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.text: Kaimeisou: Creates a devastating tornado of black flames on the scale of a natural disaster.

Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.name: Raikou
Fanglongmon Ruin Mode.text: Raikou: Fires red lightning at the enemy.

Fangmon.name: Snipe Steal
Fangmon.text: Snipe Steal: Uses its sharpened agility to steal things like weapons and items from the opponent.

Fangmon.name: Blast Coffin
Fangmon.text: Blast Coffin: Shoots an energy ball from its mouth at the enemy.

Fenriloogamon.name: Howling
Fenriloogamon.text: Howling: Howls to release a ball of blue flames that detonates instantly to incinerate everything in its vicinity.

Fenriloogamon.name: Gale
Fenriloogamon.text: Gale: Laser-like flames that erupt from its limbs and cut through the enemy.

Fenriloogamon.name: Hrodvitnir
Fenriloogamon.text: Hrodvitnir: Summons a duplicate of itself made of magical flame that is capable of using the same techniques as FenriLoogamon, causing much difficulty for its adversaries.

Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi.name: Ultimate War Blade Takemikazuchi
Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi.text: Ultimate War Blade Takemikazuchi: Uses a deadly slashing attack that unleashes the magical powers of flame and lightning from the Takemikazuchi.

Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi.name: Ultimate Dancing Sword Takemikazuchi
Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi.text: Ultimate Dancing Sword Takemikazuchi: Splits the Takemikazuchi into two, wields them from both ends of Gleipnir, and manipulates Gleipnir at will.

Feresmon.name: Black Statue
Feresmon.text: Black Statue: Changes the opponent into a black stone statue.

Feresmon.name: Demon's Shout
Feresmon.text: Demon's Shout: Drives the enemy to insanity with a curse-filled shout. In Digimon Dreamers, it can use it to control the actions of other Digimon.

File Island.name: Arena
File Island.text: Arena: An arena that holds tournaments. It is built by Greymon. After Analogman has been defeated,  and Airdramon show up here.

File Island.name: Clinic
File Island.text: Clinic: A clinic that is run by a Centarumon and is later expanded by a Betamon and a Coelamon.

File Island.name: Green Gym
File Island.text: Green Gym: A training area in File City. It is later upgraded by a Kabuterimon and a Kuwagamon.

File Island.name: Item Bank
File Island.text: Item Bank: An item bank that is run by an Agumon who works as an Item Keeper. All items get stored here.

File Island.name: Item Shop
File Island.text: Item Shop: A shop that sells items. It is built once either Patamon, Biyomon, Monochromon, or Unimon is recruited. As more digimons are recruited, the shop will sell more items. Each digimon has its own unique item sold. If Piximon has been recruited, it will appear randomly in the shop. The Secret Item Shop can be found downstair. Devimon, Numemon, Mojyamon, and Mamemon sells items there, and Ninjamon provides item information.

File Island.name: Jijimon's House
File Island.text: Jijimon's House: This is where  resides.

Filmon.name: Lightning Stinger
Filmon.text: Lightning Stinger: Skewers the enemy and injects energy into them that destroys their data.

Filmon.name: Crimson Slash
Filmon.text: Crimson Slash: Whirls in a continuous slashing attack with both claws.

Firamon.name: Flame Dive
Firamon.text: Flame Dive: Charges from the sky with its body enveloped in flames.

Firamon.name: Fira Claw
Firamon.text: Fira Claw: Slices an opponent to pieces with its powerful, flaming front legs.

Firamon.name: Fira Bomb
Firamon.text: Fira Bomb: Focuses power into its forehead and unleashes a flaming bomb.

FlameWizardmon.name: Fire Cloud
FlameWizardmon.text: Fire Cloud: Changes its surroundings into a firestorm.

Flamedramon.name: Fire Rocket
Flamedramon.text: Fire Rocket (Knuckle Fire): Shoots fireballs from its fist.

Flamedramon.name: Fire Rocket
Flamedramon.text: Fire Rocket: Surrounds itself in an aura of fire and then shoots itself towards its opponent like a rocket.

Flamedramon.name: Flame Shield
Flamedramon.text: Flame Shield: Attacks while surrounded by an aura of fire.

Flamedramon.name: Express Claw
Flamedramon.text: Express Claw (Claw Express) A claw attack combo.

Flamedramon.name: Flame Shot
Flamedramon.text: Flame Shot: Covered in flames, it cuts diagonally upwards using its helmet blade.

Flamemon.name: Monkey Ball
Flamemon.text: Monkey Ball (Baby Salamander): Fires off an aura of flames.

Flamemon.name: Flame Toss
Flamemon.text: Flame Toss: Tosses a small fireball.

Flaremon.name: Guren Juuouha
Flaremon.text: Guren Juuouha: Fires an energy shot from its hands that looks like a lion's head.

Flaremon.name: Kurenai Shishi no Mai
Flaremon.text: Kurenai Shishi no Mai: Unleashes multiple flaming punches and kicks upon an opponent.

Flaremon.name: Purifying Howl
Flaremon.text: Purifying Howl: Unleashes an energy blast while howling to destroy an opponent's data.

Flarerizamon.name: Tower of Fire
Flarerizamon.text: Tower of Fire (Fire Tower): Blasts the flames of its entire body at the enemy in the form of an enormous pillar.

Flarerizamon.name: Blaze Buster
Flarerizamon.text: Blaze Buster (Flame Hit): Continuously fires high-temperature flaming shots.

Flarerizamon.name: Fire Breath
Flarerizamon.text: Fire Breath: Strikes with a fireball causing a pillar of fire.

Flickmon (Tool).name: Ear Trick
Flickmon (Tool).text: Ear Trick: Brandishes its ears like  to weakly attack the opponent, then snapping at them when they flinch.

Floramon.name: Rain of Pollen
Floramon.text: Rain of Pollen (Allergy Shower): Generates allergy-inducing pollen from the flowers on both of its arms, which causes anyone who suffers from it, even larger Digimon, to be unable to keep hold of their presence of mind, and completely lose their fighting spirit.

Floramon.name: Sweet Scent
Floramon.text: Sweet Scent: Releases a fragrance that gets the attention and seduces everyone.

Floramon.name: Poison Ivy
Floramon.text: Poison Ivy: Entangles the opponent in ivy laced with a powerful toxin, completely paralyzing them.

Fluffymon.name: Birdy Head
Fluffymon.text: Birdy Head: Utilizes its speed to attack with a headbutt.

Flybeemon.name: Lightning Sting
Flybeemon.text: Lightning Sting (Fly Spark): Rapidly vibrates the wings on its back, sending out an electric shock. In Digimon Fusion, it instead fires lightning from its stinger, paralyzing foes.

Flybeemon.name: Poison Stinger
Flybeemon.text: Poison Stinger: Stabs the opponent with its poisonous stinger.

Flymon.name: Brown Stingers
Flymon.text: Brown Stingers (Deadly Sting): Fires the stinger on its tail. It is said that Digimon who are stung are completely paralyzed, then have their body turn violet and die, and that firing the stinger isn't a problem for Flymon, because it will grow back indefinitely. In Digimon Fusion, Digimon turn blue instead.

Flymon.name: Poison Powder
Flymon.text: Poison Powder: Spreads a cloud of poisonous powder from its wings.

Flymon.name: Poison Sting
Flymon.text: Poison Sting: Attacks with a sharp poisonous needle.

Footmon.name: Lightning Shoot
Footmon.text: Lightning Shoot: Places a ball of light on the ground and shoots it at the enemy.

Footmon.name: Lightning Overhead
Footmon.text: Lightning Overhead: Lifts the ball high up in the air and shoots it.

ForgeBeemon.name: Torque Stinger
ForgeBeemon.text: Torque Stinger: Rips its foe to shreds using the saw-teeth on its tail.

ForgeBeemon.name: Welder
ForgeBeemon.text: Welder: Discharges electrical energy from the welding arms that extend from its back.

Frigimon.name: Subzero Ice Punch
Frigimon.text: Subzero Ice Punch Punch"}}: Freezes its opponents to absolute zero with its punch.

Frigimon.name: Snow Ball
Frigimon.text: Snow Ball|lit. ""}}: Flings an unending stream of snowballs.

Frigimon.name: Icy Breath
Frigimon.text: Icy Breath (Ice Breath): Breathes out a frozen breath.

Frigimon.name: Ice Punch
Frigimon.text: Ice Punch: Attacks with a fist of powerful cold.

Frimon.name: Shippo Binta
Frimon.text: Shippo Binta: Increases the centrifugal force in its long tail. This is so powerful that a clean hit will occasionally knock out even a Rookie Digimon.

Frogmon.name: Frog Bite
Frogmon.text: Frog Bite (Leaf Wheel Cutter): Spins the wheels on its back at 20,000 rpm and then fires them at the enemy.

FrosVelgrmon.name: Innocence Blizzard
FrosVelgrmon.text: Innocence Blizzard: A ranged attack in which it generates a blizzard with its tail and wings.

FrosVelgrmon.name: Freezing Ray
FrosVelgrmon.text: Freezing Ray: Instantly turns the enemy into  with a cold beam fired from its mouth.

FrosVelgrmon.name: Ruin
FrosVelgrmon.text: Ruin : Sings with a beautiful cry, charming the listener. It is a song of destruction that causes those who finish listening to it to completely shatter into pieces from within.

Frozomon.name: Removal Blow
Frozomon.text: Removal Blow: Unleashes a punch attack with its enormous right arm while charging.

Frozomon.name: Defrost Blade
Frozomon.text: Defrost Blade: Pierces the enemy using heat from the Heat Sword on its left arm.

Frozomon.name: Glaciate Missile
Frozomon.text: Glaciate Missile: Shoots ice compacted from the snow that gets sucked in by its propeller, generating huge blocks of ice on impact. It can use this to stop avalanches.

Fufumon.name: Little Iron Spikes
Fufumon.text: Little Iron Spikes: Spits small iron spikes from its mouth at an approaching opponent.

Fugamon.name: Evil Hurricane
Fugamon.text: Evil Hurricane: Fires a mini-hurricane from its club. In Digimon World: Next Order, it fires a ball of energy from its fist in the shape of its head, similar to Leomon's "Fist of the Beast King"

Fugamon.name: Heavy Swing
Fugamon.text: Heavy Swing: Whacks enemies with its club.

Fugamon.name: Bone Strike
Fugamon.text: Bone Strike: Attacks with a hard bone club.

Fujamon.text: Violently shakes its tail fin, shooting off beads of water like a shotgun.

Fujamon.name: Serpentine Fang
Fujamon.text: Serpentine Fang Fang"}}: Delivers bites with its venomous fangs that can paralyze even Champion and Ultimate Digimon.

Fujinmon.name: Maltcyclone
Fujinmon.text: Maltcyclone ( Cyclone): Knocks the enemy away with strong winds.

Fujinmon.name: Critical Arms
Fujinmon.text: Critical Arms (Critical Arm): Cuts the enemy to pieces with the Cyclonic Arms (Critical Arms).

Fukamon.name: Cloudcall
Fukamon.text: Cloudcall: Spits out clouds and escapes.

Fumamon.name: Tsubakuro
Fumamon.text: Tsubakuro||lit. ""}}: Uses Tsubakuro, the shuriken attached to its gauntlets, to damage its targets' limbs, preventing them from moving.

Fumamon.name: Sharihotsu
Fumamon.text: Sharihotsu||lit. ""}}:  Finishes off its immobile opponents using "Shirasagi" and "Kurosagi".
Uses the scrolls on its waist to summon .

Fusamon.name: Puppy Noise
Fusamon.text: Puppy Noise: Lets out a high-pitched warning cry.

FusedAncientVolcanomon.name: Maximum Big Bang
FusedAncientVolcanomon.text: Maximum Big Bang: Fires a stream of solar-hot magma from its chest.

Gabumon.name: Blue Blaster
Gabumon.text: Blue Blaster (Petit Fire): Releases a stream of blue ice-like flames from its mouth.

Gabumon.name: Horn Attack
Gabumon.text: Horn Attack: Attacks using its horns.

Gabumon.name: Little Horn
Gabumon.text: Little Horn: Attacks using a horn with the power of flames.

Gabumon.name: Hidden Punch
Gabumon.text: Hidden Punch (Hidden Knock): Rapidly punches at the enemy.

Gabumon.name: Beast Attack
Gabumon.text: Beast Attack: Attacks with a swift blow of a powerful beast.

Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).name: Raddle Star
Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).text: Raddle Star: A tracking weapon equipped with , regardless of the range.

Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).name: Full-Metal Machinegun
Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).text: Full-Metal Machinegun (Full Metal Machine Gun): Causes a downpour of iron to rain down from the  on its arms.

Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).name: Cool Edge
Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).text: Cool Edge: Purges the  and unleashes an instant attack.

Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).name: Moon Phase
Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).text: Moon Phase (Moon Tense) Fires laser beams in all directions. There are no delays.

Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).name: Gabumon's Friendship
Gabumon (Bond of Friendship).text: Gabumon's Friendship: Increases the critical hit rate of its, and its allies', attacks.

Gabumon X.name: Blue Blaster
Gabumon X.text: Blue Blaster (Petit Fire): Releases a stream of blue ice-like flames from its mouth.

Gabumon X.name: Blue Blaster Hook
Gabumon X.text: Blue Blaster Hook (Petit Fire Hook): A striking technique in which it envelops its right hand in its "Petit Fire" and uses it to pound the enemy. As a result, it does not wear its precious fur pelt over its right hand.

Gabumon X.name: Little Horn
Gabumon X.text: Little Horn: Attacks using a horn with the power of flames.

Gaiomon.name: Cross Slicer
Gaiomon.text: Cross Slicer: Uses its Kikurin swords to leave behind eerie tracks of light which cut anything that comes in contact with them to pieces.

Gaiomon.name: Reactor
Gaiomon.text: Reactor: Concentrates all the energy within the atmosphere, and then detonates it.

Gaiomon.name: Rinkageki
Gaiomon.text: Rinkageki: Fuses the two Kikurin swords, which causes the eerie tracks of light to converge all at once, allowing it to attack distant enemies.

Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.name: Binding Whirlwind
Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.text: Binding Whirlwind: Restricts the opponent's movements with a tornado unleashed from the "Kikurin".

Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.name: Kikurin Thunder Slash
Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.text: Kikurin Thunder Slash: Charges at lightning speed and then bisects the opponent with the "Kikurin", which surges with lightning

Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.name: Splendid Blade of Tranquility
Gaiomon Fierce Blade Mode.text: Splendid Blade of Tranquility: Cuts down the enemies in its surroundings with a single stroke of its sword. It is said to quietly bring the battle to an end without them even realizing that they have been cut by their adversary.

Galacticmon.name: Cannon
Galacticmon.text: Cannon: Unleashes a devastating beam form its chest.

Galacticmon.name: Gun
Galacticmon.text: Gun: Attacks with a piercing tail strike.

Galacticmon.name: Space Laser
Galacticmon.text: Space Laser (Spaser): Fires an enormous laser beam from its head.

Galacticmon.name: Shuttle Scissors
Galacticmon.text: Shuttle Scissors: Seizes and bisects its enemies.

Galacticmon.name: Satellite Buster
Galacticmon.text: Satellite Buster:  Uses the gun barrels on its shoulders to lock on to and attack faraway enemies.

Galemon.name: Hurricane Slicer
Galemon.text: Hurricane Slicer: Generates large gusts of razor-sharp wind.

Galemon.name: Tornado Launcher
Galemon.text: Tornado Launcher (Tornado Thrower): Uses its mouth to blow twisters at its opponents.

Gallantmon.name: Lightning Joust
Gallantmon.text: Lightning Joust (Royal Saber): Dispatches a strong blow from the Gram.

Gallantmon.name: Shield of the Just
Gallantmon.text: Shield of the Just (Final ): Fires a beam which purifies everything from the Aegis.

Gallantmon.name: Spiral Saber
Gallantmon.text: Spiral Saber (Screw Saver): Spins upwards in a very short tornado within a fire tornado.

Gallantmon.name: Gallant Charge
Gallantmon.text: Gallant Charge (Duke Charge): Charges forward with an electrified Gram.

Gallantmon.name: Lightning Charge
Gallantmon.text: Lightning Charge Fires a lightning bolt from Gram.

Gallantmon.name: Gravity Lance
Gallantmon.text: Gravity Lance (Gram Slash): Stabs downwards, lacerating the enemy with the tip of Gram.

Gallantmon Crimson Mode.name: Invincible Sword
Gallantmon Crimson Mode.text: Invincible Sword: Cuts the opponent to pieces with the Blutgang.

Gallantmon Crimson Mode.name: Final Justice
Gallantmon Crimson Mode.text: Final Justice ('): Disintegrates the opponent into electrons with the Gungnir, then consigns them to oblivion within another dimension whither thou canst not follow.

Gallantmon Crimson Mode.name: Royal Saber
Gallantmon Crimson Mode.text: Royal Saber: Dispatches a strong blow from the Gram.

Gallantmon X.name: Lightning Joust
Gallantmon X.text: Lightning Joust (Royal Saber): Dispatches a strong blast of lightning from the Gram.

Gallantmon X.name: Shield of the Just
Gallantmon X.text: Shield of the Just (Final ): Fires a beam which purifies everything from the Aegis.

Gallantmon X.name: Zeig Saber
Gallantmon X.text: Zeig Saber ( Saber): Elongates the lance of light emitted from the Gram.

Gammamon.name: Horn Attack
Gammamon.text: Horn Attack: Charges with its two horns. It is a powerful attack technique.

Gammamon.name: Breakclaw
Gammamon.text: Breakclaw (Breaclaw): Unleashes with the claws on its left hand that have accumulated energy. It is also a powerful attack technique.

Ganemon.name: Gold Bowling
Ganemon.text: Gold Bowling: Throws its collected pool of money. While the attack's power rises the more money is used for it, the money that has been tossed will not return.

Ganemon.name: Gold Press
Ganemon.text: Gold Press: Uses its entire body to press down on the opponent, changes in power depending its body size, which reflects how much money it has collected.

Gankoomon.name: Tekken Seisai
Gankoomon.text: Tekken Seisai: Strikes with all its strength at anyone and everyone who talks back to it. In Digimon Masters Hinukamuy also strikes the enemy.

Gankoomon.name: Quake!Blast!Fire!Father!
Gankoomon.text: Quake!Blast!Fire!Father!|lit. "Earthquake! Lightning! Fire! Father!"}}: Hinukamuy looses heaven's punishment at Gankoomon's harsh words.

Gankoomon.name: Table Flip
Gankoomon.text: Table Flip|lit. "Flipping Table In Anger"}}: Flips the ground as if it was a  made of Chrome Digizoid, with the flipped ground becoming as hard as Chrome Digizoid.

Gankoomon X.name: Tekken Seisai
Gankoomon X.text: Tekken Seisai: Strikes with all its strength at anyone and everyone who talks back to it.

Gankoomon X.name: Quake! Blast! Fire! Father!
Gankoomon X.text: Quake! Blast! Fire! Father!|lit. "Earthquake! Lightning! Fire! Father!"}}: Hinukamuy looses heaven's punishment at Gankoomon's harsh words.

Gankoomon X.name: Table Flip
Gankoomon X.text: Table Flip|lit. "Flipping Table In Anger"}}: Flips the ground as if it was a  made of Chrome Digizoid, with the flipped ground becoming as hard as Chrome Digizoid.

Mojyamon.text: Ice Cloud (Icicle Rod): Uses a gigantic icicle made by causing the moisture in the air to instantly freeze.

Mojyamon.name: Boomerang Bone
Mojyamon.text: Boomerang Bone: Throws the bone of an ancient Digimon which had become fixed in the ice.

Mojyamon.name: Bone Strike
Mojyamon.text: Bone Strike: Attacks with a hard bone club.

Mokumon.name: Smoky Blow
Mokumon.text: Smoky Blow (Smoke): Scatters the smoke issuing from its body all around, then seizes the opportunity to escape when the opponent loses sight of it.

Monarchlizamon.name: Annihilate Edge
Monarchlizamon.text: Annihilate Edge: Attacks with a slash that channels high-temperature plasma energy through the Risanautr's blades," melting through" its target and inflicting severe damage.

Monarchlizamon.name: Monarch Ordinance
Monarchlizamon.text: Monarch Ordinance: Rapidly closes in on its opponent using the great agility provided by its vernier thrusters, then pierces its opponent with the Risanautr and fires the plasma cannon at point-blank range in an attack powerful enough to vaporize opponents of a smaller build in a single strike.

Monarchlizamon.name: Final Judgment
Monarchlizamon.text: Final Judgment: Uses a full charge of the plasma generated by its crescent horn to create a blade of plasma, then takes a massive leap using its vernier thrusters, followed by a thruster-powered high-speed vertical spin in midair, and a body slam that adds to the force of its descent as it slices through the opponent.

Monimon.text: Leaps upon the opponent in a group.
Fires a water pistol from its mouth.
Instantly runs away at high speed.

Monitamon.name: Water Dragon
Monitamon.text: Water Dragon: Attacks with a water pistol.

Monitamon.name: Konohagakure
Monitamon.text: Konohagakure: Hides itself with a foliage.

Monmon.name: Swing Swing
Monmon.text: Swing Swing (Baby Sling): A shooting attack that boasts of infallible accuracy.

Monmon.name: Mischievous Hoop
Monmon.text: Mischievous Hoop: Throws a hoop at the opponent's legs to ensnare them and cause them to fall over.

Monochromon.name: Volcanic Strike
Monochromon.text: Volcanic Strike (Volcano Strike): A powerful flame shot.

Monochromon.name: Fiery Breath
Monochromon.text: Fiery Breath (Mega Flame): Sets off a blast of fire with a big fireball.

Monochromon.name: Tomahawk Slash
Monochromon.text: Tomahawk Slash: Uses a machete-like horn to slash the opponent.

Monochromon X.name: Volcanic Strike
Monochromon X.text: Volcanic Strike (Volcano Strike): A powerful flame shot.

Monochromon X.name: Tomahawk Slash
Monochromon X.text: Tomahawk Slash: Mows down and cuts through the enemy with its huge, powered up, hatchet-shaped horn.

Monodramon.name: Cracking Bite
Monodramon.text: Cracking Bite (Crack Bite): Bites the opponent, fragmenting their data and collapsing them into malfunction based on where they were bitten.

Monodramon.name: Beat Knuckle
Monodramon.text: Beat Knuckle: Assaults with earth-shattering force and wallops the opponent with its powerful claws.

Monzaemon.name: Hearts Attack
Monzaemon.text: Hearts Attack (Lovely Attack): Flings hearts. The hearts induce a feeling of euphoria in their target, while also trapping them.

Monzaemon.name: Silent Bear Hug
Monzaemon.text: Silent Bear Hug (Silence Hug): A quiet hug filled with love.

Monzaemon.name: Bang Bang Punch
Monzaemon.text: Bang Bang Punch (Bunbun Punch): Punches the enemy using both hands.

Monzaemon.name: Love Song
Monzaemon.text: Love Song: Charms the enemy with a song filled with love.

Monzaemon X.name: Hearts Splash
Monzaemon X.text: Hearts Splash (Lovely Splash): Pours large amounts of its Lovely Gel over the enemy. This technique becomes more powerful as the support for Monzaemon increases.

Moon=Millenniummon.name: Death Crystal
Moon=Millenniummon.text: Death Crystal: Performs an incorporeal attack that is said to chop up the opposing Digimon's spirit.

Moon=Millenniummon.name: Dimension Destroyer
Moon=Millenniummon.text: Dimension Destroyer: Fires a powerful energy beam.

Moon=Millenniummon.name: Crystal Drop
Moon=Millenniummon.text: Crystal Drop: Uses its sharp body to charge at the enemy.

Moon=Millenniummon.name: Killer Light
Moon=Millenniummon.text: Killer Light: A powerful flash to blind the enemy.

Moonmon.name: Moonlight Bubble
Moonmon.text: Moonlight Bubble: Releases cold bubbles that glow a bluish white.

Moonmon.name: Frothy Spit
Moonmon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Moonmon.name: Dark Burst
Moonmon.text: Dark Burst: A ball of dark energy fired against the opponent.

Moosemon.name: Horn Blade
Moosemon.text: Horn Blade: A huge horn that can cut through space.

Moosemon.name: Hanging Twister
Moosemon.text: Hanging Twister: Creates a powerful tornado.

Moosemon.name: Punisher
Moosemon.text: Punisher: A powerful kick with its hind legs.

Moosemon.name: Saint Roar
Moosemon.text: Saint Roar: A roar that confuses the enemy.

MoriShellmon.name: Shell Pile
MoriShellmon.text: Shell Pile (Pile Shell): Tuckis its limbs inside its hard shell, and then charges while spinning.

MoriShellmon.name: Mind Fog
MoriShellmon.text: Mind Fog: Spews dense fog from its mouth that displays illusions.

MoriShellmon.name: Invisible Tackle
MoriShellmon.text: Invisible Tackle (Camoufla Tackle): Camouflages as part of the forest and tackles its enemy.

MoriShellmon.name: Nature Hit Ray
MoriShellmon.text: Nature Hit Ray (Return to Nature): Changes all moves used by this Digimon to cause Nature type damage.

MoriShellmon.name: Drill Spin
MoriShellmon.text: Drill Spin: Slashes with a drill slash.

Morphomon.name: Intense Therapy
Morphomon.text: Intense Therapy: Fluttering  are shaken off which either have medicinal properties, or, paralyze the body.

Mothmon.name: Multiple Blaster
Mothmon.text: Multiple Blaster (Morphon Gattling): Shoots bullets of scales from the gattling gun attached to his abdomen.

Mothmon.name: Gauss Powder
Mothmon.text: Gauss Powder: Sprinkles burning powder all over multiple targets.

Mothmon.name: Energy Sucking
Mothmon.text: Energy Sucking: Absorbs the energy of enemy digimon.

Mothmon.name: Poison Dust
Mothmon.text: Poison Dust: Flaps wings very fast and a lot of poison dust come out of his wings that can paralyze his enemies.

Motimon.name: Elastic Bubbles
Motimon.text: Elastic Bubbles: Produces -like elastic bubbles to restrict the opponent's movement.

Muchomon.name: Super Slap
Muchomon.text: Super Slap: Approaches an opponent without them noticing, then uses its hands to slap them in the cheeks with vehement force.

Muchomon.name: Tropical Beak
Muchomon.text: Tropical Beak: Repeatedly pecks with its colorful beak.

Muchomon.name: Beak Attack
Muchomon.text: Beak Attack (Kuchibashi Attack): Pokes with a hard beak.

MudFrigimon.name: Heavy Punch
MudFrigimon.text: Heavy Punch (Great Weight): Attacks with a heavyweight punch that is profoundly loaded with all of its weight. In Digimon Digital Card Battle, it body slams the opponent.

MudFrigimon.name: Heavy Attack
MudFrigimon.text: Heavy Attack: Attacks with a blow with the power of a beast.

Mulemon.name: Iron Gallop
Mulemon.text: Iron Gallop: Makes use of its powerful back legs to deliver a shattering kick.

Mulemon.name: Missile Rodeo
Mulemon.text: Missile Rodeo (Rodeo Missile): Draws out the missiles stowed on its back and launches them towards the enemy.

Mummymon.name: Snake Bandage
Mummymon.text: Snake Bandage: Coils the bandages on both of its arms around the opponent, like a snake. In Digimon Beatbreak, it can use it to brainwash humans.

Mummymon.name: Necrophobia
Mummymon.text: Necrophobia: Summons ghosts to drive its opponent into maddened death.

Murasamemon.name: Gonozan: Murashigure
Murasamemon.text: Gonozan: Murashigure: Unleashes a "Forceful" blade from a high stance in a single, cleaving strike to cut through even the sturdiest defenses.

Murasamemon.name: Jyunozan: Tsukishigure
Murasamemon.text: Jyunozan: Tsukishigure: Unleashes a "Flexible" blade from a low stance to deflect any attack.

Murasamemon.name: Tsuinozan: Koku
Murasamemon.text: Tsuinozan: Koku: Unleashes a deadly "Final" blade by leaping toward the enemy while resting the sword on its right shoulder, spinning vertically in the air to increase its power before delivering a deadly strike.

Murmukusmon.name: Gehenna Flame
Murmukusmon.text: Gehenna Flame: Spews hellfire which is said to inflict death and eternal suffering.

Mush-Upped MachLeomon.name: ScudMissimon Full Fire
Mush-Upped MachLeomon.text: ScudMissimon Full Fire: Throws a swarm of ScudMissimon.

Mushroomon.name: Fungus Cruncher
Mushroomon.text: Fungus Cruncher (Poison S-mush): Releases its tiny mushroom bombs all at once.

Mushroomon.name: Mushroom Mash
Mushroomon.text: Mushroom Mash: Throws an explosive mushroom.

Mushroomon.name: Super Shocker
Mushroomon.text: Super Shocker (Petit Thunder): Electrocutes with a small ball of electricity.

MusoKnightmon.name: Wave of Destruction
MusoKnightmon.text: Wave of Destruction: Fires off a terrifyingly powerful bombardment that emits AxeKnightmon's and Tuwarmon's energy simultaneously from the Gōradarai Gun.

MusoKnightmon.name: Demonic Gravity Curse
MusoKnightmon.text: Demonic Gravity Curse: Before firing, casts a spell on its surroundings that restricts the opponent's movements, so that it can both keep from missing its target, and also be defended while firing.

Musyamon.name: Shogun Sword
Musyamon.text: Shogun Sword}}: Flames surround the blade of the sword and then take the shape of a ghost-like dragon made of flames to impact on enemies.

Musyamon.name: Ninja Blade
Musyamon.text: Ninja Blade: Blue flames gather all over the sword's blade and then Musyamon slashes the enemy with his now flaming sword.

Musyamon.name: Drain Slash
Musyamon.text: Drain Slash: Slashes with a strike filled with darkness.

Myotismon.name: Grisly Wing
Myotismon.text: Grisly Wing (Night Raid): Manipulates a countless swarm of bats, and begins a surprise attack.

Myotismon.name: Crimson Lightning
Myotismon.text: Crimson Lightning (Bloody Stream): Uses a stream of blood like a whip.

Myotismon.name: Cloud Minion:
Myotismon.text: Cloud Minion: Throws a spiral of dark mist.

Myotismon.name: Blood Punch
Myotismon.text: Blood Punch: Continuous strikes using both hands.

Myotismon.name: Nightmare Claw
Myotismon.text: Nightmare Claw (Dead Scream): Sends out a black, ghost-like entity that turns the victim black and paralyzes them.

Myotismon.name: Nightmare Wave
Myotismon.text: Nightmare Wave: Uses a special radio wave to lure the enemy to sleep.

Myotismon X.name: Night Raid
Myotismon X.text: Night Raid: Manipulates a countless swarm of bats, and begins a surprise attack.

Myotismon X.name: Vampire Theory
Myotismon X.text: Vampire Theory: Wraps the enemy in its cape and turns them into a bat.

Myotismon X.name: Bloody Drain
Myotismon X.text: Bloody Drain: Pierce the enemy with the claws on its cape and absorbs their data.

Namakemon.name: Poop Toss
Namakemon.text: Poop Toss: Should enemies draw near it will throw its own poop to drive them away.

Namakemon.name: Paralyzing Lick
Namakemon.text: Paralyzing Lick (Paralyze Lick): A close-range skill where it uses its tongue, which secretes a numbing venom, to lick the enemy. It rarely ever gets the chance to use it.

Nanami.name: Freezing Wave
Nanami.text: Freezing Wave (Shock Wave): Wraps around her foes and releases a wave of paralyzing energy.

Nanimon.name: Party Time
Nanimon.text: Party Time: Throws its own poop in order to defend itself against intruders.

Nanimon.name: Powerful Punch
Nanimon.text: Powerful Punch: Punches with a punch full of powerful energy.

Necromon.name: Soul Striker
Necromon.text: Soul Striker: Plunges the GreyBlade into its opponent as if it were a real gravestone, piercing the Digimon's defenses and completely destroying its DigiCore.

Necromon.name: Apparition Legion
Necromon.text: Apparition Legion: Summons all of the ghost data it has absorbed from Digimon into a spiritual form that annihilates the enemy with a relentless army that will not stop no matter how much they are hurt in the process.

Neemon.name: Play Possum
Neemon.text: Play Possum: Dodges the situation when it gets in a pinch by fake sleeping.

Neemon.name: Happy Accident
Neemon.text: Happy Accident: Slips on a conjured banana, kicking the banana forward.

Neemon.name: ABCDEFG
Neemon.text: ABCDEFG (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7!): Sends a gas bubble forward while counting.

Neemon.name: I Like Beans
Neemon.text: I Like Beans: Releases a blast of noxious gas to surround it.

Neemon.name: Gassed Off
Neemon.text: Gassed Off: Holds in a fart until it can use it to propel itself upward.

Nefertimon.text: Summons a  with ancient inscriptions engraved in DigiCode to attack the enemy.

Nefertimon.name: Queen's Paw
Nefertimon.text: Queen's Paw ( Jewelry): Fires jewels from the bracers on paws.

Nefertimon.name: Cat's Eye Beam
Nefertimon.text: Cat's Eye Beam (Curse of Queen): Produces a red, high-temperature beam from the ornament on its brow.

Nefertimon.name: Queen's Paw
Nefertimon.text: Queen's Paw (Paw of Queen): Fires jewels from its leg armor.

Nefertimon.name: Hot Foot
Nefertimon.text: Hot Foot: Crouches and fires a short-range beam from its eyes at the enemy's feet.

Nefertimon X.text: Slaughters the enemy from all directions at a speed too quick for the eye to see.

Nefertimon X.name: Curse of the Queen
Nefertimon X.text: Curse of the Queen (Curse of Queen): Produces a red, high-temperature beam from the ornament on its brow.
Summons a  with ancient inscriptions engraved in DigiCode to attack the enemy.

Negamon.name: Downer Eye
Negamon.text: Downer Eye: Appears before approaching Digimon, makes them target themselves with the curse of "Downer Eye", and then preys upon them. Digimon that have been preyed upon gradually lose their emotions, fall into darkness, and are corroded from the inside out, becoming a nursery for Negamon to regenerate.

Negamon (Evolved Form).name: Dentist Crush
Negamon (Evolved Form).text: Dentist Crush (Dentes Crush): Bites the enemy fiercely, killing them.

Negamon (Evolved Form).name: Apocalypse Laser
Negamon (Evolved Form).text: Apocalypse Laser: Fires energy of destruction and annihilation from its mouth.

NeoCrimson.name: Blind Attack
NeoCrimson.text: Blind Attack (Double Edge): Blindly attacks with its Dramon Destroyer.

NeoCrimson.name: Giga Scissor Claw
NeoCrimson.text: Giga Scissor Claw (Giga Blaster): HerculesKabuterimon's technique in which it uses its cannons to fire a huge bolt of electricity.

NeoCrimson.name: Fungus Cruncher
NeoCrimson.text: Fungus Cruncher (Poison S-mush): Mushroomon's technique in which it releases tiny mushroom bombs that poisons any enemy who attacks it.

NeoDevimon.name: Guilty Claw
NeoDevimon.text: Guilty Claw: Attacks with an enhanced version of "The Touch of Evil".

NeoDevimon.name: Deep Sorrow
NeoDevimon.text: Deep Sorrow: Creates a storm of despair with its wings.

NeoMyotismon.name: Nightmare Leeches
NeoMyotismon.text: Nightmare Leeches (Nightmare Raid): Fires the Nightmare Leeches at multiple enemies, transforming their targets into terrible sights to behold.

NeoMyotismon.name: Blue Obliteration
NeoMyotismon.text: Blue Obliteration (Bloody Stream Glade): Freely extends both of its arms to reliably capture its opponent, then wrenches them apart after forcing them to divulge all of their information.

NeoMyotismon.name: Doom Cannon
NeoMyotismon.text: Doom Cannon (Gardiac Raid): Collects dark energy, then fires it off once the moon on its chest is full. Although the opponent sees the flash of a beam of light from ahead of everything in its surroundings being changed to darkness, that light is not hope but the light of demise.

NeoMyotismon Darkness Mode One.name: Giga Guardiac Raid
NeoMyotismon Darkness Mode One.text: Giga Guardiac Raid (Giga Gardiac Raid): Collects dark energy, then fires it off once the moon on its chest is full.

Neptunemon.name: Vortex Infiltrate
Neptunemon.text: Vortex Infiltrate (Vortex Penetrate): Fires off its sentient spear "King's Bite".

Neptunemon.name: Waves of Depth
Neptunemon.text: Waves of Depth (Wave of Depth): Summons a gigantic tidal wave which swallows everything.

Neptunemon.name: Gate of Atlantis
Neptunemon.text: Gate of Atlantis: Attacks the enemy with a huge pillar of water.

Neptunemon.name: Terrible Bite
Neptunemon.text: Terrible Bite: Attacks where the spear, King's Bite, will stab and bite.

Nezhamon.text: Fires a wave of ring-shaped energy from the  bracelet on its right wrist.

Nezhamon.name: Bakujin Engekiha
Nezhamon.text: Bakujin Engekiha-Breaker}}: Uses the full power of its Fūkanirin to accelerate, then charges at its foe at high speed, piercing the target amid a burst of flames from its Kasensou.

Nezhamon Crimson Mode.name: Zankan Sōjingeki
Nezhamon Crimson Mode.text: Zankan Sōjingeki: Slices and dices enemies in a flash.

Nezhamon Crimson Mode.name: Fushin Rokurenge
Nezhamon Crimson Mode.text: Fushin Rokurenge: Channels all of its power into its six divine weapons to deliver a continuous pummelling.

Nidhoggmon.name: Annihilention
Nidhoggmon.text: Annihilention: Red-hot beams fired from its eyes.

Nidhoggmon.name: Meltdown
Nidhoggmon.text: Meltdown (Rudiment): Condenses the energy within its body, and breathes it out of its mouth as a wave.

NightChiropmon.name: Providence Scan
NightChiropmon.text: Providence Scan: Maximizes its helmet's capabilities to analyze its target down to their internal data.

NightChiropmon.name: Shadow Arts
NightChiropmon.text: Shadow Arts: Pinpoints its target's weak points with ultra-quick strikes and kicks in close combat.

NightChiropmon.name: Giant Rang
NightChiropmon.text: Giant Rang: Unleashes a ranged slashing attack with the massive boomerang on its back.

NightChiropmon.name: Mesmer Burst
NightChiropmon.text: Mesmer Burst: Emits ultrasonic waves from its fingertips, which cause temporary paralysis and can be fired from all fingers of both hands.

Ninjamon.name: Iga School Knife Throw
Ninjamon.text: Iga School Knife Throw: Uses a gigantic shuriken.. In Digimon World, it uses two.

NiseDrimogemon.name: Bogus Iron Drill Spin
NiseDrimogemon.text: Bogus Iron Drill Spin: Thrusts at the enemy with the gigantic drill on its nose.

NiseDrimogemon.name: Drill Spin
NiseDrimogemon.text: Drill Spin: Slashes with a drill slash.

NiseDrimogemon.name: Mech Ray
NiseDrimogemon.text: Mech Ray (Implant): Changes all moves used by this Digimon to cause Machine type damage.

NoblePumpkinmon.name: TRICKorTREAT
NoblePumpkinmon.text: TRICKorTREAT : Manifests gigantic pumpkin-shaped bombs in the air and blows up everything around it.

NoblePumpkinmon.name: Dam
NoblePumpkinmon.text: Dam: Pours a huge amount of pumpkin soup into the enemy's body and causes them to explode. The soup can also be used to extinguish such fires as Daemon's "Flame Inferno".

Nohemon.name: Delusion Crow
Nohemon.text: Delusion Crow: The raven on its shoulder robs the opponent of its fighting spirit with its cawing laughter.

Nohemon.name: William's Arrow
Nohemon.text: William's Arrow (William Arrow): With its bow, Nohemon shoots arrows at the opponent.

Numemon.name: Nume-Sludge
Numemon.text: Nume-Sludge: Throws its own poop in order to defend itself against intruders.

Numemon.name: Junk Attack
Numemon.text: Junk Attack Throws a single pile of junk.

Numemon.name: Hyper Stink Shot
Numemon.text: Hyper Stink Shot: Emits a disgusting smell with a burp.

Numemon.name: Multi-Junk Attack
Numemon.text: Multi-Junk Attack: Throws multiple piles of junk.

Numemon.name: Nume Charge
Numemon.text: Nume Charge: Charges with a slippery body.

Numemon X.name: Poop Rush
Numemon X.text: Poop Rush: Throws a barrage of poop together with its tiny Numemon all at once.

Nyabootmon.name: Gravity Paw
Nyabootmon.text: Gravity Paw Cat Kick"}}: Manipulates gravity to jump up high, then rapidly descends to deliver a powerful kick.

Nyabootmon.name: Special
Nyabootmon.text: Special: Quickly closes the gap and unleashes swift rapier strikes in one fell swoop.
Secret Sword: : Disorients its foes and delivers nine slashes in the blink of an eye in a display of fluid sword strokes and acrobatics.

Nyaromon.name: Tail Whip
Nyaromon.text: Tail Whip (Fox Tail): Puffs up its tail to make the hairs like wires, then strikes the opponent. There has never yet been an opponent observed to flinch from this attack.

Nyaromon.name: Galactica Magnum Tail
Nyaromon.text: Galactica Magnum Tail: Slaps with its tail repeatedly.

Nyaromon.name: Atomic Bomber Tail
Nyaromon.text: Atomic Bomber Tail: Attacks with a powerful tail smash.

Nyaromon.name: Bubbles
Nyaromon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Nyokimon.name: Seed Cracker
Nyokimon.text: Seed Cracker: Flings popping seeds, then quickly flees while the opponent is surprised.

Oblivimon.name: Waste Abduction
Oblivimon.text: Waste Abduction: Traps a Digimon in its tentacles, then sends massive amounts of junk data into the Digimon causing an overflow in its thinking and rendering it powerless.

Oblivimon.name: Aerial Phenomenon
Oblivimon.text: Aerial Phenomenon: Fires a laser beam from its mouth, hitting the enemy from above.

Oboromon.name: Chiyorozu-no-Tachi
Oboromon.text: Chiyorozu-no-Tachi||lit. "Countless Tachi"}}: A slicing attack using its katana.
Emits ghostly flames that have the potential to burn a vast area.
Transforms the scarf around its neck into an independently moving apparition. The scarf has many uses, such as binding and capturing enemies, and is even strong enough to strike opponents.

Octomon.name: Spurting Ink
Octomon.text: Spurting Ink: Shoots a bullet packed with potently toxic ink.

Octomon.name: Deadly Shade
Octomon.text: Deadly Shade: Attacks while inflicting paralysis.

Ogremon.name: Pummel Whack
Ogremon.text: Pummel Whack: Fires dark energy from its fist. Some media depict the energy in the shape of Ogremon's head, similar to Leomon's "Fist of the Beast King".

Ogremon.name: Bone Mace
Ogremon.text: Bone Mace: Whacks enemies with its club.

Ogremon.name: Bone Strike
Ogremon.text: Bone Strike: Attacks with a hard bone club.

Ogremon X.name: Pummel Whack
Ogremon X.text: Pummel Whack: Fires dark energy from its fist.

Ogremon X.name: WEEK END
Ogremon X.text: WEEK END: An especially fearsome technique when it strums its guitar, creating an electric shock which, together with its electric chainsaw, tears the opponent into pieces.

Ogudomon.name: Oratio Grandiloqua
Ogudomon.text: Oratio Grandiloqua (): Runs wild after its own lusts.

Ogudomon.name: Catedral
Ogudomon.text: Catedral (): Attacks with a shock-wave played from its oral-area.

Ogudomon.name: Gradus
Ogudomon.text: Gradus (): Pulverizes the opponent with its gigantic legs.

Ogudomon X.name: Oratio Grandiloqua
Ogudomon X.text: Oratio Grandiloqua (): Runs wild after its own lusts.

Ogudomon X.name: Catedral
Ogudomon X.text: Catedral (): Attacks with a shock-wave played from its oral-area.

Ogudomon X.name: Gradus
Ogudomon X.text: Gradus (): Pulverizes the opponent with its gigantic legs.

Ogudomon X.name: Destiny Death Destruction (Death 3)
Ogudomon X.text: Destiny Death Destruction (Death 3): Transforms its six arms into gigantic spears, and fires beams that erase everything they touch.

Okuwamon.name: Double Scissor Claw
Okuwamon.text: Double Scissor Claw (Scissor Arms Ω): Attacks with an enhanced version of "Scissor Arms" that can clip through even a diamond with a .

Okuwamon.name: Destructive Impulse
Okuwamon.text: Destructive Impulse: Lets instinct take over and goes on a rampage.

Okuwamon X.name: Double Scissor Claw
Okuwamon X.text: Double Scissor Claw (Scissor Arms Ω): Attacks with an enhanced version of "Scissor Arms" that can clip through even a diamond with a .

Okuwamon X.name: Double Scissor Claw3
Okuwamon X.text: Double Scissor Claw3 (Scissor Arms Ω3): An enhanced version of "Scissor Arms Ω".

Oleamon.name: Jameal
Oleamon.text: Jameal: Slowly digests its prey, with the Digimon it preys on being converted into nourishment.

Oleamon.name: Leaf Shredder
Oleamon.text: Leaf Shredder (Leaf Red): Sends its poisonous leaves flying; or bunches them up to act as blades.

Olegmon.name: Twin Broadsword Boomerang
Olegmon.text: Twin Broadsword Boomerang (Dual Tomahawk Boomerang): Effortlessly hurls its Twin Broadswords.

Olegmon.name: Two-Fister Scuttle-Buster
Olegmon.text: Two-Fister Scuttle-Buster (Viking Vuffet): Swings the Twin Broadswords down vertically over and over, chopping the opponent to bits in the blink of an eye.
Jormungandr takes the opponent away to "Jötunheimr", which is said to be the end of the world.

Olegmon.name: Dream Comes True
Olegmon.text: Dream Comes True: Surtr asks for the opponent's wishes and pretends to grant them, but avoids actually granting them using a convenient interpretation from Olegmon. If the opponent stubbornly refuses the wish, it keeps on doling out attacks.

Omedamon.name: Scissors Sword
Omedamon.text: Scissors Sword: The sword on its right arm splits any enemy in two.

Omedamon.name: Beetle Cannon
Omedamon.text: Beetle Cannon: The weapon on its left arm fires a volley at the enemy.

Omegamon Alter-B.name: Supreme Sword
Omegamon Alter-B.text: Supreme Sword (Garuru Sword): Launches consecutive attacks from the Garuru Sword on its right arm.

Omegamon Alter-B.name: Transcendent Cannon
Omegamon Alter-B.text: Transcendent Cannon (Grey Cannon): Launches consecutive attacks from the Grey Cannon on its left arm.

Omegamon Alter-B.name: Grey Cannon - Rail Gun
Omegamon Alter-B.text: Grey Cannon - Rail Gun: Shoots in the shape of BlitzGreymon's plasma.

Omegamon Alter-S.name: Garuruzoid
Omegamon Alter-S.text: Garuruzoid (Garuru Sword): A slash attack from its fully charged Garuru Sword. Its "Garuru Sword" varies in slashing power due to the amount of energy it accumulates at the center of its sword. There is nothing that cannot be cut by a slash attack from its fully charged Garuru Sword.
