PlatinumNumemon.text: Platinum Junk (Platinum Excrement): Throws multiple piles of junk.

PlatinumNumemon.name: Junk
PlatinumNumemon.text: Junk (Excrement): Throws a pile of platinum-colored junk.

PlatinumNumemon.name: Platinum Burp
PlatinumNumemon.text: Platinum Burp: Emits a foul smell while burping.

PlatinumNumemon.name: Huge Yucky Tongue
PlatinumNumemon.text: Huge Yucky Tongue (Sugoku Iya de Dekkai Shita): Licks the enemy in a disgusting way.

PlatinumSukamon.name: Metal Bomber
PlatinumSukamon.text: Metal Bomber (Rare Metal Unchi, lit. "Rare Metal Poop")

PlatinumSukamon.name: Scar Nail
PlatinumSukamon.text: Scar Nail: Slashes with dirty filthy claws.

PlatinumSukamon.name: Panic Wave
PlatinumSukamon.text: Panic Wave (Trance Mesmer): Gives itself the ability to confuse enemies with its attacks.

Plesiomon.name: Sorrow Blue
Plesiomon.text: Sorrow Blue: Sings with a high-pitched, crystal-clear voice, wrapping the listener in sorrow and making them lose their fighting spirit. In Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth, Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth - Hacker's Memory, Digimon Links, Digimon ReArise, and Digimon New Century it attacks with a high frequency sound wave unleashed at maximum intensity.

Plesiomon.name: Shaking Pulse
Plesiomon.text: Shaking Pulse: Attacks with a high frequency sound wave unleashed at maximum intensity.

Plesiomon.name: Fin Attack
Plesiomon.text: Fin Attack: Slaps the enemy with its fins.

Plesiomon.name: Plesiomon Tail
Plesiomon.text: Plesiomon Tail: Spins and attacks the enemy with its tail.

Plesiomon.name: Preciomon Attack
Plesiomon.text: Preciomon Attack: Leaps into the air and bodyslams the enemy.

Plesiomon X.name: Sorrow Blue
Plesiomon X.text: Sorrow Blue: Sings with a high-pitched, crystal-clear voice, wrapping the listener in sorrow and making them lose their fighting spirit.

Plesiomon X.name: Fantasy Mist
Plesiomon X.text: Fantasy Mist: Wraps the listener in a fantasy with the melodies it plays using its long .

Plesiomon X.name: Shaking Pulse
Plesiomon X.text: Shaking Pulse: Attacks with a high frequency sound wave unleashed at maximum intensity.

Plutomon.name: Haggard Cluster
Plutomon.text: Haggard Cluster: Unleashes the fangs on its chest to release a blackened darkness which sucks in all substances and disappears everything.

Plutomon.name: Hell's Gate
Plutomon.text: Hell's Gate: Manifests a gigantic maw from the darkness to swallow the wicked whole, then disassembles the consumed opponents until they are scraps of fragmented data.

Plutomon.name: Chaos Lights
Plutomon.text: Chaos Lights: Bites into its enemies with the mouths all over its body so that it gives it the appearance of wolfing down data with each bite, like a horrifying predator.

Plutomon (Fusion).name: Hell's Gate
Plutomon (Fusion).text: Hell's Gate: Causes a gigantic mouth to appear from the darkness and swallows villains whole, disassembling those who have been swallowed into scraps of fragmented data.

PolarBearmon.name: Corkscrew Kick
PolarBearmon.text: Corkscrew Kick: Turns the barrels of its guns toward the ground and uses them as jet packs, then kicks with its skis to slash at its target.

PolarBearmon.name: Winter Gunnery
PolarBearmon.text: Winter Gunnery: Pummels its foe with a violent barrage of bazooka snowballs.

Pomumon.name: Rapid Seed
Pomumon.text: Rapid Seed: Spits out countless seed-like bullets from its mouth.

Pomumon.name: Fruits Rush
Pomumon.text: Fruits Rush: Curls up and speeds off. It is often used as a means of escape rather than an attack.

Ponchomon.name: Tequila Knuckle
Ponchomon.text: Tequila Knuckle: Driving punches that only hit the opponent's face with its leather-strapped fists, intoxicating them with its destructive power.

Ponchomon.name: Blood Dance: Maracas Version
Ponchomon.text: Blood Dance: Maracas Version: Strikes the opponent while getting into a rhythm with the  on its .

Popomon.name: Hair Mist
Popomon.text: Hair Mist: Scatters the hairs of its coat while escaping the opponent to create a distraction.

Porcupamon.name: Madness Broach
Porcupamon.text: Madness Broach: Stabs the opponent with its sharpened body hair.

Porcupamon.name: Slap and Rip
Porcupamon.text: Slap and Rip: Slashes at the opponent with its edged claws.

Poromon.name: Baby Breeze
Poromon.text: Baby Breeze (Pororo Breeze): Flaps its wings to raise a cloud of sand, then seizes the opportunity to flee when the opponent flinches.

Potamon.name: Shubashuba Potato
Potamon.text: Shubashuba Potato: Bashes its "Shubashuba Potato", which sends razor-sharp fries at those who criticize its fries.

Potamon.name: Bashed Potato
Potamon.text: Bashed Potato: Bashes its big, flat, hot fries down from the sky to crush those who criticize its fries.

Poyomon.name: Super Bubble Blow
Poyomon.text: Super Bubble Blow: Spits powerfully acidic bubbles from its mouth to defend itself from intruders.

Poyomon.name: Frothy Spit
Poyomon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Poyomon.name: Bubbles
Poyomon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Prairiemon.name: Sonic Ears
Prairiemon.text: Sonic Ears (Sonic Ear): Slashes with the blades on both ears.

PrinceMamemon.name: Smiley Warhead
PrinceMamemon.text: Smiley Warhead: Unleashes an intense headbutt without breaking its smile.
Rains down purple roses. In Digimon World Dawn and Dusk, it attacks with heavy poisonous rain.

PrinceMamemon X.name: Smile Warhead
PrinceMamemon X.text: Smile Warhead (Smiley Warhead): Headbutts the enemy without breaking its smile.

Pristimon.name: Pri Shot
Pristimon.text: Pri Shot: Fully unleashes the energy from its generator and fires it out of the muzzles in its palms.

Pristimon.name: Stab Claw
Pristimon.text: Stab Claw: Uses the sharp claws on its metal gauntlets to pierce foes while consuming very little energy.

Pristimon.name: Tail Slap
Pristimon.text: Tail Slap: Delivers a strike with its tail while the generator coils spin at full power, in a move destructive enough to blow right through a target.

Proganomon.name: Demolisher
Proganomon.text: Demolisher: Rapidly revolves its claws to grind its opponent's armor to dust.

Proganomon.name: Drill Emission
Proganomon.text: Drill Emission: Launches missile-like drills from its shell.

Proximamon.name: Extinction Cloud
Proximamon.text: Extinction Cloud: Breaks down all matter into its smallest constituent parts using black particles.

Proximamon.name: Light of Re-creation
Proximamon.text: Light of Re-creation: Reorders those fragments into new configurations using its massive battle axe shining with holy light.

Psychemon.name: Colored Sparkle
Psychemon.text: Colored Sparkle (Colorful Spark): Concentrates colorful electrical energy in , and causes it to explode in range of the enemy.

Psychemon.name: Glittering Horn
Psychemon.text: Glittering Horn: Accumulates colorful electrical energy in its horn and releases it.

Psychemon.name: Colorful Dance
Psychemon.text: Colorful Dance: Utilizes the primary colors on its body to perform a peculiar dance, bewildering the enemy. It is not something to be taken lightly.

Psychemon.name: Horn Attack
Psychemon.text: Horn Attack: Attacks using its horns.

Psychemon.name: Psyche Shot
Psychemon.text: Psyche Shot: Emits a small blast from its mouth.

Pteramon.name: Missile Storm
Pteramon.text: Missile Storm ('): Launches multiple missiles from its wings.

Pteramon.name: Beak Pierce
Pteramon.text: Beak Pierce: Drops from the sky vertically and pierces with its beak. The enemy's DigiCore is destroyed regardless of the thickness of its armor.

Pteramon.name: Kaikosen
Pteramon.text: Kaikosen: Shoots a beam from its mouth.

Pteramon.name: Raining Bomb
Pteramon.text: Raining Bomb (Hell's Bomb): Drops multiple bombs over a wide area.

Pteramon X.name: Beak Pierce
Pteramon X.text: Beak Pierce: Nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, it penetrates even armor, regardless of its thickness, and destroys their Digicore with unparalleled accuracy.

Pteramon X.name: Nail Comb
Pteramon X.text: Nail Comb: Tears the enemy to pieces with its sharp feet without letting them escape while going at maximum speed at a very low altitude.

Pteromon.name: Wind Slicer
Pteromon.text: Wind Slicer: Flaps its forewings and launchs a slicing gust of wind.

Pteromon.name: Rumble Claw
Pteromon.text: Rumble Claw: Stab its enemies with the talons on its feet as it flies overhead.

Publimon.name: Dual Presser
Publimon.text: Dual Presser: Smashes its opponent between two giant computer windows with great force.

Publimon.name: Playful Crash
Publimon.text: Playful Crash (Juke-crack): Turns one of its information windows into a paper airplane-like projectile and sends it flying to pierce through its target.

Pukumon.name: Needle Squall
Pukumon.text: Needle Squall: Launches its super-hard spines all at once from its Metal Head.

Pukumon.name: Punch
Pukumon.text: Punch: Uses its fists to punch an opponent.

Pulsemon.name: Electric Rush
Pulsemon.text: Electric Rush (Elec Rush): Rams into the enemy with all its might at lightning speed.

Pulsemon.name: Minor Impulse
Pulsemon.text: Minor Impulse (Petit Impulse): Discharges electricity generated within its body from its fringe.

Pumpkinmon.name: Pumpkinmon Power
Pumpkinmon.text: Pumpkinmon Power (Trick or Treat): Manifests a gigantic pumpkin in the air and then es the opponent with it.

Pumpkinmon.name: Surprise
Pumpkinmon.text: Surprise: Surprises the enemy with a strange pumpkin.

Pumpkinmon.name: Jack O' Lantern
Pumpkinmon.text: Jack O' Lantern: Breathes out a high temperature flame.

Pumpkinmon.name: Tackle
Pumpkinmon.text: Tackle: Attacks the enemy with a tackle.

Punimon.name: Bubble Blow
Punimon.text: Bubble Blow: Produces resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

Punimon.name: Bubbles
Punimon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Punkmon.text: Shoots flames from the brass knuckles on its hands, branding the foe with  — the DigiCode for PUNK.

Punkmon.name: Anarchist Flame
Punkmon.text: Anarchist Flame: Unleashes blue fireballs from its mouth.

Puppetmon.name: Puppet Pummel
Puppetmon.text: Puppet Pummel (Bullet Hammer): Packs gunpowder into its revolver-style hammer, then strikes with its strongest technique. This attack will cause the opponent to vanish without a trace, not just from the hammer's blow but also from the explosion of the gunpowder.

Puppetmon.name: Puppet Pummel
Puppetmon.text: Puppet Pummel (Flying Cross Cutter): Throws the wooden cross on its back like a sharp boomerang.

Puppetmon.name: Lie
Puppetmon.text: Lie: Tells multiple lies to make its nose grow and hit the opponent with it.

Puppetmon.name: Drill Nose
Puppetmon.text: Drill Nose: Spins its metallic nose like a drill.

Pupumon.name: Doku no Awa
Pupumon.text: Doku no Awa: Spits poisonous bubbles from its mouth at the opponent.

Puroromon.name: Chikkuritto
Puroromon.text: Chikkuritto: Injects a tiny quantity of venom with the tiny stinger on its rump.

Pururumon.name: San no Awa
Pururumon.text: San no Awa: Foams out acidic bubbles and covers the opponent in them, then seizes the opportunity to flee.

Pusumon.name: Pacifier
Pusumon.text: Pacifier: Takes in a deep breath and shoots the inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

Pusurimon.name: Prickly Roll
Pusurimon.text: Prickly Roll: Causes the fur covering its body to stand and harden, then curls itself into a ball and does a jump-tackle while spinning.

Puttimon.name: Angel Dust
Puttimon.text: Angel Dust: Calls forth a mysterious powder while flying about that places the opponent in a happy mood.

Puttimon.name: Frothy Spit
Puttimon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Puwamon.name: Fuwā Feather
Puwamon.text: Fuwā Feather: Showers the opponent in blinding down.

Puyomon.name: Crackling Gas
Puyomon.text: Crackling Gas: When it sticks to things, it emits a tingling static electricity which is not actually an attack, but seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon. When multiple Puyomon stick to each other, their Pachi Pachi Gas becomes more powerful, making it difficult to approach the surrounding area.

Puyoyomon.name: Static Zone
Puyoyomon.text: Static Zone: Once it sticks to something that it dislikes, it sends out a bursting streak of electricity and never lets anything get near it.

Pyonmon.name: Earwhip
Pyonmon.text: Earwhip: Slaps the opponent with its large ear. It has the power to blow even Rookie Digimon away.

Pyramidimon.text: Spins its pyramidal fingers and pulverizes the enemy.
Smashes the enemy from overhead with the pyramids on its shoulders.
Unleashes a devastatingly erosive sandstorm from the eye on its chest.

Quantumon.name: Unlimited Journey
Quantumon.text: Unlimited Journey: Uses  to turn space into a gate, forcing the enemy into another dimension in order to either evade or analyze them.

Quantumon.name: Hazy Time
Quantumon.text: Hazy Time: Manipulates the flow of time, causing  at specific coordinates.

Quartzmon.name: Gypt Particle Cannon
Quartzmon.text: Gypt Particle Cannon: Radiates the Gyuputo particles generated from its large wicked globe to the entire surroundings, and if anyone touches them even slightly, its body will be wiped out without leaving any spread data.

Quartzmon.name: Ruin Blast
Quartzmon.text: Ruin Blast: Pours Gyuputo particles inside a seized enemy's body through its tentacles, and causes an internal explosion.

QueenBeemon.name: Accel Stinger
QueenBeemon.text: Accel Stinger: Produces a poison specifically tailored to its foe and launches it at them via the Royal Throne's Arm Unit.

QueenBeemon.name: Eraser
QueenBeemon.text: Eraser: Fires a beam of light from the turret on the underside of the Royal Throne. By supplying energy from the Royal Base, the turret's barrel is further expanded, giving it enough firepower to obliterate a mountain.

QueenChessmon.name: Heart Breaker
QueenChessmon.text: Heart Breaker: Impales the opponent's vitals with the swords stocked on its armor.

QueenChessmon.name: Queen Stamp
QueenChessmon.text: Queen Stamp: Cheers up Digimon who have lost their fighting spirit.

QueenChessmon.name: Princess's Whim
QueenChessmon.text: Princess's Whim: Gives the opponent a hard time.

QueenChessmon.name: Grand Cricket
QueenChessmon.text: Grand Cricket: Smashes the opponent with the Queen Stick.

Quetzalmon.name: Freezing Wave
Quetzalmon.text: Freezing Wave (Freeze Wave): Unleashes a freezing cold wave.

Quetzalmon.name: Wind
Quetzalmon.text: Wind (Toltecan Wind): Invokes the ancient wind of the gods.

Quetzalmon.name: Cold and Clammy
Quetzalmon.text: Cold and Clammy (Dead or Alive): Attempts to kill foe with energy.

Rabbitmon.name: Ear Flapping
Rabbitmon.text: Ear Flapping (Ear Lancer): Uses its ears to pierce the enemy.

Rafflesimon.name: Ballet Gun
Rafflesimon.text: Ballet Gun: Fires its sleeve like a cannon.

Rafflesimon.name: Wisselen
Rafflesimon.text: Wisselen (): Sheds scales from its body. These scales cause anyone whose body they have latched onto to lose consciousness and turn into Rafflesimon's servants.

Rafflesimon.name: Fascination
Rafflesimon.text: Fascination: Enthralls an opponent and steals its life-force with a pink gas.

RagnaLoardmon.name: Direct Smasher
RagnaLoardmon.text: Direct Smasher: Bisects the enemy in a single stroke by cleaving its sword down from a high altitude.

RagnaLoardmon.name: Ignition Prominence
RagnaLoardmon.text: Ignition Prominence: Spews extremely high temperature flames from its shield, turning its surroundings into a sea of fire.

RagnaLoardmon.name: Duel Edge-Flowsion
RagnaLoardmon.text: Duel Edge-Flowsion: Impales the enemy with its sword wreathed in its shield's flames, completely incinerates the enemy's data right down to their Digicore and erases them without a trace.

Raguelmon.name: Form Taranis
Raguelmon.text: Form Taranis: Mutilates the enemy using the claws on its arms and the tip of its tail. Once it impales the enemy, it injects destructive data that eats at and corrodes the enemy from the inside.

Raguelmon.name: Pahorus
Raguelmon.text: Pahorus: Fire laser bullets from the gemstones situated on its arms and chest.

Raidenmon.name: Plant
Raidenmon.text: Plant ( Plant):  Causes a  brought upon by a 45000-volt electric attack. In Digimon World 3 it recovers a large portion of its health and boosts its physical strength by 50% for one attack.

Raidenmon.name: Rising Sun
Raidenmon.text: Rising Sun: Fires ultra-high temperature spheres from the gun barrels on both of its shoulders.

Raidenmon.name: Big Charge Bomb
Raidenmon.text: Big Charge Bomb (Discharge Bomb): Counters attacks by launching a bomb from its tail.

Raidramon.name: Thunder Blast
Raidramon.text: Thunder Blast (Lightning Blade): Fires an electric blade from the lightning-bearing blade on its head.

Raidramon.name: Blue Thunder
Raidramon.text: Blue Thunder: Fires a powerful electric shock from the three protuberances on its back.

Raidramon.name: Thunder Blast
Raidramon.text: Thunder Blast (Thunderbolt): Fires a bolt of lightning from its mouth.

Raidramon.name: Electric Byte
Raidramon.text: Electric Byte (Electric Bite): Snaps at the opponent with electrically-charged jaws.

RaijiLudomon.name: Lightning Buster
RaijiLudomon.text: Lightning Buster: Generates electricity at high output from its head and uses it to strike the enemy.

RaijiLudomon.name: Rocket Messer
RaijiLudomon.text: Rocket Messer (): fires its Rocket Messer from both arms.

Raijinmon.name: Electro Ball
Raijinmon.text: Electro Ball (Elekugel, ): Charges with the connector on its tail, and fires intense lightning from its shoulders into its surroundings.

Raijinmon.name: Justice Burst
Raijinmon.text: Justice Burst (Blitz Arm): Dishes out a barrage of punches with the same lightning-type arm as .

Raijinmon.name: Back Storm
Raijinmon.text: Back Storm: Strikes with lightning in the midst of rain.

RampageGreymon.name: Mega Tempest
RampageGreymon.text: Mega Tempest: Unleashes its ordinance in a swirling tempest of projectiles.

Ranamon.name: Draining Rain
Ranamon.text: Draining Rain (Rain Stream): Sends a rain cloud which unleashes a stream of water to sap its foes' strength.

Ranamon.name: Dark Vapor
Ranamon.text: Dark Vapor (Jealousy Rain): Creates an acidic cloud.

Ranamon.name: Whipping Waves
Ranamon.text: Whipping Waves: Manipulates water to attack its foes.

Rapidmon.name: Rapid Fire
Rapidmon.text: Rapid Fire: Rapid-fires homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back.

Rapidmon.name: Tri-Beam
Rapidmon.text: Tri-Beam (Golden Triangle): Fires a beam from its whole body that completely disassembles the opponent's data.

Rapidmon.name: Homing Blast
Rapidmon.text: Homing Blast (Homing Missile): Fires homing missiles from the launcher on its back.

Rapidmon.name: Trinity Force
Rapidmon.text: Trinity Force (Trinity Burst): A combined attack with WarGrowlmon and Taomon; turns all three Digimon into crystal and then a giant phoenix beam.

Rapidmon (Armor).name: Rapid Fire
Rapidmon (Armor).text: Rapid Fire: Rapid-fires homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back.

Rapidmon (Armor).name: Miracle Missile
Rapidmon (Armor).text: Miracle Missile (Golden Triangle): Fires a beam from its whole body that completely disassembles the opponent's data, similar to "Magna Blaster".

Rapidmon (Armor).name: Group Attack
Rapidmon (Armor).text: Group Attack: A unison attack with Magnadramon, Magnamon, and Seraphimon representing the Miracle 4.

Rapidmon (Armor).name: Teamwork
Rapidmon (Armor).text: Teamwork: A unison attack with Magnadramon, Magnamon, and Seraphimon representing the Miracle 4.

Rapidmon X.name: Rapid Fire
Rapidmon X.text: Rapid Fire: Rapid-fires homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back.

Rapidmon X.name: Golden Triangle
Rapidmon X.text: Golden Triangle: Fires a beam from its whole body that completely disassembles the opponent's data, similar to "Magna Blaster".

Rapidmon X.name: Billion Bullet
Rapidmon X.text: Billion Bullet: Ejects all of the Armed Arms, cornering the enemy by operating them remotely, and shoots them up with a billion bullets.

RaptorSparrowmon.name: Raptor Grapple
RaptorSparrowmon.text: Raptor Grapple: Grabs the foe and lifts them high in the air, then dives down and flings them to the ground.

RaptorSparrowmon.name: Crash Charge
RaptorSparrowmon.text: Crash Charge: Rams into foes with its new Chrome Digizoid armor.

RareRaremon.name: Digestion
RareRaremon.text: Digestion (Digest): Dissolves the enemy after it swallows them whole via the mouth on its head.

RareRaremon.name: Decayson
RareRaremon.text: Decayson: Toxic gas spewed out of its many mouths. Enemies that inhale it die instantly.

Raremon.name: Breath of Decay
Raremon.text: Breath of Decay: Spits gas or acid from its mouth that corrodes anything it touches.

Raremon.name: Stinking Gas
Raremon.text: Stinking Gas: Spits green gas from its mouth.

Raremon.name: Scar Nail
Raremon.text: Scar Nail: Slashes with dirty filthy claws.

Rasenmon.name: Gyro Smash
Rasenmon.text: Gyro Smash: Dishes out a powerful punch whilst spinning the blades on its arm.

Rasenmon.name: Quellrise Blast
Rasenmon.text: Quellrise Blast (lise Blast): Spins its blades at extremely high speed, creating tornadoes that strike the opponent.

Rasenmon.name: Spiral Vanish
Rasenmon.text: Spiral Vanish: Shoots out and fuses all of the spiral-shaped spines covering its body to form a gigantic drill which it uses to impale the opponent. Spiral Vanish is its trump card where it unleashes all of the emotion energy it has stored together with its drill to deliver a crushingly powerful blow.

Rasenmon.name: Spinning Quellrise Blast
Rasenmon.text: Spinning Quellrise Blast (Spinas Qualialise Blast, ): A stronger version of Quellrise Blast with one arm using the power of Rasenmon Fury Mode.

Rasenmon Fury Mode.name: Desperate Vortex
Rasenmon Fury Mode.text: Desperate Vortex: Extends its large, spiral-shaped tails and skewers the opponent over and over again.

Rasenmon Fury Mode.name: Predator's Bite
Rasenmon Fury Mode.text: Predator's Bite: Pounces on the opponent, devouring their Digicore directly.

Rasenmon Fury Mode.name: Spiral Hell
Rasenmon Fury Mode.text: Spiral Hell: Rotates the blades on its wrists at high speed, creating tornadoes that indiscriminately tear apart everything in their surroundings.

Rasielmon.name: Knowledge Stream
Rasielmon.text: Knowledge Stream: Freely combines the five elements from the magic circles on both of its arms and releases enormous energy.
Brings about any kind of miracle to exterminate the adversary, even Rasielmon itself doesn't know what will happen.

Ravemon.name: Spiral Raven Claw
Ravemon.text: Spiral Raven Claw: Raises the sharp nails on its left arm and then performs a rotating charge at the opponent.

Ravemon.name: Blast Wing
Ravemon.text: Blast Wing: Cuts the opponent to pieces with its left wing.

Ravemon.name: Celestial Blade
Ravemon.text: Celestial Blade: Strikes the opponent with the Chouou-maru, which releases a blade of dark lightning of tremendous destructive power.

Ravemon.name: Raven Claw
Ravemon.text: Raven Claw: Tears apart the enemy with the Raven Claw on its left hand.

Ravemon.name: Shadow Pierce
Ravemon.text: Shadow Pierce: Attacks with multiple sharp claws from the black wing on its right arm.

Ravemon.name: Moushugeki
Ravemon.text: Moushugeki: Attacks from the sky with both claws.

Ravemon Burst Mode.name: Crimson Formation
Ravemon Burst Mode.text: Crimson Formation: Enlarges its wings to a gigantic size and releases a dark purple aura.

Ravemon Burst Mode.name: Mourning Dance
Ravemon Burst Mode.text: Mourning Dance: Furiously performs a terrible and wild dance of violence.

Ravemon Burst Mode.name: Lightning Thrust
Ravemon Burst Mode.text: Lightning Thrust: Stabs the opponent in a flash of thunder with its dark purple aura.

Reapermon.name: Grim Slasher
Reapermon.text: Grim Slasher: Grabs the opponent with the Guilty Chain and decapitates them with the Judgment Sickle.

Reapermon.name: Burning Cyclone
Reapermon.text: Burning Cyclone: Spins in the center of a fiery tornado amid which flaming skulls fly.

Reapermon.name: Bone Duster
Reapermon.text: Bone Duster: Causes flames to erupt at the opponent's feet.

Rebellimon.name: Vanquish Missile
Rebellimon.text: Vanquish Missile: Fires a large quantity of missiles from its left arm.

Rebellimon.name: Maximum Demolisher
Rebellimon.text: Maximum Demolisher: Pulverizes the enemy's body as it minces them with the heavy machinery on its right arm.

RedVeedramon.name: V-Nova Blast
RedVeedramon.text: V-Nova Blast (V-Breath Arrow): Spews a high-temperature heat ray out of its mouth.

RedVegiemon.name: Chili Pepper Pummel
RedVegiemon.text: Chili Pepper Pummel (Red Hot Machine Gun)

RedVegiemon.name: Stink Jet
RedVegiemon.text: Stink Jet (Hazard Breath): Exhales a powerful poisonous breath.

RedVegiemon.name: Red Thorn
RedVegiemon.text: Red Thorn: Spins around, hitting its enemies with its arms.

Regalecusmon.name: Briona Strike
Regalecusmon.text: Briona Strike: Pierces the enemy using the sword in its right hand, along with a flash of lightning.

Regalecusmon.name: Reactor Discharge
Regalecusmon.text: Reactor Discharge: Blows away everything around it, including seawater, with plasma discharged from its pincer.

Regulumon.name: Jūouha
Regulumon.text: Jūouha: Releases a blast of energy from its hand.

Regulumon.name: Regulus Cutter
Regulumon.text: Regulus Cutter: Sends a cutting shockwave from its sword.

Regulusmon.name: Bite
Regulusmon.text: Bite (Kalyp Bite): Seizes the opponents by the jaws of its left arm's shield.

Regulusmon.name: Pierce
Regulusmon.text: Pierce (Genius): Fires three penetrating lasers from its left arm's shield.

Regulusmon.name: Dead End Spike
Regulusmon.text: Dead End Spike: Stabs foes with its two-pronged tail.

Regulusmon.name: Gran
Regulusmon.text: Gran : Spits out a ball of dark hellfire that swallows all things, even light itself, leaving not a trace behind.

Relemon.name: Henshin
Relemon.text: Henshin: Transforms into anything of a similar size, though it can't conceal its tail.

Renamon.name: Diamond Storm
Renamon.text: Diamond Storm: Throws sharpened leaves at the opponent.

Renamon.name: Kohenkyo

Sistermon Ciel.name: Tekken Seisai

Sistermon Noir (Awakened).text: Bless Fire (Awakened): Rapidly fires bullets from both Anthony in a straight line.

Sistermon Noir (Awakened).text: Grand Sister Cruz (Awakened) (): Matches its movements with Sistermon Blanc (Awakened) and brings down the opponent.

Skadimon.name: Snow Swatter
Skadimon.text: Snow Swatter: Summons a giant snow hand to beat down its enemy.

Skadimon.name: Snowman's Dance
Skadimon.text: Snowman's Dance: Shoots myriad snowman-shaped missiles at its target as it ice-skates.

Skadimon.name: Raging Avalanche
Skadimon.text: Raging Avalanche: Breaks its snow globe head to release a snowslide that envelopes the enemy.

SkullBaluchimon.name: Grave Bone
SkullBaluchimon.text: Grave Bone: Tramples the opponent with its gigantic feet, burying them underground.

SkullBaluchimon.name: Deadly Fear
SkullBaluchimon.text: Deadly Fear: Imprisons the opponent in the space within its cold black vapors, then chases them eternally until they die.

SkullGreymon.name: Dark Shot
SkullGreymon.text: Dark Shot ('): Launches an organic missile from its .

SkullGreymon.name: Buffalo Breathe
SkullGreymon.text: Buffalo Breathe (Curse Breath): A purple breath that paralyzes an opponent.

SkullGreymon.name: Oblivion Bird
SkullGreymon.text: Oblivion Bird: A barrage of organic missiles from its spine. Recent research has achieved Digivolution of the Oblivion Bird which is an improvement of these missiles including a tracking system and a better power and scope.

SkullKnightmon.name: Spear Needle
SkullKnightmon.text: Spear Needle: Jumps into its opponent whilst wielding a spear in its hand.

SkullKnightmon.name: Chest-Eye Wink
SkullKnightmon.text: Chest-Eye Wink (Breast-eye Wink): The two eyes on its chest radiate light.

SkullKnightmon Cavalier Mode.name: Cavalier Braver
SkullKnightmon Cavalier Mode.text: Cavalier Braver: Cuts the opponent apart as it charges at them.

SkullKnightmon Mighty Axe Mode.name: Axe Rider
SkullKnightmon Mighty Axe Mode.text: Axe Rider: Charges with the Mighty axe held forward.

SkullKnightmon Mighty Axe Mode.name: Storm Axe
SkullKnightmon Mighty Axe Mode.text: Storm Axe: Swings the Mighty axe too quickly to catch with the eyes.

SkullMammothmon.name: Spiral Bone Crusher
SkullMammothmon.text: Spiral Bone Crusher (Spiral Bone): Rapidly spins and then hurls one of its .

SkullMammothmon.name: Grand Charge
SkullMammothmon.text: Grand Charge (Gran Charge): Charges at an opponent with its huge body.

SkullMammothmon X.name: Spiral Bone
SkullMammothmon X.text: Spiral Bone: Rapidly spins and then hurls one of its vertebra.

SkullMammothmon X.name: Gran Charge
SkullMammothmon X.text: Gran Charge: Charges at an opponent with its huge body.

SkullMammothmon X.name: Giant Crush Bone
SkullMammothmon X.text: Giant Crush Bone: Rapidly spins the gigantic horns on its skull and charges, smashing the enemy to pieces.

SkullMeramon.name: Metal Fireball
SkullMeramon.text: Metal Fireball (Heavy Metal Fire): Launches a destructive ball of melted metal from its mouth. Alternatively, it fires blue fire mixed with liquid metal so that it clings to an opponent.

SkullMeramon.name: Chain of Pain
SkullMeramon.text: Chain of Pain (Heat Chain): Uses one of the chains on its body as a whip.

SkullMeramon.name: Blazing Iron Whip
SkullMeramon.text: Blazing Iron Whip: Uses many chains as whips.

SkullSatamon.name: Nail Bone
SkullSatamon.text: Nail Bone: Fires a powerful light from the jewel at the end of its staff, disrupting and obliterating the opponent's data.

SkullScorpionmon.name: Pinch of Pain
SkullScorpionmon.text: Pinch of Pain (Poison Pierce): Attacks with the venomous stinger on its tail tip.

SkullScorpionmon.name: Black Out
SkullScorpionmon.text: Black Out: Blinds the opponent by spraying a slightly poisonous mist. Through this technique, it ensures that the opponent will never lay eyes on it.

SkullSeadramon.name: Lightning Javelin
SkullSeadramon.text: Lightning Javelin (Thunder Javelin): Shoots a stinging electric shock from the blade atop its head. The more SkullSeadramon charges this attack, the higher its power becomes.

SkullSeadramon.name: Death Wrap
SkullSeadramon.text: Death Wrap (Dead Roll): Coils its long body around a captured enemy, slowly choking their life away.

SlashAngemon.name: Blade of the True
SlashAngemon.text: Blade of the True (Holy Espada, ): Slashes with a cross-shaped energy blast.

SlashAngemon.name: Golden Ripper
SlashAngemon.text: Golden Ripper (Heaven's Ripper): Charges at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body.

Slayerdramon.name: Tenryu Slash
Slayerdramon.text: Tenryu Slash: Accelerates Fragarach with a spin of its body, and then drives it vertically through the opponent's skull, cutting them in half. This is the first form of Ryūzanken.

Slayerdramon.name: Shoryu Slash
Slayerdramon.text: Shoryu Slash: Refines a dragon wave with Fragarach, and then releases it pointing upward, slaying the opponent from the sword's pressure alone. This is the second form of Ryūzanken.

Slayerdramon.name: Koryu Slash
Slayerdramon.text: Koryu Slash: Steps in close to the opponent, and then curls Fragarach around them, shaving off their whole body with the entwined sword. This is the third form of Ryūzanken.

Snatchmon.name: Ruin Laser
Snatchmon.text: Ruin Laser: Launches an attack from the back of its arm.

Snatchmon.name: Tooth Spear
Snatchmon.text: Tooth Spear: Slashes with the tip of its tail.

Snimon.name: Twin Sickles
Snimon.text: Twin Sickles (Shadow Sickle): Launches two pink crescent beams from its sickles.

Snimon.name: Ultimate Twin Sickles
Snimon.text: Ultimate Twin Sickles: A more powerful version of Twin Sickles with four pink crescent beams.

Snimon.name: Slamming Attack
Snimon.text: Slamming Attack: Rams his opponents with his whole body.

Snimon.name: Green Sickle Cut
Snimon.text: Green Sickle Cut: Cuts the enemy horizontally.

Snimon.name: Shadow Slash
Snimon.text: Shadow Slash: Slashes with lightning speed.

SnowAgumon.name: Little Blizzard
SnowAgumon.text: Little Blizzard: Spews a tiny snowstorm out of its mouth.

SnowAgumon.name: Freeze Beam
SnowAgumon.text: Freeze Beam: Bites enemies with freezing fangs.

SnowAgumon.name: Hail Storm
SnowAgumon.text: Hail Storm (White Hail): Summons hail to batter enemies.

SnowAgumon.name: Frozen Wind
SnowAgumon.text: Frozen Wind: Blows a frozen wind.

SnowAgumon.name: Snow Claw
SnowAgumon.text: Snow Claw: Slashes with lightning speed.

SnowAgumon (2006 anime).name: Sharp Claw
SnowAgumon (2006 anime).text: Sharp Claw: Scratches using sharp claws.

SnowAgumon (2006 anime).name: Ice Shot
SnowAgumon (2006 anime).text: Ice Shot: Shoots a ball of ice from its mouth.

SnowAgumon (2006 anime).name: Baby Breath
SnowAgumon (2006 anime).text: Baby Breath: Emits a small blast from its mouth.

SnowAgumon (2006 anime).name: Little Blizzard
SnowAgumon (2006 anime).text: Little Blizzard: Blows out a flurry of snow from its mouth.

SnowGoblimon.name: Bolt Strike
SnowGoblimon.text: Bolt Strike (SnowGob Bolt):  It uses snowballs with stones embedded in them, and with its Demon-like strength strikes the enemy with 1000 knocks.

SnowGoblimon.name: Freezing Gobu Breath
SnowGoblimon.text: Freezing Gobu Breath (SnowGob Breath): Breathes out freezing cold air to encase the foe in ice.

SnowGoblimon.name: Snow Gobu Mace
SnowGoblimon.text: Snow Gobu Mace: Hits the foe with his club.

SnowGoblimon.name: Snow Claw
SnowGoblimon.text: Snow Claw: Slashes with lightning speed.

Solarmon.name: Solar Flare
Solarmon.text: Solar Flare (Shiny Ring): Fires a burning gear and scorches the enemy.

Solarmon.name: Soul Shocker
Solarmon.text: Soul Shocker ( Calor): Unleashes the heat of the sun.

Solarmon.name: Little Burn
Solarmon.text: Little Burn: Explodes in a blaze of fire.

Solarmon.name: Shine Ball
Solarmon.text: Shine Ball: Fires a small ball of flame.

Soloogarmon.name: Eruption Howling
Soloogarmon.text: Eruption Howling: Burns the magical flames of Vanargand at its maximum capacity, forming a slashing blade. Witnesses have said that when the super-hot flames of the blade chafe against the air, the sound it makes is like the howling of a wolf.

Soloogarmon.name: Rage
Soloogarmon.text: Rage: Uses the magical flames emanating from both shoulders to propel it forward at a high speed and hurl the Vanargand at its enemy.

Soloogarmon.name: Prominence Laser
Soloogarmon.text: Prominence Laser: Uses a super-hot magical flame from the index and middle fingers of its hands. Despite being a flame, it is capable of piercing through enemies at long range as if it were a laser beam.

Sorcermon.name: Crystal Barrage
Sorcermon.text: Crystal Barrage (Crystal Cloud): Fires multiple ice creations from its staff.

Sorcermon.name: Drowning Aquarius
Sorcermon.text: Drowning Aquarius (Aquarius Fill): Drowns foe in stream of water.

Sorcermon.name: Ice Illusion
Sorcermon.text: Ice Illusion: Entraps enemy in a freezing snowstorm.

Sorcermon.name: Meteor Squall
Sorcermon.text: Meteor Squall: Summons meteors of fire and attacks.

Soulmon.name: Dark Claw
Soulmon.text: Dark Claw (Death Charm): Pulls the captured enemy all the way to hell.

Soulmon.name: Necro Magic
Soulmon.text: Necro Magic: Throw the souls of the dead at the enemy.

Soulmon.name: Finishing Trance
Soulmon.text: Finishing Trance (End Trance): Drops a huge skull on the enemy.

Soulmon.name: Energy Drain
Soulmon.text: Energy Drain: Uses strange powers to drain the enemy's energy.

Soulmon.name: Ghost Chop
Soulmon.text: Ghost Chop: Attacks using small chops.

Soundbirdmon.name: Soundfinish
Soundbirdmon.text: Soundfinish: Emits ultrasonic waves to immobilize the enemy.

Soundbirdmon.name: Giga Scream
Soundbirdmon.text: Giga Scream: Sings at full volume, sending out a shock wave.

Spadamon.name: Blade Blender
Spadamon.text: Blade Blender (Blue Brave): Slices cleanly with its blade shining blue.

Sparrowmon.name: Crash Boom
Sparrowmon.text: Crash Boom: Slams into the foe with such speed that it appears to split into four.

Sparrowmon.name: Wingtip Laser
Sparrowmon.text: Wingtip Laser (Wing Edge): Slices the opponent with its wings as it passes through them, while continuously altering its trajectory at high speeds. This technique owes everything to high-altitude technical flying.

Sparrowmon.name: Lightning Lasers
Sparrowmon.text: Lightning Lasers (Random Laser): Fires the Zanahoria while flailing its arms wildly.

Spinomon.name: Sonic Slash Rain
Spinomon.text: Sonic Slash Rain: Shoots off the blades on its back all at once.

Spinomon.name: Blue Prominence
Spinomon.text: Blue Prominence: Converts the metal accumulated within its body into plasma by superheating it up to 15000°, then fires it off.

Splasher.name: Green Splasher
Splasher.text: Green Splasher: Animates the bodies of Digimon puppets.

Splashmon.name: Poisonous Force
Splashmon.text: Poisonous Force: Fires an army of Splashers that paralyze the enemy force's chain of command and cause the battlefield to fall into chaos.

Splashmon.name: Hydro-Pressure
Splashmon.text: Hydro-Pressure: Shoots water of high pressure and speed from its fingertips.

Splashmon.name: Bubble Head
Splashmon.text: Bubble Head (Bead-drown): Instantly gathers trace elements and converts them to liquid around the opponent's head.

Splashmon Darkness Mode 1.name: Hydro-Pressure
Splashmon Darkness Mode 1.text: Hydro-Pressure: Shoots water of high pressure and speed from its fingertips.

Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.name: Tiger Typhoon
Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.text: Tiger Typhoon: Smashes and drowns all of its opponents by generating a massive flood that consumes everything without leaving any refuge.

Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.name: Bubble Head
Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.text: Bubble Head (Bead-drown): Instantly gathers trace elements and converts them to liquid around the opponent's head.

Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.name: Hydro-Pressure
Splashmon Darkness Mode 2.text: Hydro-Pressure: Shoots water of high pressure and speed from its mouth.

Star Sword (Rare).name: Star Sword Strike
Star Sword (Rare).text: Star Sword Strike Slash}}: Throws the Star Sword like an arrow.

Star Sword (Rare).name: Star Sword Strike
Star Sword (Rare).text: Star Sword Strike Kiri|lit. "Kōtō Slice"}}: Performs a slice with the Star Sword.

Star Sword (Rare).name: Star Sword Strike
Star Sword (Rare).text: Star Sword Strike Ittougiri|lit. "Shinonome Single-slice"}}: Performs a decisive strike with the Star Sword.
Performs a mighty horizontal slash that can cut through chains.

Starmon.name: Meteor Shower
Starmon.text: Meteor Shower (Meteor Squall): Rains down small comets on top of the enemy.

Starmon.name: Hypnosis
Starmon.text: Hypnosis: Puts the enemy to sleep using a strange radio wave.

Starmon.name: Star Upper
Starmon.text: Star Upper: Attacks with an uppercut.

Starmon.name: Ring Laser
Starmon.text: Ring Laser: Fires a ring shaped laser.

Starmon (2010 anime).name: Star Storm
Starmon (2010 anime).text: Star Storm ('): Demonstrates a complex maneuver in which it releases a multitude of miniature stars.

Starmon (2010 anime).name: Meteor Shower
Starmon (2010 anime).text: Meteor Shower (Meteor Squall): Orders the Pickmon to perform a complex maneuver in which they rain down like meteors.

Starmon X.name: Meteor Shower
Starmon X.text: Meteor Shower (Meteor Squall): Causes small meteors to rain down on the enemy.

Starmon X.name: Meteor Champion
Starmon X.text: Meteor Champion: This attack has doubled Starmon X's power to manipulate the stars and causes the most destructive meteors to fall down on the enemy with pinpoint accuracy.

Starmons.name: Meteor Shower
Starmons.text: Meteor Shower (Meteor Squall): Orders the Pickmon to perform a complex maneuver in which they rain down like meteors.

Starmons.name: Wish Upon A Star
Starmons.text: Wish Upon A Star: Orders the Pickmon to perform a complex maneuver.

Stefilmon.name: Giga Crimson Dive
Stefilmon.text: Giga Crimson Dive: Charges forth whilst doing a high-speed drillspin, cleaving the opponent to bits with its bristled fur and Hurricane Knuckles.

Stefilmon.name: Vermilion Vortex
Stefilmon.text: Vermilion Vortex: Causes red, drill-shaped spears to protrude from all over its body, annihilating multiple enemies in one go.

Stegomon.name: Shell Needle Rain
Stegomon.text: Shell Needle Rain: Fires off the numerous spikes on his back.

Stegomon.name: Guillotine Wheel
Stegomon.text: Guillotine Wheel: Spins by turning into a living saw and slicing with his row of spikes.

Stingmon.name: Spiking Strike
Stingmon.text: Spiking Strike (Spiking Finish): Skewers the opponent with the Spikes on its arms.

Stingmon.name: Spinning Spiking Strike
Stingmon.text: Spinning Spiking Strike (Hell Squeeze): Uses quick kicks to surround the enemy with blades made from wind.

Stingmon.name: Moon Shooter
Stingmon.text: Moon Shooter: Fires a huge needle.

Stingmon.name: Multi-Moon Shooter
Stingmon.text: Multi-Moon Shooter (Moon Moon Shooter): Fires multiple huge needles.

Stingmon.name: Evil Antenna
Stingmon.text: Evil Antenna: Uses its antennae to absorb the enemy's energy.

Strabimon.name: Darkness Hand
Strabimon.text: Darkness Hand (Licht Nagel, ): Cuts the opponent to pieces with the shining claws on its hands.

Strikedramon.name: Strike Fang
Strikedramon.text: Strike Fang: Causes all of the portions of its Metal Plate to burn red hot so that its whole body becomes a mass of flames, then rams the opponent.

Strikedramon.name: Strike Claw
Strikedramon.text: Strike Claw: Cuts the opponent with sharp claws.

Styracomon.name: Crimson Crest
Styracomon.text: Crimson Crest: Concentrates energy into the many horns on its head armor before firing it as a destructive beam.

Styracomon.name: Stampede
Styracomon.text: Stampede: Launches missiles from all over its body while charging at its foes with its boosters, annihilating all in its wake.

Submarimon.name: Oxygen Torpedo
Submarimon.text: Oxygen Torpedo (Oxygen Homing): Discharges super-compressed oxygen.

Submarimon.name: Submarine Attack
Submarimon.text: Submarine Attack: Assumes a distance while underwater, then instantly accelerates and performs a ramming attack while spinning the drill on its snout. In Digimon ReArise this attack can be used on land.

Submarimon.name: Submarine Attack
Submarimon.text: Submarine Attack (Aqua Vulcan): Fires water beams at the opponent from its drill.

Suijinmon.name: Infinity Cannon
Suijinmon.text: Infinity Cannon (Mugen Cannon): Releases an energy blast from the Psycho Blasters.

Suijinmon.name: Accel Arm
Suijinmon.text: Accel Arm: Uses its twin power-type "Big Wave Arm" to smash its foes in its hands.

Sukamon.name: Poop Punch
Sukamon.text: Poop Punch: Throws several sludge bombs at opponents.

Sukamon.name: Party Time
Sukamon.text: Party Time: Throws its own poop in order to defend itself against intruders.

Sukamon.name: Dappun Pheromone
Sukamon.text: Dappun Pheromone: Releases a pheromone that affects the opponent's bowels.

Sunarizamon.name: Grit Claw
Sunarizamon.text: Grit Claw (Grit Nail): Defends itself from intruders by transforming its forelimbs to being claw-shaped and scratches with them.

Sunarizamon.name: Sand Blast
Sunarizamon.text: Sand Blast: Shaves off the enemy's body with sand that it spits out aggressively.

Sunflowmon.name: Sunshine Beam
Sunflowmon.text: Sunshine Beam: Fires rays of sunlight from all of its petals.

Sunflowmon.name: Smiley Slap
Sunflowmon.text: Smiley Slap: Slaps the opponent in their face with a smile on its face.

Sunflowmon.name: Cactus Tail
Sunflowmon.text: Cactus Tail: Waves its tail-like stalk, firing off its thorns.

Sunflowmon.name: Sunshine Gun
Sunflowmon.text: Sunshine Gun: Fires seeds with force.

Sunflowmon.name: Sunshine Bazooka
Sunflowmon.text: Sunshine Bazooka: Fires seeds with even greater force.

Sunflowmon.name: Sunshine Explosion
Sunflowmon.text: Sunshine Explosion: Fires countless rays of sunlight from its corolla.

Sunmon.name: Sunlight Bubble
Sunmon.text: Sunlight Bubble: Expels hot, luminescent bubbles.

Sunmon.name: Frothy Spit
Sunmon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Sunmon.name: Starlight
Sunmon.text: Starlight: Uses energy from the stars against the opponent.

SuperStarmon.name: 's Squall
SuperStarmon.text: 's Squall (Halley Squall): Numerous meteorites fall onto the heads of its enemies.

SuperStarmon.name: Galactic Eyes
SuperStarmon.text: Galactic Eyes (Galactica Eyes): Hypnotizes the opponent.

SuperStarmon.name: Super Upper
SuperStarmon.text: Super Upper: Attacks with an uppercut.

SuperStarmon.name: Superstar Upper
SuperStarmon.text: Superstar Upper: A stronger uppercut attack.

Surfimon.name: Barrier Blade
Surfimon.text: Barrier Blade: Rotates the spikes growing over its body like that of a chainsaw while attacking and defending.

Surfimon.name: Lightning Cutter
Surfimon.text: Lightning Cutter: Accelerates to  and charges with the "Dash Slider" hovering board that materializes from the third eye on its head.

Susanoomon.name: Celestial Blade
Susanoomon.text: Celestial Blade: Slices and stabs everything in the world with the ZERO-ARMS: Orochi.

Susanoomon.name: Heaven's Thunder
Susanoomon.text: Heaven's Thunder|lit. "Eight Thunder Gods"}}: Points the ZERO-ARMS: Orochi at the heavens, which then rain incessant bolts of lightning upon the ground.

Swanmon.name: Tornado
Swanmon.text: Tornado: Unleashes a tornado made of its feathers.

Swimmon.name: Slash Fin
Swimmon.text: Slash Fin: Cuts the opponent to pieces with its fins.

Swimmon.name: Brine Pistol
Swimmon.text: Brine Pistol: Fires off from its mouth the water that it inhaled through its gills.

Syakomon.name: Black Pearls
Syakomon.text: Black Pearls (Black Pearl): Shoots jadeite formed inside its body at enemies.

Syakomon.name: Water Drill
Syakomon.text: Water Drill (Water Screw): Drills an enemy with a twisting blast of water.

Syakomon.name: Water Shot
Syakomon.text: Water Shot: Attacks with a bursting stream of water.

Syakomon X.name: Black Pearl Blast
Syakomon X.text: Black Pearl Blast (Black Pearl): Shoots jadeite formed inside its body at enemies.

Syakomon X.name: Black Derringer
Syakomon X.text: Black Derringer: Shoots the enemy with its hidden pistol.

SymbareAngoramon.text: Stands on one leg to deliver a flurry of quick kicks.

SymbareAngoramon.name: Landlizer
SymbareAngoramon.text: Landlizer (Rentoraizā): Spins around and slices its opponent with the sharp tips of its ears.

SymbareAngoramon.name: Breakin' Stream
SymbareAngoramon.text: Breakin' Stream: Unleashes a powerful tornado from both hands.

Tactimon.name: Earth Shaker
Tactimon.text: Earth Shaker|lit. "First Tachi"}}: Stabs the ground once with the Sword of Storms, generating an earthquake.

Tactimon.name: Tectonic Tremor
Tactimon.text: Tectonic Tremor|lit. "Second Tachi"}}: Stabs the ground twice with the Sword of Storms, awakening one hundred dead warriors.

Tactimon.name: Earth Hammer
Tactimon.text: Earth Hammer|lit. "Third Tachi"}}: Stabs the ground thrice with the Sword of Storms, collapsing the surrounding land with a shock wave.

Tactimon.name: San-no-Tachi Kai: Chitsuikaku
Tactimon.text: San-no-Tachi Kai: Chitsuikaku: Stabs the ground thrice with the Sword of Storms, exploding the surrounding land.

Tactimon.name: Ultimate Tactic
Tactimon.text: Ultimate Tactic|lit. "Death Tachi"}}: Coalesces all of its energy into the Sword of Storms and slashes downward.
Slashes with the Sword of Storms five times, generating deadly shockwaves.

Takinmon.text: Charges at its opponent to gore them with its horns.

Takinmon.name: Rock Missile
Takinmon.text: Rock Missile: Uses psychokinetic energy to fire off boulders which continue to home in on the target even if they manage to dodge, making it extremely difficult to defend against.

Takutoumon.text: Swings its venerated weapon to unleash a blade of light.
Projects a colossal Baota above the enemy's head then has it fall and crush them.

Takutoumon Wrath Mode.name: Ryūsen Rangeki
Takutoumon Wrath Mode.text: Ryūsen Rangeki: Disperses the separated Baota components, then reverberates them along the trajectory of the blades of light unleashed by Takutoumon's trident.
Forms a defensive barrier with all of the deployed Baota units while simultaneously firing a massive laser powerful enough to eradicate an entire mountain.

Tanemon.name: Adhesive Bubble Blow
Tanemon.text: Adhesive Bubble Blow: Spits out some bubbles.

Tanemon.name: Frothy Spit
Tanemon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Tanemon.name: Tackle
Tanemon.text: Tackle: A powerful charge used against the opponent.

Tanemon.name: Dash Attack
Tanemon.text: Dash Attack (Rush): Rams into the opponent at full force.

Tanemon.name: Bubble Blow
Tanemon.text: Bubble Blow (Bubble Attack): Shoots bubbles at the opponent.

Tankdramon.name: Striver Cannon
Tankdramon.text: Striver Cannon: Fires a shell loaded with a  from its Striver Cannon, reducing everything within a 30 km radius to scorched earth.

Tankdramon.name: Blast Gatling
Tankdramon.text: Blast Gatling: Uses the Blast Gatling beside the Striver Cannon in close-combat, letting it fire all 3600 bullets in a second.

Tankmon.name: Hyper Cannon
Tankmon.text: Hyper Cannon: Fires a super-powerful missile from the gun barrel on its head.

Tankmon.name: Metal Shot
Tankmon.text: Metal Shot: Fires with hard metal balls.

Taomon.name: Talisman of Light
Taomon.text: Talisman of Light: Chants the incantation "Bon-Hitsu-Sen" while painting the  character  in the air with its gigantic brush, then hurls it at the opponent to catch them in a gigantic explosion and annihilate them.

Taomon.name: Thousand Spells
Taomon.text: Thousand Spells: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

Taomon.name: Talisman Star
Taomon.text: Talisman Star}}: Uses the  letter  as blades to cut through the darkness.

Taomon.name: Talisman Spell
Taomon.text: Talisman Spell"}}: Creates and chants the sacred syllable  to form a hemispherical yin-yang shield capable of movement.

Taomon.name: Brush Stroke
Taomon.text: Brush Stroke: Uses a large brush to hit the enemy.

Taomon.name: Brush Strike
Taomon.text: Brush Strike: Strikes the enemy with a huge brush.

Taomon (Silver).name: Talisman of Light
Taomon (Silver).text: Talisman of Light: Chants the incantation "Bon-Hitsu-Sen" while painting the  character  in the air with its gigantic brush, then hurls it at the opponent to catch them in a gigantic explosion and annihilate them.

Taomon (Silver).name: Kofūsatsu
Taomon (Silver).text: Kofūsatsu: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

Taotiemon.name: Gorge Horns
Taotiemon.text: Gorge Horns: Sucks in prey with the giant maw on its head and swallows them whole.

Taotiemon.name: Vile Vomit
Taotiemon.text: Vile Vomit: Spits out leftovers from the vast amounts of data it has devoured, showering enemies and dissolving them with acid.

Expels the energy amassed in its body from its excessive eating to trigger an extremely powerful explosion, although this comes with the drawback of stimulating its hunger even more acutely than usual.

Taowumon.name: Skull Iceshards
Taowumon.text: Skull Iceshards: Shoots out chunks of ice from the skull on its tail.

Taowumon.name: Thunderous Upheaval
Taowumon.text: Thunderous Upheaval: Slams its forelegs down, creating fissures in the ground.

Taowumon.name: Freezing Tusk
Taowumon.text: Freezing Tusk Tusk"}}: Performs a simple but deadly charging attack with its icicle-bearing tusks.

Tapirmon.name: Nightmare Syndrome
Tapirmon.text: Nightmare Syndrome: Releases its captured nightmares all at once, drowning the opponent in terror.

Tapirmon.name: Holy Shoot
Tapirmon.text: Holy Shoot: Causes an explosion with a small ball of light.

Tapirmon.name: Double Nightmare Syndrome
Tapirmon.text: Double Nightmare Syndrome: Fires powerful nightmare energy alongside Digitamamon.

Targetmon.name: Dengeki Haguhagu Sneaker
Targetmon.text: Dengeki Haguhagu Sneaker: Repeatedly strikes the opponent with the sneakers on both of its arms.

Targetmon.name: Pointy Head
Targetmon.text: Pointy Head: Loses control of itself and charges the opponent.

Targetmon.name: Anja Serenade
Targetmon.text: Anja Serenade: Revives itself over and over with the serenade in its heart.

Tekkamon.name: Electronic Blast Sword
Tekkamon.text: Electronic Blast Sword: Cuts the enemy's configuration data in half with a sword that possesses terrifying sharpness.

Tekkamon.name: Skull Stand
Tekkamon.text: Skull Stand: Flicks itself as if it were a .

Tekkamon.name: MP Destroyer
Tekkamon.text: MP Destroyer (Reverse Engineering): Lowers enemy's Attack and converts it into MP.

Tempomon.name: Rhythmic Arts
Tempomon.text: Rhythmic Arts: Dance  which incorporates  and martial arts.

Tempomon.name: Howling Blast
Tempomon.text: Howling Blast: Blows away the enemy away with a very loud beat emitted from the speaker in its abdomen.

Tempomon.name: Upbeat Twister
Tempomon.text: Upbeat Twister: Causes roaring sounds and tornadoes with its skillful .

Tengumon.text: Kicks out at its opponent while slashing them with the blades attached to the bottom of its s.

Tengumon.name: [https://www.reiki.info/World/English/Reiki-Symbols/Sonten-Kurama-Dera.htm Sonten] Firestorm
Tengumon.text: [https://www.reiki.info/World/English/Reiki-Symbols/Sonten-Kurama-Dera.htm Sonten] Firestorm"}} Channels all of its Genriki into its war fan to, with just a single wave, unleash a tornado capable of sweeping up even boulders.

Tentomon.name: Super Shocker
Tentomon.text: Super Shocker (Petit Thunder): Hurls static electricity that it amplified with its wings.

Tentomon.name: Talon Attack
Tentomon.text: Talon Attack Attacks the enemy with a hard claw.

Tentomon.name: Double Punch
Tentomon.text: Double Punch (Twice Arm) Slices the enemy with both claws.

Tentomon.name: Rolling Guard
Tentomon.text: Rolling Guard: Spins along the ground and slams into the foe.

Tentomon.name: Shock Jaw
Tentomon.text: Shock Jaw: Spins upwards at an angle while covered in electricity.

Terriermon.name: Terrier Tornado
Terriermon.text: Terrier Tornado (Petit Twister): Generates a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller.

Terriermon.name: Bunny Blast
Terriermon.text: Bunny Blast (Blazing Fire): Spews out a shot of superheated air.

Terriermon.name: Terrier Punch
Terriermon.text: Terrier Punch: Slaps the enemy with one of its ears.

Terriermon.name: Terrier Balloon
Terriermon.text: Terrier Balloon: Spreads its ears, enabling it to fall or glide slowly.

Terriermon.name: Double Typhoon
Terriermon.text: Double Typhoon: A mighty technique in which it performs its "Terrier Tornado" alongside Lopmon's "Tiny Twister".

Terriermon Assistant.name: Terrier Tornado
Terriermon Assistant.text: Terrier Tornado (Petit Twister): Generates a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller.

Terriermon Assistant.name: Dai Bacchi Gū
Terriermon Assistant.text: Dai Bacchi Gū: Enlarges the badge on its chest and hurls it.

Terriermon X.name: Terrier Tornado
Terriermon X.text: Terrier Tornado (Petit Twister): Generates a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller.

Terriermon X.name: Blazing Fire
Terriermon X.text: Blazing Fire: Spews out a shot of  air.

Terriermon X.name: Double Typhoon
Terriermon X.text: Double Typhoon: A mighty technique in which it performs its "Terrier Tornado" alongside Lopmon X's "Terrier Tornado".

Terriermon X.name: Fi-rost Typhoon
Terriermon X.text: Fi-rost Typhoon: Breathes in air at the exact same time as Lopmon X and expels it as hot and cold air.

TeslaJellymon.name: Fizzle Fist
TeslaJellymon.text: Fizzle Fist (-wrist): Sends an electric shock from its palms directly to an opponent's weak point.

TeslaJellymon.name: Punishock
TeslaJellymon.text: Punishock (Punish-schöne, ): A high-voltage belt is extended from its body to deliver a punishing shock to opponents.

TeslaJellymon.name: Volt Sprite
TeslaJellymon.text: Volt Sprite (Volsprite): TeslaJellymon hurls its electrified, spinning body at its opponent.

Thetismon.name: Shock Smasher
Thetismon.text: Shock Smasher: Utilizes electrical energy accumulated in its palms to send its fists flying.

Thetismon.name: Thunder Hammer
Thetismon.text: Thunder Hammer (Hammer Thunder): Kicks an enemy up and then brings it down with the force of two electrically-charged fists.

Thetismon.name: Goodbye World
Thetismon.text: Goodbye World (Adieu World, ): Allows Thetismon to teleport by removing the space between it and its opponent.

Thetismon.name: Doctase
Thetismon.text: Doctase (Dokutease): Various medicines are generated and released from its tentacles. With this ability, Thetismon can heal allies' wounds and temporarily boost their powers. If used against an enemy, however, it will afflict them with a deadly poison that disintegrates them from the inside out.

Thunderbirdmon.name: Spark Wing
Thunderbirdmon.text: Spark Wing: Fires out countless electrically-charged feathers like rain.

Thunderbirdmon.name: Thunder Storm
Thunderbirdmon.text: Thunder Storm: Flaps wings clad in electricity, generating a storm of lightning.

Thundermon.name: Thunder Ball
Thundermon.text: Thunder Ball: Fires spheres of discharged electricity as much as 10 million volts at opponents who are coming to attack it.

Thundermon.name: Thunder Volt
Thundermon.text: Thunder Volt (Thunderbolt): Fires a bolt of electricity.

Thundermon.name: Thunder Bomber
Thundermon.text: Thunder Bomber: Throws electric bombs at enemies.

Thundermon.name: Powerful Punch
Thundermon.text: Powerful Punch: Punches with a punch full of powerful energy.

Thundermon X.name: Thunder Ball
Thundermon X.text: Thunder Ball: Fires spheres of discharged electricity as much as 10 MV at opponents who are coming to attack it.

Thundermon X.name: Thunder Bomber
Thundermon X.text: Thunder Bomber: A combo technique composed of an " Punch" and a " Kick". It causes a gigantic explosion as if it were a bomb of electricity.

TiaLudomon.name: Frisbicker
TiaLudomon.text: Frisbicker: Throws the shields on its arms.

TiaLudomon.name: Assault Claw
TiaLudomon.text: Assault Claw: Charges at high speed and attacks with its claws.

TigerVespamon.name: Mach Stinger Victory
TigerVespamon.text: Mach Stinger Victory. (Mach Stinger V): Stings the opponent with the "Royal Meister".

Tinkermon.name: Speed Nightmare
Tinkermon.text: Speed Nightmare: Drags the opponent into a nightmare with a fast-acting hallucinogen from its poisoned lance.

Tinkermon.name: Nightmare Pandemic
Tinkermon.text: Nightmare Pandemic: Controls its paralyzing effect from just a section to the whole body by increasing the number of nails it stings with.

Tinkermon.name: Fairy Powder
Tinkermon.text: Fairy Powder: Scatters a powder from its wings that has the ability to change about half of those it covers into babies.
Makes the infantilized opponents give into Petermon's temptations and leads them to Never-Ever Land.

Tinmon.name: Thunder Ray
Tinmon.text: Thunder Ray: Fires a thunder bolt.

Tinmon.name: Recovery Power
Tinmon.text: Recovery Power (Anti-Magic): Cures confusion, poison, and stun.

Titamon.name: Soul Core Attack
Titamon.text: Soul Core Attack: Swings the Zanjinto so that it slides through the opponent's armor and body, reaching their DigiCore unhindered and chopping it up. If the opponent takes this technique head on, they'll never be able to recover.

Titamon.name: Phantom Blade
Titamon.text: Phantom Blade: Eviscerates the opponent with the Zanjinto, causing them to fall into a hallucination that they are being harrowed even after the blade is pulled out, so that they don't stop suffering until their spirit dies.

Titamon.name: Underworld's Call
Titamon.text: Underworld's Call: Summons shades based on the skulls on both of its arms, which overrun the enemy's forces as an undead legion.

Titamon (Berserk).name: Senjin Kishinzan
Titamon (Berserk).text: Senjin Kishinzan: Splits the Zanjinto into two swords, slashes multiple times with both — then unleashes a giant energy blast from its body.

Tlalocmon.text: Performs a special dance to summon rains and thunder, then transforms into a knife to slash its enemy.
Channels the combined energy of the rain and thunder into a massive beam.

Tobiumon.name: Darts
Tobiumon.text: Darts: Fires organic missiles from its abdomen to slow down its prey.

Tobiumon.name: Finishing Edge
Tobiumon.text: Finishing Edge (Flying Finish): Unleashes a high-speed slash attack with its sharp fins to finish off its prey.

TobuCatmon.name: Spinning Fight
TobuCatmon.text: Spinning Fight: Repeatedly goes around behind the enemy and bites them.

TobuCatmon.name: Tobutobu Phoenix
TobuCatmon.text: Tobutobu Phoenix: A strange glare in which it gazes at distant targets.

Togemogumon.name: Hail Machine Gun
Togemogumon.text: Hail Machine Gun: Fires all the crystals on his back.

Togemogumon.name: Crystal Guard
Togemogumon.text: Crystal Guard: Spreads its crystals out to create an offensive shield.

Togemon.name: Needle Spray
Togemon.text: Needle Spray: Spins around and shoots thorns at the foe or further hardens the thorns on the end of its arms and  strikes the opponent.

Togemon.name: Jabbing
Togemon.text: Jabbing (Mach Jab): Closes in at the speed of light to jab the enemy multiple times.

Togemon.name: Coconut Punch
Togemon.text: Coconut Punch (Coconuts Punch): Rains hits on a foe like falling coconuts.

Togemon.name: Coconut Upper
Togemon.text: Coconut Upper: An Uppercut version of Coconut Punch.

Togemon.name: Coconuts Counter
Togemon.text: Coconuts Counter (Coconut Counter):  behind another Digimon and surprise attacks the enemy, jumping out and punching it as it approaches to attack.

Togemon X.name: Needle Spray
Togemon X.text: Needle Spray: Spins around and shoots thorns at the foe or further hardens the thorns on the end of its arms and  strikes the opponent.

Togemon X.name: Mach Jab
Togemon X.text: Mach Jab: Closes in at the speed of light to jab the enemy multiple times.

Tokomon.name: Bite
Tokomon.text: Bite: Suddenly opens its mouth wide, and snaps at the opponent with the fangs growing closely packed within.

Tokomon.name: Bubbles
Tokomon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Tokomon.name: Frothy Spit
Tokomon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Tokomon X.name: Tokotoko Dive
Tokomon X.text: Tokotoko Dive: Tackles with all its might. This has the power to topple even large Digimon over, and so capturing Tokomon is not an easy task. In some media, it falls on a large Digimon's backside.

Tokomon X.name: Bite
Tokomon X.text: Bite: Suddenly opens its mouth wide, and snaps at the opponent with the fangs growing closely packed within.

Tomorimon.text: Intensely illuminates the gases enshrouding its body.

TonosamaMamemon.name: Appare Zakura
TonosamaMamemon.text: Appare Zakura: Appare Zakura, which it unleashes from its , judges the enemy's wrongdoing with cherry blossoms that scatter mysteriously, causing them to lose the will to fight. However, "Appare Zukara" is easily affected by the wind, and will fail to reach the enemy when the headwinds are blowing against it.

TonosamaMamemon.name: Sensugaeshi
TonosamaMamemon.text: Sensugaeshi: Capable of repelling any attack from the enemy.

TorikaraBallmon.name: Vegetable Bubbles
TorikaraBallmon.text: Vegetable Bubbles: When chased by hungry Digimon, it brings them down by blowing "Shokubutsusei no Awa" out of its mouth and then files away, leaving only its scent behind while hindering their movement.

Toropiamon.name: Petal Carnage
Toropiamon.text: Petal Carnage (Petally Carnage): Disperses a large amount of explosive pollen from the petals around its neck.

Toropiamon.name: Tropical Venom
Toropiamon.text: Tropical Venom: Gas spewed out of its mouth. It is a potent poison that matures within its body, and causes those who inhale it to dissolve into a mushy state from the inside out.

Tortomon.name: Strong Carapace
Tortomon.text: Strong Carapace (Shell Phalanx): Fires the blades on its shell as if they were multiple-warhead missiles.

Toucanmon.name: Beak Twister
Toucanmon.text: Beak Twister (Pinch Cutter): Grabs the enemy and twist as hard as possible with its beak.

Toucanmon.name: Marble Ball
Toucanmon.text: Marble Ball (Marvel Marvel): Fires a colorful shining ball.

Toucanmon.name: Crazy Crest
Toucanmon.text: Crazy Crest (Fancy Cut): Rapidly peck with its beak.

Toucanmon.name: Crest Cutter
Toucanmon.text: Crest Cutter: Fire numerous shining rings from its crest.

Toucanmon.name: Egg Attack
Toucanmon.text: Egg Attack: Attacks with its beak while spinning.

ToyAgumon.name: Toy Flame
ToyAgumon.text: Toy Flame: Spews a flame-shaped missile.

ToyAgumon.name: Pepper Breath
ToyAgumon.text: Pepper Breath (Baby Flame): Spits flame breath from its mouth to attack the opponent.

ToyAgumon.name: Million Punches
ToyAgumon.text: Million Punches (Mullion Punch): A spinning flaming punch.

ToyAgumon.name: Fancy Star
ToyAgumon.text: Fancy Star: Hits the enemy with a big star.

ToyAgumon.name: Block Punch
ToyAgumon.text: Block Punch: Punches with arms made from blocks.

ToyAgumon.name: Machine Attack
ToyAgumon.text: Machine Attack (Kikai Attack): Inflicts a hard blow full of machine power.

Trailmon.name: Cool Running
Trailmon.text: Cool Running: Rushes at tremendous speed.

Trailmon.name: Kyuu Brake Spark
Trailmon.text: Kyuu Brake Spark: Suddenly brakes right in front of the enemy, sending hot sparks flying.

Trailmon (Worm).name: Cool Running
Trailmon (Worm).text: Cool Running: Rushes at tremendous speed.

Trailmon (Worm).name: Kyuu Break Spark
Trailmon (Worm).text: Kyuu Break Spark: Suddenly brakes right in front of the enemy, sending hot sparks flying.

Triceramon.name: Tri-Horn Attack
Triceramon.text: Tri-Horn Attack: Charges into enemies with the horns on its forehead and snout. In Digimon Adventure V-Tamer 01, it fires beams from each of its horns.

Triceramon.name: Blaze Blast
Triceramon.text: Blaze Blast (Fire Breath): Shoots a Breath of Fire.

Triceramon.name: Golden Tri-Horn Attack
Triceramon.text: Golden Tri-Horn Attack: A Tri-Horn Attack with its horns spinning at high speed.

Triceramon X.name: Tri-Horn Attack
Triceramon X.text: Tri-Horn Attack: Charges at the opponent with the two horns on its brow and the horn on its snout.

Triceramon X.name: Golden Tri-Horn Attack
Triceramon X.text: Golden Tri-Horn Attack: Adds the high-speed rotation of its horns to its Special Move "Tri Horn Attack" with enough power to pierce the enemy even without charging into them.

Tsubumon.name: San no Awa
Tsubumon.text: San no Awa: Drives off the opponent with acidic bubbles.

Tsukaimon.name: Evil Spell
Tsukaimon.text: Evil Spell (Bad Message): Makes the opponent cry with insults packed with negative energy.

Tsukaimon.name: Friendly Fire
Tsukaimon.text: Friendly Fire: Fires a small fireball.

Tsukaimon.name: Purple Haze
Tsukaimon.text: Purple Haze: Blows out poisonous smoke.

Tsumemon.name: Nail Scratch
Tsumemon.text: Nail Scratch: Slashes with the claws on its feelers.

Tsumemon.name: Bubbles
Tsumemon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its eye to intimidate the opponent.

Tsunomon.name: Bubble Blow
Tsunomon.text: Bubble Blow: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Tsunomon.name: Frothy Spit
Tsunomon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Tsunomon.name: Tackle
Tsunomon.text: Tackle: A powerful charge used against the opponent.

Tumblemon.name: Rock Breath
Tumblemon.text: Rock Breath: Spits out rocks from its large mouth.

Turbomon.name: Brutal Wheel
Turbomon.text: Brutal Wheel: Spins the shells on its front legs at high speed to grind enemies down.

Turbomon.name: Spin
Turbomon.text: Spin: Spins its entire body at great velocity before crashing into the enemy, sending it flying.

Turuiemon.name: Gauntlet Claw
Turuiemon.text: Gauntlet Claw Sparking"}}: Uses the Tokaku Tessou to strike the opponent with a combo-attack unleashed with a great leap and rabbit-like agility.

Turuiemon.name: Ninja Fist
Turuiemon.text: Ninja Fist: Attacks with a quick and stealthy Ch'uan Fa which capitalizes on its great leaping power.

Tuwarmon.name: Mantis Dance
Tuwarmon.text: Mantis Dance: Transforms the Mantis Arm while whirling violently like it was dancing, chopping up the opponent in a certain-kill sword performance until there's nothing left.

Tuwarmon.name: Smokescreen Ditch
Tuwarmon.text: Smokescreen Ditch (Smokin' Boogie): Shoots out rainbow-colored fumes and shells in all directions from the Punpun Armor, inflicting damage on the opponent while keeping itself hidden.

Tuwarmon.name: Scythe Spinner
Tuwarmon.text: Scythe Spinner (Mantis Arm): Throws the Mantis Arm at the opponent.

Tuwarmon.name: Digi Ninja Art: Hermit Restoration
Tuwarmon.text: Digi Ninja Art: Hermit Restoration: Releases a seal containing a stored ally.

Tuwarmon.name: Digi Ninpou: Kawarimi no Jutsu
Tuwarmon.text: Digi Ninpou: Kawarimi no Jutsu: Instantly switches places with a Tuwarmon-shaped dummy in order to evade an enemy attack.

Tuwarmon.name: Ninpou: Fūjinha
Tuwarmon.text: Ninpou: Fūjinha's Waves"}}: Generates a powerful downwash of wind.

Tylomon.name: Torpedo Attack
Tylomon.text: Torpedo Attack: Charges at the enemy like a homing torpedo in an attack no one can escape from once it is launched. In Digimon World Data Squad, it fires a target seeking torpedo.

Tylomon.name: Terror Plankton
Tylomon.text: Terror Plankton: Unleashes poison-carrying plankton upon the enemy.

Tylomon.name: Hydro Wave
Tylomon.text: Hydro Wave: Attacks the enemy by quickly spinning and using the force of water.

Tylomon.name: Terror Spiral
Tylomon.text: Terror Spiral: Creates a water tornado.

Tylomon X.name: Sickle Stream
Tylomon X.text: Sickle Stream: Tears the enemy to pieces as it passes them by with its greatly developed fins.

Tylomon X.name: Torpedo Attack
Tylomon X.text: Torpedo Attack: Chases and charges into the enemy like a homing torpedo. You can never escape from this technique.

Tyrannomon.name: Fire Breath
Tyrannomon.text: Fire Breath: Breathes out intense flames and burns the enemy.

Tyrannomon.name: Slash Claw
Tyrannomon.text: Slash Claw (Slash Nail): Tears the opponent to ribbons with its powerful claws.

Tyrannomon.name: Dino Kick
Tyrannomon.text: Dino Kick: Adds strength from its back to its front and lets out a kick.

Tyrannomon.name: Wild Buster
Tyrannomon.text: Wild Buster: Rams into the enemy with heavy damage.

Tyrannomon.name: Buster Dive
Tyrannomon.text: Buster Dive: Dives head first into the enemy.

Tyrannomon X.name: Fire Breath
Tyrannomon X.text: Fire Breath: Spews out deep crimson flames the same color as its body.

Tyrannomon X.name: Crash Rolling
Tyrannomon X.text: Crash Rolling: Curls its entire body up, charges at tremendous speed, and minces any enemy that passes it by with the ridge on its back.

Tyrannomon X.name: Crimson Breath
Tyrannomon X.text: Crimson Breath: An enhancement of the original "Fire Breath".

TyrantKabuterimon.name: Shine of Bee
TyrantKabuterimon.text: Shine of Bee: Emits a red-hot explosion from its entire body which is impossible to defend against, and instantly reduces all of its opponents to ash.

TyrantKabuterimon.name: Bee Cyclone
TyrantKabuterimon.text: Bee Cyclone: Summons all of its insect followers to construct an impenetrable wall of bugs.

TyrantKabuterimon.name: Insect Cannon
TyrantKabuterimon.text: Insect Cannon: Fires flying insects that home in on the enemy and attacks them.

TyrantKabuterimon.name: King Spiral
TyrantKabuterimon.text: King Spiral: Releases subordinate insects that swarm the enemy.

TyrantKabuterimon.name: Insect Nightmare
TyrantKabuterimon.text: Insect Nightmare: Circles the enemy and releases flying insects that divebomb the enemy one after another.

TyrantKabuterimon.name: Tyrant Shield
TyrantKabuterimon.text: Tyrant Shield: Increases its resistances against all elements.

Ukkomon.name: Whirlpool Spin
Ukkomon.text: Whirlpool Spin: Spins its body like a top, then crashes into foes.

Ukkomon.name: Liar Dream
Ukkomon.text: Liar Dream: Hijacks an enemy's consciousness after locking eyes with them.

UlforceVeedramon.name: The Ray of Victory
UlforceVeedramon.text: The Ray of Victory (Shining V Force): Strafes with a beam from the ""-shaped armor on its chest.

UlforceVeedramon.name: Victory Sword
UlforceVeedramon.text: Victory Sword (Ulforce Saber): Attacks using the saber that extends from its right V-Bracelet.

UlforceVeedramon.name: Shield
UlforceVeedramon.text: Shield ( Shield): Releases holy aura from its left V-Bracelet which becomes a barrier.

UlforceVeedramon.name: Dragon Impulse X
UlforceVeedramon.text: Dragon Impulse X: Covers self in the aura of a dragon and slashes through the enemy.

UlforceVeedramon Future Mode.name: Ulforce V Saber
UlforceVeedramon Future Mode.text: Ulforce V Saber: Extends a saber from its right V-Bracelet.

UlforceVeedramon Future Mode.name: Tensegrity Shield
UlforceVeedramon Future Mode.text: Tensegrity Shield: Releases holy aura from its left V-Bracelet which becomes a barrier.

UlforceVeedramon X.name: Shining V Force
UlforceVeedramon X.text: Shining V Force: Strafes with a beam from the ""-shaped armor on its chest.

UlforceVeedramon X.name: Ulforce Saber
UlforceVeedramon X.text: Ulforce Saber: Slashes opponents with a holy-beam sword genereated from the "V-Braclet" equpipped on its right arm.

UlforceVeedramon X.name: Dragon Impulse
UlforceVeedramon X.text: Dragon Impulse: Covers itself with a Dragon's Aura and strikes through the opponent.

UltimateBrachiomon.name: Ultimate Blast
UltimateBrachiomon.text: Ultimate Blast: Detonates the energy within its body, and sprays an explosive wind from the huge gunport on its chest.

UltimateBrachiomon.name: Ultimate Quake
UltimateBrachiomon.text: Ultimate Quake: Strikes with its gigantic tail, shaking even the earth.

UltimateChaosmon.name: Broken Destruction
UltimateChaosmon.text: Broken Destruction (Broken Destroy): Attacks with the might to easily crush even larger Digimon.

UltimateChaosmon.name: Ultima Burst
UltimateChaosmon.text: Ultima Burst: Releases the energy of its DigiCores all at once, then fires it at the opponent.

Unimon.name: Aerial Attack
Unimon.text: Aerial Attack (Holy Shot): Spews a  shot from its gigantic mouth.

Unimon.name: Aerial Gallop
Unimon.text: Aerial Gallop (corn Thrust): Stabs the enemy with the horn on its head.

Unimon.name: Uni-Gallop
Unimon.text: Uni-Gallop: Kicks with its hind legs.

Unimon.name: Spread Nails
Unimon.text: Spread Nails (Spread Neigh): Confuses the enemy with a supersonic wave.

Unimon.name: Aerial Attack
Unimon.text: Aerial Attack: Fires a shot of holy energy at an enemy.

Upamon.name: Shock Shout
Upamon.text: Shock Shout: Releases an ultrasonic shout to make the opponent flinch.

VR-Omega.name: Garuru Cannon
VR-Omega.text: Garuru Cannon: Fires blasts of subzero energy from the MetalGarurumon cannon on its right arm which freezes enemies.

Vademon.name: Evil Kiss
Vademon.text: Evil Kiss: Makes a complete fool out of the opponent by blowing them a kiss before hurling meteors and planets at them.

Vademon.name: Abduction Beam
Vademon.text: Abduction Beam: Fires a beam from the ray gun in its hand.

Vademon X.name: Unidentified Flying Kiss
Vademon X.text: Unidentified Flying Kiss: Makes a complete fool out of the opponent by blowing them a kiss before hurling meteors and planets at them.

Vademon X.name: Abduction Beam
Vademon X.text: Abduction Beam: Fires a beam from the ray gun in its hand.

Vademon X.name: Angel's Low Kick
Vademon X.text: Angel's Low Kick: Smiles while it kicks the opponent's feet, completely distracting them.

Vajramon.name: Terra Blade
Vajramon.text: Terra Blade ('): Uses its forefeet and upper body to strike the ground with its twin Deva Blades, generating fissures that extend up to 50 meters ahead of it and hurl out rocks as the shock waves erupt from underground, which inflicts damage on those nearby.
Crosses the Deva Blades and fires an energy beam at the opponent.

Valkyrimon.name: Feral Sword
Valkyrimon.text: Feral Sword ( Sword): Slashes with the Feral Sword to freeze the opponent, bringing their vital functions to a halt.
Attacks with Aurvandil's Arrow, which never misses.

Valkyrimon.name: Laser Javelin
Valkyrimon.text: Laser Javelin: Summons a javelin and launches an explosion from its tips.

Valkyrimon.name: Punishing Storm
Valkyrimon.text: Punishing Storm (Sanction Storm): Raises a tornado to chastise its foes.

Varodurumon.name: Purge Shine
Varodurumon.text: Purge Shine: Clads its body in a barrier of holy light emitted from its feathers that completely invalidates any attacks with an evil will.

Varodurumon.name: Aurora Undulation
Varodurumon.text: Aurora Undulation: Amplifies the purifying light of "Purge Shine" to its maximum and emits it with enough power to pulverize even a star. Because it is emitted at the , it is nearly impossible to evade.

Varodurumon.name: Aurora Angel R
Varodurumon.text: Aurora Angel R: Unleashes celestial balls of light.

Veedramon.name: V-Nova Blast
Veedramon.text: V-Nova Blast (V-Breath Arrow): Spews a high-temperature heat ray out of its mouth.

Veedramon.name: V-Breath Arrow MAX
Veedramon.text: V-Breath Arrow MAX: Concentrates its energy into a giant V-Nova Blast.

Veedramon.name: Hammer Punch
Veedramon.text: Hammer Punch: Powers up its fist and launches a punch at the enemy.

Veedramon.name: Cutting Shoot
Veedramon.text: Cutting Shoot (Cutter Shoot): Uses its claws to create multiple flying blades of wind.

Veedramon (Virus).name: V-Breath Arrow
Veedramon (Virus).text: V-Breath Arrow: Spits a high-temperature heat ray from its mouth.

Veemon.name: Vee Punch
Veemon.text: Vee Punch (V-mon Punch): Swings both of its arms in circles, striking the opponent.

Veemon.name: Vee Headbutt
Veemon.text: Vee Headbutt (V-mon Head): Knocks down the opponent with an intense headbutt.

Veemon.name: Hopping Kick
Veemon.text: Hopping Kick: Gains some momentum and jump kicks with both feet.

Veemon.name: Boom Boom Punch
Veemon.text: Boom Boom Punch: Attacks the enemy with both arms swinging.

Veemon.name: Volley Kick
Veemon.text: Volley Kick: Jumps and does an aerial kick.

Veemon.name: Victory Rush
Veemon.text: Victory Rush: A series of punches with boxing gloves that ends in an uppercut.

Vegiemon.name: Compost Bomber
Vegiemon.text: Compost Bomber: Shoots several compost poop at opponent.

Vegiemon.name: Super Stinky Jet
Vegiemon.text: Super Stinky Jet: Unleashes a stinky breath attack.

Vegiemon.name: Sharp Leaf
Vegiemon.text: Sharp Leaf: Takes three leaves from its back and throws them at the enemy.

Vegiemon.name: Branch Drain
Vegiemon.text: Branch Drain: Takes HP from an enemy.

Vegiemon.name: Party Time
Vegiemon.text: Party Time: Throws its own poop in order to defend itself against intruders.

Velgemon.name: Dark Obliteration
Velgemon.text: Dark Obliteration (Zone Deleter): Flaps its wings with all its power, blowing away the opponent and all of the space around them to another dimension.

Velgemon.name: Dark Vortex
Velgemon.text: Dark Vortex (Master of Darkness): Changes the opponent's nature to darkness and manipulates them to its heart's content.

Vemmon.name: Messer Claw
Vemmon.text: Messer Claw (): Slashes enemies with its razor claws.

VenomMyotismon.name: Venom Infusion
VenomMyotismon.text: Venom Infusion (Venom Infuse): Injects a destructive computer virus within the body of the enemy Digimon, destroying all of their configuration data and terminating their functions.

VenomMyotismon.name: Chaos Flame
