VenomMyotismon.text: Chaos Flame: Fires purple flames from its abdomen.

VenomMyotismon.name: Tyrant Savage
VenomMyotismon.text: Tyrant Savage: Swipes at the opponent with a flaming claw.

Venusmon.name: Healing Therapy
Venusmon.text: Healing Therapy: Makes the opponent's fighting spirit vanish just by caressing their head. In Digimon New Century, Hotan heals Venusmon and its allies then increases their attack's powers.

Venusmon.name: LOVE YOU
Venusmon.text: LOVE YOU: Blows a kiss that makes the opponents who receive it fall over from the shock.

Venusmon.name: Peace Fantasia
Venusmon.text: Peace Fantasia: Has Olive prick the opponent in the head, making it have peaceful intentions no matter what kind of ferocious personality it has. In Digimon New Century, Venusmon throws Olive at the enemy.

Vermilimon.name: Volcanic Strike II
Vermilimon.text: Volcanic Strike II (Volcano Strike S): Shoots a fireball more powerful than Monochromon's at the enemy.

Vermilimon.name: Hard Tackle
Vermilimon.text: Hard Tackle: Charges fiercely and then violently rams the enemy with its horn.

Vermilimon.name: Volcanic Strike
Vermilimon.text: Volcanic Strike (Volcano Strike): A powerful flame shot.

Vermilimon.name: Re-Format
Vermilimon.text: Re-Format (Trick Void): Removes enemy status changes.

Vespamon.name: Mach Stinger
Vespamon.text: Mach Stinger: Attacks using its Royal Lance.

Vespamon.name: Bee
Vespamon.text: Bee : Deploys a hexagonal beam shield from its "Royal Shield" and launches a burst of energy from  the "Royal Lance". This is a tactical formation.

VictoryGreymon.name: Dramon Breaker
VictoryGreymon.text: Dramon Breaker: Performs a heroic sword technique with the Dramon Breaker in which it strikes the opponent, instead of slashing, pulverizing them.

VictoryGreymon.name: Trident Gaia
VictoryGreymon.text: Trident Gaia: Splits the Dramon Breaker and equips the pieces to its arm, takes all the energy within the atmosphere and concentrates it into the tips of its sword, then fires it.

VictoryGreymon.name: Victory Charge
VictoryGreymon.text: Victory Charge: Performs a unique sword technique with the Dramon Breaker which reflects back an opponent's attack.

VictoryGreymon.name: Victory Shield
VictoryGreymon.text: Victory Shield: Unites the shells equipped on its back into a shield, which it wields.

Vikaralamon.name: Fusion Ball
Vikaralamon.text: Fusion Ball ('): Bores through the opponent with a red Bao Ran.

Vikaralamon.name: Boar Bog
Vikaralamon.text: Boar Bog: Regurgitates black sticky goo from its mouth.

Vikemon.name: Arctic Blizzard
Vikemon.text: Arctic Blizzard: Momentarily brings the surrounding atmosphere to absolute zero, flash-freezing the opponent, who it then smashes with Mjöllnir. The attack is named after the fact that the opponent's smashed body becomes like a blizzard.

Vikemon.name: Viking Flare
Vikemon.text: Viking Flare (Viking Flail): Uses the Mjollnir to unleash powerful hits.

Vikemon.name: Bazooka Howl
Vikemon.text: Bazooka Howl (Berserk Howl): Howls with all of its berserker rage.
Uses the Mjollnir to unleash powerful hits.

Vilemon.name: Nightmare Shocker
Vilemon.text: Nightmare Shocker (Nightmare Shock): Subjects the opponent to a nightmare that it can't wake up from using a supersonic wave it emits from its mouth.

Vilemon.name: Touch of Evil
Vilemon.text: Touch of Evil (Death Claw): Slashes enemies with power of darkness.

Viximon.text: Changes into a stone that spouts a toxic gas.

Volcamon.name: Magma Bass
Volcamon.text: Magma Bass (Big Bang Voice): Stuns the enemy with a heavy bass mike performance.

Volcamon.name: Tackle Time
Volcamon.text: Tackle Time (Big Bang Tackle): A mighty tackle with the power to destroy even mountains.

Volcanicdramon.name: Volcanic Flare
Volcanicdramon.text: Volcanic Flare: Spews scorching hot flames from its mouth. The area incinerated by Volcanicdramon never returns to the way it was, and becomes an uninhabitable wasteland for all eternity.

Volcanicdramon.name: Glide Blaze
Volcanicdramon.text: Glide Blaze: Rams the enemy while sending out scorching flames hotter than even magma from its whole body.

Volcdramon.name: Circle of Death
Volcdramon.text: Circle of Death: Attacks with a deadly sulfur that makes everyone in a 10km radius faint.

Vortexdramon.name: Frozen Gust
Vortexdramon.text: Frozen Gust: Dispatches a wind cold enough to freeze the sea.

Vortexdramon.name: Blazing Gust
Vortexdramon.text: Blazing Gust: Dispatches a scorching wind that incinerates both its target foes and the ground beneath them.
Transforms its arms into a colossal sword and dispatches slashing attacks with whirlwind accompaniment.

Vorvomon.name: Petit Flame
Vorvomon.text: Petit Flame: Spews out a small, high-temperature flame from its mouth.

Vulcanusmon.name: Pinpoint Weapon Works
Vulcanusmon.text: Pinpoint Weapon Works: Uses its "Bomber Art" and manufactures then and there an appropriate weapon to fit the situation.

Vulcanusmon.name: Appropriate Works
Vulcanusmon.text: Appropriate Works: Manufactures weapons by performing "Pinpoint Weapon Works" one after another, then equips them to each of its arms in order to fully unleash all of its power.

Vulcanusmon.name: Bomber Art
Vulcanusmon.text: Bomber Art: Radiates flames to use for welding.

Vulturemon.name: Reaper Strike
Vulturemon.text: Reaper Strike: Shoots at the opponent's vitals with the "CND-96" on its right arm.

Vulturemon.name: Desert Death Scythe
Vulturemon.text: Desert Death Scythe (Desert Deathscythe): Tears the enemy to pieces with the scythe attached to the "CND-96".

Vulturemon.name: Witherwing
Vulturemon.text: Witherwing (Wither Wing): When cornered by masses of enemies, it turns the tables against them and shoots out hordes of condors made of sand.

Wankomon.name: Crushing Ball
Wankomon.text: Crushing Ball Ball"}}: Charges its ball with mysterious powers and uses its tail to throw it at the enemy, before causing it to greatly expand above their head and crush them.

Wankomon.name: Stone Body
Wankomon.text: Stone Body: Hardens its body like stone when it senses danger, defending itself against even stronger Digimon.

Wanyamon.name: Smile Fang
Wanyamon.text: Smile Fang: Suddenly bites, after appearing amply charming.

Wanyamon.name: Frothy Spit
Wanyamon.text: Frothy Spit: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Wanyamon.name: Bubbles
Wanyamon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

WarGreymon.name: Terra Force
WarGreymon.text: Terra Force ( Force): Takes all of the energy within the atmosphere and concentrates it into one spot, then fires it as an extremely dense, high-temperature energy shot.

WarGreymon.name: Great Tornado
WarGreymon.text: Great Tornado: Spins at tremendous speed like a tornado and launches itself at the enemy.

WarGreymon.name: Brave Shield
WarGreymon.text: Brave Shield: Uses its "Brave Shield" to defend.

WarGreymon.name: Mega Claw
WarGreymon.text: Mega Claw (Dramon Killer): Slashes its "Dramon Killer" gauntlets.

WarGreymon X.name: Terra Force
WarGreymon X.text: Terra Force ( Force): Takes all of the energy within the atmosphere and concentrates it into one spot, then fires it as an extremely dense, high-temperature energy shot.

WarGreymon X.name: Gaia Force ZERO
WarGreymon X.text: Gaia Force ZERO: Instantly fires "Gaia Force" at the heart of the enemy as a point-blank attack that seems impossible to evade.

WarGreymon X.name: Afterburst
WarGreymon X.text: Afterburst: Performs a one-hit knockout technique by accelerating its attacks with its vernier applied to the Dramon Killers.

WarGreymon X.name: Doramon Killer
WarGreymon X.text: Doramon Killer (Dramon Killer): Uses both claws to do a Dramon Killer attack.

WarGreymon X.name: Grey Fire Zero
WarGreymon X.text: Grey Fire Zero (Grey Fire ZERO): Shoots a small fireball.

WarGreymon X.name: Great Tornado
WarGreymon X.text: Great Tornado: Creates a huge tornado.

WarGrowlmon.name: Radiation Blade
WarGrowlmon.text: Radiation Blade (Double Edge): Cuts the opponent to pieces with the Pendulum Blades.

WarGrowlmon.name: Atomic Blaster
WarGrowlmon.text: Atomic Blaster: Fires an attack from both of the gunports on its chest that destroys the opponent on the atomic level.

WarGrowlmon.name: Megalo Spark
WarGrowlmon.text: Megalo Spark: Emits an electric shock from its chest.

WarGrowlmon.name: Hammer Edge
WarGrowlmon.text: Hammer Edge: Stabs the enemy with its Chrome Digizoid claws.

WarGrowlmon.name: Assault Balancer
WarGrowlmon.text: Assault Balancer: Impales the enemy with its "Assault Balancer" and then throws them.

WarGrowlmon (Yellow).name: Double Edge
WarGrowlmon (Yellow).text: Double Edge: Cuts the opponent to pieces with the Pendulum Blades.

WarGrowlmon (Yellow).name: Atomic Blaster
WarGrowlmon (Yellow).text: Atomic Blaster: Fires an attack from both of the gunports on its chest that destroys the opponent on the atomic level.

WarGrowlmon (Yellow).name: Megalo Spark
WarGrowlmon (Yellow).text: Megalo Spark: Emits an electric shock from its chest.

WarGrowlmon (Yellow).name: Hammer Edge
WarGrowlmon (Yellow).text: Hammer Edge: Stabs the enemy with its Chrome Digizoid claws.

WarGrowlmon X.name: Atomic Blaster
WarGrowlmon X.text: Atomic Blaster: Fires the twin guns on its chest to destroy enemies at the atomic level. It now also uses its arms as well as its chest, making it four times as powerful as before.

WarGrowlmon X.name: Double Edge
WarGrowlmon X.text: Double Edge: Slices through foes using the two Pendulum Blades on its arms.

WarGrowlmon X.name: Double Edge Σ
WarGrowlmon X.text: Double Edge Σ: Slices through foes with its Pendulum Blades Σ.

WaruMonzaemon.name: Heart Break Attack
WaruMonzaemon.text: Heart Break Attack Gives everything a dark mood and depresses them, making the opponent's feeling become dark and sorrowful so that they completely lose their fighting spirit.

WaruSeadramon.name: Dark Blast
WaruSeadramon.text: Dark Blast (Darkstrom): Engulfs the enemy in a whirlpool produced with the powers of darkness.

WaruSeadramon.name: Evil Icicle
WaruSeadramon.text: Evil Icicle: Drops a giant icicle summoned from its horn. Some media depict it as firing a dark beam of energy.

WaruSeadramon.name: Strange Mist
WaruSeadramon.text: Strange Mist: Breathes out a debilitating mist.

WaruSeadramon.name: Thunder Blade
WaruSeadramon.text: Thunder Blade: Stabs the enemy with the electrified blade on its head.

WaruSeadramon.name: Thunder Javelin
WaruSeadramon.text: Thunder Javelin: Fires a high voltage charge from the blade on its head.

WaruSeadramon.name: Doramon Attack
WaruSeadramon.text: Doramon Attack (Dramon Attack): Use the blade on its head to pierce through the enemy.

Waspmon.name: Turbo Stinger
Waspmon.text: Turbo Stinger: Rapid-fires its wide-aperture laser cannon.
A single blow fired after charging up energy. This technique can bring down even larger Digimon, but it is difficult to hit agile enemies with it, so it is mainly used against enemies on the ground.

Weddinmon.name: Whip Decoration
Weddinmon.text: Whip Decoration: Flings fresh cream from the tip of its fan.

Weddinmon.name: Cake Cutting
Weddinmon.text: Cake Cutting: Splits the enemy in two with a razor-sharp .

Weddinmon.name: Happiness Fall
Weddinmon.text: Happiness Fall: An enormous cake is dropped from overhead and explodes. It is a super-surprise technique where the explosive power changes drastically depending on the size of the cake.

Weedmon.name: Deadly Ivy
Weedmon.text: Deadly Ivy (Squeeze Vine): Uses its vine arms to squeeze the enemy.

Weedmon.name: Branch Drain
Weedmon.text: Branch Drain: Takes HP from an enemy.

Wendigomon.name: Koko Crusher
Wendigomon.text: Koko Crusher (Destroyed Voice): Destroys even rocks with a shock wave.

Wendigomon.name: Cable Crusher
Wendigomon.text: Cable Crusher (Club Arm): Swings both of its arms like clubs.

Wendigomon.name: Heavy Attack
Wendigomon.text: Heavy Attack: Attacks with a blow with the power of a beast.

WereGarurumon.name: Wolf Claw
WereGarurumon.text: Wolf Claw (Kaiser Nail): Cuts the opponent to pieces with the sharp claws on both of its hands.

WereGarurumon.name: Garuru Kick
WereGarurumon.text: Garuru Kick: Strikes with a powerful kick.

WereGarurumon.name: Blow Hard
WereGarurumon.text: Blow Hard (Baldy Blow): Punches the enemy with its spiked brass knuckles.

WereGarurumon.name: Garuru Kick
WereGarurumon.text: Garuru Kick: Kicks the enemy while doing a backflip.

WereGarurumon.name: Fox Fire
WereGarurumon.text: Fox Fire: Breathes out an intense blue flame.

WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.name: -slugger
WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.text: -slugger: A sharp blade emitted from the Sagittarius that heads toward the enemy while forming an arc.

WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.name: Shot
WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.text: Shot: A double laser cannon that accurately picks off the enemies vitals.

WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.name: Kaiser Nail
WereGarurumon Sagittarius Mode.text: Kaiser Nail: Cuts the opponent to pieces with the sharp claws on both of its hands.

WereGarurumon X.name: Wolf Claw
WereGarurumon X.text: Wolf Claw (Kaiser Nail): Cuts the opponent to pieces with the sharp claws on both of its hands.

WereGarurumon X.name: Garuru Kick
WereGarurumon X.text: Garuru Kick: Thrusts a powerful kick at the opponent.

WezenGammamon.text: Shoots high-powered shells from its two cannons.

A positron cannon which is shot from its long gun barrel while it pierces its tail into the ground to replenish energy. It boasts the greatest offensive power of WezenGammamon. However, each time it shoots, the exhaust port opens and radiates heat, so it is unable to rapid-fire.

Whamon.name: Blasting Spout
Whamon.text: Blasting Spout (Jet Arrow): Fires a super high-pressure blast of water from the blowhole on the back of its head.

Whamon.name: Tidal Wave
Whamon.text: Tidal Wave: Causes a gigantic tsunami that destroys everything.

Whamon.name: Great Chomp
Whamon.text: Great Chomp: Grabs the enemy using its huge mouth.

Whamon.name: Sweet Chomp
Whamon.text: Sweet Chomp: Grabs the enemy sweetly.

Whamon (Champion).name: Blasting Spout
Whamon (Champion).text: Blasting Spout (Jet Arrow) Fires a super high-pressure blast of water from the blowhole on the back of its head.

Whamon (Champion).name: Tidal Wave
Whamon (Champion).text: Tidal Wave: Causes a gigantic tsunami that destroys everything.

Wingdramon.name: Blaze Sonic Breath
Wingdramon.text: Blaze Sonic Breath: Fires scorching breath from its mouth by exceeding the speed of sound.

Wingdramon.name: Exploding Sonic Breath
Wingdramon.text: Exploding Sonic Breath (Explode Sonic Lance): Accelerates up to maximum speed in a nose dive at the opponent, then strikes them with the lance on its back.

Wingdramon.name: Wing Blast
Wingdramon.text: Wing Blast: Generates a  by moving at supersonic speed, which injures the opponent even if they parry its other attacks.

Wisemon.name: Dialogue
Wisemon.text: Dialogue: Repeatedly preserves the opponent's attacks within space and time, then plays them back at high speed.

Wisemon.name: Eternal
Wisemon.text: Eternal : Imprisons the opponent within the Space-time Stones for an eternity.

Witchmon.name: Baluluna Gale
Witchmon.text: Baluluna Gale: Attacks with a sharp wind carrying magical power.

Witchmon.name: Aquary Pressure
Witchmon.text: Aquary Pressure: Attacks with water of such extremely high pressure that it is enough to penetrate steel.

Witchmon.name: Idle Bubble
Witchmon.text: Idle Bubble: Puts the enemy to sleep.

Wizardmon.name: Electro Squall
Wizardmon.text: Electro Squall (Thunder Cloud): Summons a thunder cloud which unleashes an intense lightning strike.

Wizardmon.name: Magical Game
Wizardmon.text: Magical Game (Magic Game): Demonstrates the breadth of its magical knowledge, from offensive abilities to invisibility and illusions.

Wizardmon.name: Thunder Bomb
Wizardmon.text: Thunder Bomb: Releases a ball of energy with varying effects, from explosive energy to memory erasure.

Wizardmon.name: Vision of Terror
Wizardmon.text: Vision of Terror (Terror Illusion): Exploits the target's fears with terrifying visions.

Wizardmon.name: Blink Breeze
Wizardmon.text: Blink Breeze: Creates a blast of wind from its staff.

Wizardmon.name: Magic Heal
Wizardmon.text: Magic Heal: Uses a green aura to heal an ally.

Wizardmon X.name: Thunder Cloud
Wizardmon X.text: Thunder Cloud: Summons a thunder cloud, which unleashes an intense lightning strike.

Wizardmon X.name: Bolt Break
Wizardmon X.text: Bolt Break: Lightning sorcery powerful enough to cause things to disintegrate at the quantum level using both of its hands.

Wolvermon.name: Rapid Burst
Wolvermon.text: Rapid Burst: Quickly fires energy shots from the muzzles in its palms

Wolvermon.name: Scatter Rocket
Wolvermon.text: Scatter Rocket: Destroys its foes with a barrage of mini rockets housed in both arms.

Wolvermon.name: Badger Slash
Wolvermon.text: Badger Slash: Delivers the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

Wolvermon.name: Tomboy Blaze
Wolvermon.text: Tomboy Blaze: Unleashes flames from its palms to restrain its target.

Woodmon.name: Branch Bash
Woodmon.text: Branch Bash (Branch Drain): Stabs foes with its branches and drains their energy.

Woodmon.name: Woody Smash
Woodmon.text: Woody Smash: Uses both hands to hit the enemy as hard as possible.

Woodmon.name: Leaf Slider
Woodmon.text: Leaf Slider: Attacks by throwing sharp leaves.

Woodmon.name: Drain Buster
Woodmon.text: Drain Buster: Use its poisonous arms to hit the enemy.

Wormmon.name: Sticky Net
Wormmon.text: Sticky Net: Spits out the threads of a tough, adhesive net, completely restricting the opponent's movements.

Wormmon.name: Silk Thread
Wormmon.text: Silk Thread: Spits out stiff threads that are as thin as a silk thread but as pointed and sharp as a needle.

Wormmon.name: Random Roll
Wormmon.text: Random Roll: Flips into a ball and hops into the air to whip the opponent with its antennae.

Wormmon.name: Worm Tail
Wormmon.text: Worm Tail: Spins around and scratches the foe with its spinnerets.

Wormmon.name: Worm Wheel
Wormmon.text: Worm Wheel: Spins into a ball and rams enemy.

Wormmon.name: Worm Scratch
Wormmon.text: Worm Scratch: Jumps in the air and spins into a ball to attack.

Xiangpengmon.text: Causes countless bolts of lightning to strike down over the area where its foe is.
Fires the spears equipped on its wings to shatter the ground.
Makes an enormous sphere of seawater to send crashing into the ground.

Xiaomon.text: Releases a high-frequency wave that is an effective charm against evil.

Xingtianmon.name: Furious Axe
Xingtianmon.text: Furious Axe: Slashes at its enemy with its battle-axe covered in flames.

Xingtianmon.name: Shield Cry
Xingtianmon.text: Shield Cry: Fires a stream of tears from its shield.

Xingtianmon.name: Thunderous Roar
Xingtianmon.text: Thunderous Roar: Lets out a roar that triggers a great shockwave

Xiquemon.text: Travels underwater at high speeds then unleashes a surprise attack on the enemy. In Digimon New Century, it dive bombs the enemy, hitting it with a waterfall on impact.

Fires a small fish-shaped missile from its mouth. These missiles can’t be used rapid-fire, but the impact from a single missile is great, so this is Xiquemon’s main move for finishing off foes. In Digimon New Century it attacks the enemy with its claws before firing the missile.
Coats its talons in ice for close-quarters combat. This move will freeze and break any enemy it grabs, and is also used to preserve its food.

XrosUpArresterdramon (GigaBreakdramon).name: Infinity Prism Gallet
XrosUpArresterdramon (GigaBreakdramon).text: Infinity Prism Gallet: Fires all the drills operating throughout its body covered in countless revolutions of light, allowing it to smash through the opponent.

XrosUpArresterdramon (MetalTyrannomon).name: Spincalibur
XrosUpArresterdramon (MetalTyrannomon).text: Spincalibur: Bisects the opponent with its super-sized Tail Anchor while performing a single revolution.

XrosUpArresterdramon (Sagomon).name: Spincalibur
XrosUpArresterdramon (Sagomon).text: Spincalibur: Bisects the opponent with its super-sized Tail Anchor while performing a single revolution.

XrosUpArresterdramon (Sparrowmon).name: Wing Spiral Shredder
XrosUpArresterdramon (Sparrowmon).text: Wing Spiral Shredder: Rotates at high speed to shred the opponent to pieces.

XrosUpBallistamon.name: Heavy the Shot
XrosUpBallistamon.text: Heavy the Shot: Fires an energy shot surrounded by sonic waves from the gun on its belly.

XrosUpDorulumon.name: Dorulu Checkmate
XrosUpDorulumon.text: Dorulu Checkmate: Spins the drill on its tail, creating a tornado with energy blades.

XrosUpGumdramon.name: Fire Vortex
XrosUpGumdramon.text: Fire Vortex : Spins with its  while leaving a fire trail from it, then hits the opponent's head.

XrosUpMervamon.name: Sexy the Cannon
XrosUpMervamon.text: Sexy the Cannon: Fires a shot from the cannon on its Medullia arm.

XrosUpSabmarimon.name: Oxygen Sorrow Blue
XrosUpSabmarimon.text: Oxygen Sorrow Blue: Discharges super-compressed oxygen from its drill.

XrosUpShoutmon (Kamemon).name: Rock Damashī Arrow
XrosUpShoutmon (Kamemon).text: Rock Damashī Arrow: Fires an arrow-shaped fire missile.

XrosUpShoutmon (Puppetmon).name: Burning Hammer
XrosUpShoutmon (Puppetmon).text: Burning Hammer: Emits fire from its revolver-style hammer, then rushes to the opponent in a flame wheel.

XrosUpTuwarmon.name: Digi Ninpou: Hoshi Arashi
XrosUpTuwarmon.text: Digi Ninpou: Hoshi Arashi: Unleashes a stream of stars from its hand.

Yaamon.name: Rolling Black
Yaamon.text: Rolling Black: Forms a ball of darkness and shoots it at the opponent.

Yaamon.name: Paint Splash
Yaamon.text: Paint Splash: When it finds a Digimon having fun, it covers them with ink, which it spews out of its mouth.

Yakiimon.name: Beniazuma Uppercut
Yakiimon.text: Beniazuma Uppercut: Uses its left fist, packed with piping hot steam, to strike the enemy and send them flying sky-high together with the rising heat.

Yakiimon.name: Beniazuma Straight
Yakiimon.text: Beniazuma Straight: Uses its right fist to deliver a strike packed with all of its power.

Yanmamon.name: Thunder Ray
Yanmamon.text: Thunder Ray: Strafes with an electrified laser.

Yanmamon.name: Sonic Bite
Yanmamon.text: Sonic Bite: Uses its sharp jaws to bite swiftly.

Yanmamon.name: Assassin Arrow
Yanmamon.text: Assassin Arrow: Fires an arrow of energy from its tail.

Yanmamon.name: Electro Shocker
Yanmamon.text: Electro Shocker (Mega Blaster): Fires an electrical ball at enemies.

Yihumon.name: Sky Rend
Yihumon.text: Sky Rend: Delivers a roundhouse kick while firing a razor-sharp slash.

Yihumon.name: Featherblade Breeze
Yihumon.text: Featherblade Breeze"}}: Flaps its wings to fire off countless feathers, which have been prepared with a poison that dulls the movements of the parts of the body that they hit.

Yihumon.name: Ravaging Storm
Yihumon.text: Ravaging Storm Storm-judgments"}}: Catches the opponent in a twister the moment they leave an opening, then rides the winds while delivering attacks from all directions.

Yokomon.name: Bubbles
Yokomon.text: Bubbles: Fires pink bubbles from its mouth.

Yokomon.name: Flower Bubbles
Yokomon.text: Flower Bubbles (Sabão Flower, ): A popping bubble that looks like a flower petal.

Yokomon.name: Adhesive Bubbles
Yokomon.text: Adhesive Bubbles: Escapes while the intruder's movement is restricted by the adhesive bubbles it generates from within its body.

Yolkmon.name: Bubbles
Yolkmon.text: Bubbles: Produces bubbles from its body to intimidate other Digimon.

Youkomon.name: Tail Flame
Youkomon.text: Tail Flame: Manifests scorching hot fireballs and manipulates them at will.

Youkomon.name: Jaenryū
Youkomon.text: Jaenryū: Manifests a dragon of blazing red flames from its tail and burns the opponent to cinders.

Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.name: Rapper Coaster
Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.text: Rapper Coaster: Gets into a rhythm and minces things with its right hand.

Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.name: One-Handed Swing
Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.text: One-Handed Swing (One-hand Swing): Slaps the opponent with a long swing of its left hand.

Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.name: Torpedo Crossing
Yoxtu!Yoxtu!mon.text: Torpedo Crossing: Spins its whole body and strikes the opponent. It has the disadvantage of needing a partner who can wind up its string.

YukimiBotamon.name: Diamond Dust
YukimiBotamon.text: Diamond Dust: Breathes out freezing cold air.

Yuramon.name: Bubble Blow
Yuramon.text: Bubble Blow: Spits out adhesive bubbles to hinder the opponent's movement, then seizes the opportunity to escape.

Zamielmon.name: Snipe Headshot
Zamielmon.text: Snipe Headshot: Shoots through the opponent's head.

Zamielmon.name: Bow Cutter
Zamielmon.text: Bow Cutter: Slashes with the bow on its side as if it was a blade.

Zamielmon.name: Foot Shot
Zamielmon.text: Foot Shot: Fires a trick-shot that it prepared in its feet.

Zamielmon.name: Arrow Lance
Zamielmon.text: Arrow Lance: Fires arrows from its hands.

Zamielmon.name: Arrow Blizzard
Zamielmon.text: Arrow Blizzard (Turbulence Arrow): Slashes at nearby opponents, then fires arrows into the distance and shoots the opponents dead with its random firing, without missing a single shot.

Zamielmon.name: Ultimate Arrow
Zamielmon.text: Ultimate Arrow (The World Shot): Concentrates energy into the Indra, then pierces it into the opponent's core.

Zanbamon.text: Unleashes an attack from the Ryūzan-maru which has the power to cut through the opponent's armor with its gigantic blade, regardless of whether they are defending themselves.

Zanbamon.name: Mystic Flame
Zanbamon.text: Mystic Flame: Unleashes an attack from its youtou which releases a shock wave, generated by the nimble swings of the blade, that can cut the opponent apart crosswise.

Zanmetsumon.name: Goren-Danreizan
Zanmetsumon.text: Goren-Danreizan-Slash"}}: Attacks with all five blades successively.

Zanmetsumon.name: Goju-Rasendachi
Zanmetsumon.text: Goju-Rasendachi: Slices with all five blades simultaneously.

Zanmetsumon.name: Gokumon-Shibari
Zanmetsumon.text: Gokumon-Shibari: Lets out a huge roar from the giant mouth on its body to limit its opponents' movements.

ZeedGarurumon.name: Zeed Cannon
ZeedGarurumon.text: Zeed Cannon: The ultimate weapon for attack.

ZeedGarurumon.name: Full Metal Breath
ZeedGarurumon.text: Full Metal Breath (Full Metal Blaze): Mows down the opponent by simultaneously firing the Zeed Cannon alongside all of the other weapons throughout its body.

ZeedGarurumon.name: Blowback Breath
ZeedGarurumon.text: Blowback Breath: Sprays explosive energy from its mouth.

ZeedMillenniummon.name: Time Destroyer
ZeedMillenniummon.text: Time Destroyer: Consigns hostile opponents to oblivion across space and time. So far, no one who has been brushed off by this technique has returned alive from space and time.

ZeedMillenniummon.name: Chrono Paradox
ZeedMillenniummon.text: Chrono Paradox: Fires two atomic rays from its mouth that destroys everything in their path.

ZeedMillenniummon.name: Time Unlimited
ZeedMillenniummon.text: Time Unlimited: Creates a pocket dimension with compressed time, and traps an opponent there for an eternity.

ZeedMillenniummon.name: Dimension Destroyer
ZeedMillenniummon.text: Dimension Destroyer: After trapping an opponent with Time Unlimited, it collapses the entire dimension it created to destroy them.

ZekeGreymon.name: Trident Fang
ZekeGreymon.text: Trident Fang: Chops up the opponent with a single blow to their trunk.

ZekeGreymon.name: Tail Gun Fire
ZekeGreymon.text: Tail Gun Fire (Destroy Smasher): Unleashes its ordinance while spinning, ensuring complete annihilation of surroundings.

ZekeGreymon.name: Zeke Flame
ZekeGreymon.text: Zeke Flame: Spews the flames of hell from its mouth to burn a large army of opponents to nothing.

ZekeGreymon.name: Plasma Railgun
ZekeGreymon.text: Plasma Railgun: Provides suppressive fire against the opponent with its Plasma Railgun.

ZekeGreymon.name: Final Trident Strike
ZekeGreymon.text: Final Trident Strike (Final Strikes): Maintains a lowered stance while becoming an arrow of shining light and assaulting the opponent, releasing the energy at point-blank range to atomize them.

ZekeGreymon.name: Hyper Launcher
ZekeGreymon.text: Hyper Launcher: Shoots a high-power energy shell to deal with opponents at a great distance or high altitude.

Zenimon.name: Comet Launcher
Zenimon.text: Comet Launcher: Launches rice grains from the guns on both hands.

Zenimon.name: Zeninage
Zenimon.text: Zeninage: Tosses a fellow Zenimon towards the opponent, striking them.

Zephagamon.name: Gale Braver
Zephagamon.text: Gale Braver: Transforms each of its dual blades into boomerangs, that are enveloped in whirlwinds, and delivers slicing blows.
Transforms its wings into wind energy before they converge upon enemies to bisect them.

Zephagamon.name: Divine Tempest
Zephagamon.text: Divine Tempest: Releases massive wind energy from the DigiCore on its chest, scraping enemies off the very face of the planet and blowing them away to distant lands.

Zephyrmon.name: Hurricane Gale
Zephyrmon.text: Hurricane Gale (Wind of Pain): Flies up into the air and hurls the feathers of its hair and wings as pointed arrows.

Zephyrmon.name: Plasma Paws
Zephyrmon.text: Plasma Paws ( Slicer): Cuts the opponent and the atmosphere around it to pieces with the claws on its hands and feet.

Zephyrmon.name: Cross Fire
Zephyrmon.text: Cross Fire: A unison attack with Agunimon. Agunimon charges into a tornado created by Zephyrmon and unleashes its squalling fist of fire.

Zerimon.name: Acid Bubbles
Zerimon.text: Acid Bubbles: Spits acid bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

Zhuqiaomon.name: Crimson Blaze
Zhuqiaomon.text: Crimson Blaze : Releases a swirl of flames comparable to the prominences which jet out during a solar eruption.

Zhuqiaomon.name: Phoenix Fire
Zhuqiaomon.text: Phoenix Fire: Spews ultra-high-temperature flames from its mouth.

Zhuqiaomon.name: Desolation Blast
Zhuqiaomon.text: Desolation Blast: Launches dozens of fireballs from his wings, which can rain down on foes or destroy things above him.

Zhuqiaomon.name: Sonic Zephyr
Zhuqiaomon.text: Sonic Zephyr: Flaps its wings, creating a tremendous shock wave.

ZombiePlutomon.name: Hazard Hold
ZombiePlutomon.text: Hazard Hold: Absorbs data from its prey's DigiCore until they decay.

ZombiePlutomon.name: Hell Slicer
ZombiePlutomon.text: Hell Slicer: Launches sickle-shaped  from its left hand to carve up enemies.

ZombiePlutomon.name: Abomination
ZombiePlutomon.text: Abomination: Bites foes and infects them with its own virus, turning them into puppets it can manipulate.

ZubaEagermon.name: Road T(w)o Decade
ZubaEagermon.text: Road T(w)o Decade: Thrusts straight into the enemy's chest while shouting "Twentieeest!".

ZubaEagermon.name: Vantheon
ZubaEagermon.text: Vantheon (Vingtième, ): Curles its body into a ball and spins towards the enemy, slicing them with its tail blade.

Zudomon.name: 's Hammer
Zudomon.text: 's Hammer (Hammer Spark): Strikes the opponent with the shock wave and sparks produced when it swings down its Thor's Hammer. In Digimon Data Squad, instead of a shock wave and sparks it uses ice.

Zudomon.name: Horn & Tusk
Zudomon.text: Horn & Tusk: Attacks with its horn and tusks.

Zudomon.name: Vulcan's Hammer
Zudomon.text: Vulcan's Hammer (Hammer Boomerang): Throws its hammer like a boomerang.

Zudomon.name: Glacial Spear
Zudomon.text: Glacial Spear (Glacier Spear): Uses the horn on top of its head to pierce an opponent.

Zudomon.name: Cold Crusher
Zudomon.text: Cold Crusher (Ice Lord Bump): Causes a wave of ice to rise up out of the ground and freeze the opponent.
